review_text: Marseille to Zurich A lazy checkin not Helvetic employee who did not want to check my luggage through its final destination neither to release a lounge voucher Star Alliance Gold I finally had a great trip in this old Fokker Crew was extremely attentive flight on time and aircraft clean as snow

VnukovoIrkutsk An eventful and enjoyable flight Everything went smoothly Vnukovo is the closest airport to the city centre and it has also a convenient train connection the train departs from the Kievsky train station This helps to avoid the usual heavy traffic of Moscow UTair uses a new terminal A which is quite handy It is likely that UTair is the only airline which uses a widebody B on this route and the plane seems to be a relatively new and wellmaintained one Friendly flight attendants the flight was ontime onboard catering is not superb but it was OK Would fly them again

Oldest airport that is still in use but great The mother of all airports has an impressive architecture huge size and is very close to the city Unfortunately SN Brussels airlines is the only largest airline flying there together with some local airlines Unfortunately they want to close it in the next years but the building will not be destroyed

Gatwick to Preveza return with Small Planet Airlines Our flights both ways could not have been any smoother and the experience was faultless I didnt try the food so unable to comment but all the staff were friendly and attentive Would use again

Even though it was a really full flight I still had a good experience as a frequent flyer for United Airlines Everything was the same on the way and I dont have much to say But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago The food tasted great but was familiar to me and I hope I didnt feel deja vu

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

The airport staff are friendly and the waiting time is short very convenient because there are many transport choices to choose The seats are comfortable and there are the sky bridge let me see the airplanes

Getting into Kinshasa is quite OK getting out is something else The airlines dontcant have their own staff at the terminal all the flights Kenya South African Ethiopian are handled by the same slow and unfriendly personnel There is now an official exit tax of plus a couple of minor unofficial ones Airport is gloomy very little seating nothing to do except worry about what is going to happen next VIP exit lounge while hardly Heathrow is clean and bright and you get a free drink well worth the extra Even if you speak French dont even contemplate going to Kinshasa unless your hosthotel sends a protocol to meet you at the airport and escort you out Be sure to stock up with US bills for unofficial taxes they wont take less and they dont expect more On a more positive note it is irritating rather than frightening and once youre through the airport everybody is pleasant and everything is fine

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

City of Derry is a small regional airport however check in was very straight forward the Logan Air staff were very friendly The security process was a little over the top however it was fast There is a small cafe within the terminal and its servers drinks and snacks which was more than sufficient for the short wait prior to boarding the aircraft Boarding the flight was by seat number however this was orderly and efficient The flight from City of Derry to London takes just over hour The cabin crew are extremely friendly and provided some teacoffee and biscuits After landing the plane was parked in a remote apron however there was a bus to take us to the terminal upon arrival My luggage was also coming out of the carousal by the time we got to the terminal which meant I was on my way to next destination very quickly Overall this is a great service by Loganair from a regional airport

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped

It is an efficiently run small low cost carrier hub As long as you consider it as such it is appropriate and convenient I see it more as a kind of bus stop for airplanes to a limited number of countries Parking is great and affordable an in walking distance to the terminal Guess total distance from car door to plane door is appx metres Services are limited and foodshops overpriced Big airport prices here on this small airfield Boarding procedures check in and security OK Kind staff

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

Regional onboard service food and beverages LagosNairobi very good International onboard service food and beverages NairobiWashington good Onboard cleanliness satisfactory Nairobi lounge services good Airline customer support at Airport fair Kenya Airways App unreliable Online customer support very poor

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

Conakry is in no way a modern airport even quite old But its management is stunning I have been through this airport a great number of times over the years and am always impressed by its efficiency especially arrivals In minutes you get through immigration and then at the luggage carousel something Ive never seen in the possibly airports I know luggage trolleys are already positioned in front of the carousel so very convenient Unfortunately to leave the airport is somewhat difficult especially for elder people as you have to push you trolley on a pretty steep ramp before exiting the airport Also departure area needs to be modernized
A smallish airport with limited facilities but clean and comfortable

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free

Arriving into Landvetter was fine had to get a bus to the other side of the airport to go through immigration As I was on a nonschengen flight we had to go through immigration This part is quite small with European check desk and two noneu that are hidden in the corner and there are no signs to show that the noneu passport holder check is on the side Waited in the wrong queue for a few minutes till I had to ask and the immigration office put me right Immigration was quick with very friendly staff on arrival and departure Im the baggage reclaim you can see the bags come out from the conveyed overhead which is cool On departure airport queue times were quick with security very quick as well Gates has a small eating area with minimal seating and lack of plug sockets and as you have gone through immigration you cant leave this part Plenty of food and shopping options very modern clean airport that is nice to travel through
Flight attendants hospitality service careful consideration I hope the WiFi on airplanes will be better in the future Cabin clean and tidy It was an unforgettable journey

Super small airport and wonderful if you are meeting someone from Hamilton Car rentals from site were out of cars and were no help Cost bucks to take cab from airport to in town car rental agency Tim Hortons only outlet in airport on arrival side or vending machines Flying with Flair and can only get tickets printed and drop off suitcases two hours before flight What we thought we were saving to get to a Blue Jays game in Toronto cost us more by flying to this back wood airport than what it would have been to fly WestJet to Toronto Never again will stick with West Jet friendly and helpful and reliable And the Blue Jays lost which made the trip even more horrible

Flew TACA Airlines from Lima to Bogota Only the outside of the aircraft and the food carriage were TACA The rest magazine and crew were Avianca Food service for the and a half hour flight was great full meal Full service of drinks juices beers alcoholic I would fly with them again

Even though it was a really full flight I still had a good experience as a frequent flyer for United Airlines Everything was the same on the way and I dont have much to say But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago The food tasted great but was familiar to me and I hope I didnt feel deja vu

Quite impressed as I was not expecting much the ticket was very cheap brand new aircraft very cleaned and smelled nice Pretty good legroom seat next to me vacant so it was comfortable flight Two hot meal services main meals not very good but was happy with fresh fruit on the tray insider tip when offered SEAFOOD NOODLES dont expect wok stir fried asian style noodlesyou will get something that I would expect in Swedish kindergarten see photo below crew dont speak much English and the service is somehow chaotic but not too bad IFE quite limited but enough for me

The airport is well laid out the gates are simply marked and the staff are extremely helpful There is an information desk to the left of the entrance which will direct you where you need to go Considering this was my first flight and after having a head injury they allowed my parents to go through security with me to guide me through the process Security was slower than I have come to realize is usual and very confusing however once on the other side there were many shopping options and also a great deal of eating options There was suitable seating and the boards with times of departures were readily available The bathrooms were a little messy however

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

I recently flew American Eagle operated by Republic from Washington DC to Philadelphia and I was really impressed The E was comfortable and wellsuited for the short hop between cities Even though the flight was only minutes and we had a slight delay leaving Washington due to congestion the crew still managed to offer a full beverage service in first class which I really appreciated Despite the delay we landed in Philadelphia on time It was a smooth and enjoyable flight overall

The onground experience was great very pleasant checkin experience the Adani lounge has a separate section for Vistara Frequent Fliers and Business Class which is quite nice The onboard experience is a bit soso the legroom in economy is fairly tight and feels less than Indigo They have cutdown on the quantity of food in meals visibly in economy class The IFE was good enough to keep oneself entertained and thankfully with the middle seat remaining empty the flight was quite comfortable

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too
It was the smoothest landing ever and an enjoyable flight overall The crew was very polite and the departure and the arrival were on time in a minute

ARNHEL on the standard B Clean and airy cabin legroom fine for such a short hop Coffeetea served for free Courteous FAs gave out a stuffed toy for the baby in our party and took extra care explaining how the infants seatbelt worked Bags were on the belt in minutes at HEL
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers

What a great little airport Friendly staff in all areas and in my opinion unique system to me anyway of scanning the hold luggage whilst youre with it before its loaded onto the aircraft Domestic departure lounge is small but plenty of seating available

Bangkok to Hong Kong and return After several good experiences I only use Orient Thai for my flights to Hong Kong Their price is Set regardless whether youre buying ahead or last moment Other low costs can have their cheapest offers around US less however that distinction quickly fades with slapping you various charges before you click buy Orient Thais fare is all inclusive inclusive of taxes a hot meal and KG of baggage too They used to fly an older B however now they use the version Flights were on time the plane was comfortable Staff active and helpful Seats and leg room superior to other low cost and many full fare airlines out there Only drawback is that there is no online check in and you get seats at the airport so you might not get your favourite seat All in all cannot fault them and love to see them fly to more Asian destinations
TFNGMZ return on ATR Very good minute flights Served cup of water and chocolate bar Great views of a snow capped Mt Teide on left going and right returning

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

Really small airport but everything went fine Fast check in and fast security check Theres only one coffee shop kuna for a cappuccino and kuna for water is a decent price People speak English and are friendly The WiFi works fine but you have to get the password from the personnel I asked a girl from the duty free shop Taking points away only because the WiFi password is not available somewhere and you have to ask and there are no nice seating areas
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Although it is a regional airport it handles two international arrivals Seattle and San Francisco As I avoid YVR Immigration like a plague I spent over hours in one of my latest arrivals I prefer Victoria to get into Canada and then go to Vancouver You can take a taxi cab to the ferry terminal would not work on late flights though and be in Vancouver in less than hours enjoying one of the most scenic rides you will ever find in a ferry Immigration in YYJ is short and pleasant You get your bags in less than minutes usually and go through customs in less than Overall great airport to get to Canada Coming out is also simple and effective Short lines and great staff

Return journey Clean modern aircraft comfortable seat tasty food and drying and great cabin crew On the way back ground staff checked our bags through to EDI on BA even though we did not have the journey on a single ticket Impressive and enjoyable journey and I would happily use them again

Overall a great airport with great facilities and ample outlets to eatdrinkshop The only issue about this airport is the queues at immigration and security which is serious For instance immigration at arrival took minutes although there were only people in front of me and this was because only windows were open for processing

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

Flew in from Baltimore on Southwest What a great little airport Easy to navigate spotless facilities fast wifi and good options for coffee and snacks A great alternative to Boston for access to Cape Cod

This is a great airport us my wife and self We fly from it twice a year We have just returned from Lanzarote We had no problems at all until we arrived back at hrs mins late There was a full plane load of passengers and only Border Control Officers on duty We were stood in a snakelike queue for nearly half an hour in a room that was like a shed I think that Border Control can do a lot better and should be doing so After saying this we are flying from Doncaster again in Sept

The airport was not busy when we arrived but this did not stop it taking minutes to pass through immigration and collect bags Facilities are what you expect from an airport about years out of date and did not expect anything different I guess Found the staff to be unfriendly and there were no painted on smiles available here

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point

Had a great flight from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines A brief winter maintenance delay ensured a safe departure and while we experienced mild turbulence leaving Philadelphia and again upon arrival in Washington the pilots handled it smoothly Due to the conditions inflight service was not possible but safety remained the priority The Main Cabin Extra seats made for a much more comfortable experience and with a flight time of under minutes we arrived quickly and safely Republic continues to deliver a reliable and professional service for the American Airlines group

This is a fairly good airport Nice and clean easy to get around This airport is also very small and therefore has less wait time thus you can probably get away with arriving only hour prior to departure and still make your flight On the other hand there is not very many options to eat or shop

AZDMHD Aseman is one of the only airlines that provides domestic flights between Yazd and Mashad Tickets are cheap and service is ok There was a delay of hr which feels endless waiting at a small domestic airport Despite the delay the flight was comfortable on a Fokker aircraft Not much legroom but fine for a flight of about mins Some snacks were included and that was ok Friendly staff

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

Tallinn is my favourite airport of all airports Ive been to Its so small lovely and there are never crowds flowing around There are about gates The Business Lounge is quiet and comfy and theres always enough food Its main difference is the low ceiling compared to other airports There arent many restaurants or shops but the Tax Free Shop has almost everything needed for your flight Staff very friendly and WiFi works well
The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

Arrival on Sunday morning Apr Good airport quick luggage delivery clean airport Departure on Thursday evening Apr Check in correct no air conditioning very hot temperature more than C on the evening very crowded due to small boarding lounge and not enough seats Only one small bar in international area for more than large aircraft B departing at the same time

I had to visit Abidjan this January There is no doubt the airport is more than a pleasant surprise One would expect the worst for any West African ariport in general and even more for this one keeping in mind that the country is fairly isolated and suffering from heavy civil unrest and at the edge of civil war keeping most western travellers and business away In fact the airport corresponds totally to European counterparts of the same size fairly small thus The terminal building is very new and has been totally rebuild in a quite recent past with all confort one can expect Aircondition normal sanitary facilities and yes all is clean and in good working condition On arrival jet aircrafts just dock at a direct tunnel connection to the building distances are quite short All controls are very smooth with absolutely no bribes to give to any official While standing in line for passport control a doctor passes trough the lines and checks vaccinations Yellow fever is compulsory every where there is security passport control is smooth and efficient although every one tries to be closest to the luggage belt this also goes quite smoothly including inspection of luggage No unauthorized people in the arrival area and nowhere unpleasant people insisting on helping you carrying your luggage and then trying to run away with it apparently some people do have a sort of authorization to enter customs area for helping passengers but not insisting Departure also is quite smooth Check in is done in an enclosed area with identity check at the entrance so here also one is safe after checking in there is just a short way up the stairs passing customs and then to the departure hall Here also with all normal facilities duty free shop large restaurant area some smaller shops and sanitary facilities still clean and in good working order Altogether thus a pleasant experience

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

Older Dash but comfortable and good leg room but very noisy Departed on time friendly sole flight attendant juice and water on offer and great views of the Atolls they were organised friendly and have pride in their brand and country cant ask for more than that A bit pricey but no competition I guess

The trip took us from Bangkok to Paro and back to BKK and other than having to use the apron bus at Suvarnabhumi and the lack of IFE the entire process was faultless The flights both departed and landed ahead of schedule checked bags didnt go missing meals were comprehensive and appetising cabin crew were courteous and professional With Business Class fares being a premium over Economy fares I wondered why more people didnt take up that option As several others have pointed out the views upon the journey in and out of Paro were breathtaking making it a great way to welcome any visitors into their enchanting and enthralling kingdom

Last year I flew from Saint John Airport on my way back to Toronto Although the airport is quite small but the service is fast and very friendly Check in staff at Air Canada counter was very friendly and even the security staff were courteous to all passengers As soon as boarding was announced we embarked the aircraft followed by a short walk as there are no air bridges used at this airport

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive

We had to return early from a holiday in Dubai and it was considerably cheaper to fly from Sharjah than from Dubai Sharjah is a relatively small airport but has a reasonable duty free area a food court with a number of very reasonably priced outlets and very friendly staff It was very clean and staff were constantly and vigilantly cleaning the public areas Unfortunately the check in desk for Pegasus was very slow and boarding was slow as well Nevertheless a stress free experience Would definitely use Sharjah again

Great restaurant upstairs that serves main course meals and happy to work in your time frame for your flight Modern building and brilliant to depart and arrive from if you live anywhere nearby Just make sure you check the kind of aircraft being used for your flight If you do NOT want to be on a small regional or propeller plane your choices are limited Nothing better than arriving at HPN and getting home locally in under minutes

We took a short flight from Vientiane to Luang Prabang and service at every touchpoint from checkin to arrival was delivered with smiles professionalism and efficiency A clean aircraft with ample leg room was another example of their star service If my experience was the standard that Lao Airlines delivers then this airline will surely go places Highly recommended

There in December Jan and Mar times very quick handling of luggage etc comfortable waiting area and free internet No queues for Immigration desk One point that is minor if you dont know where the bus to Rotterdam centre is located you may have a problem however I took a taxi and then it takes only minutes Its much more agreeable than the big airports like Toulouse Orly JFK or even Schiphol also in the Netherlands

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

What a great little airport Friendly staff in all areas and in my opinion unique system to me anyway of scanning the hold luggage whilst youre with it before its loaded onto the aircraft Domestic departure lounge is small but plenty of seating available
Modern infrastructure and worldclass service Known for its efficiency cleanliness and design it has become one of the most impressive airports in India

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

Great Airport We travelled from Manchester and from landing to leaving the airport it only took us minutes For the return flight we checked our bags in minutes and took just another to get through security etc The departure lounge is bright and welcoming and boarding just took a few minutes Good experience I wish more airports were like this

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

Brussels to Eskisehir with Tailwind Airlines Nice flight The crew was okay the plane was outdated The food was okay too not free or included though There wasnt any kind of inflight entertainment Great if you dont want WiFi connection or when you dont want to know where you are

Awful airport On arrival was very smooth to be fair but the passport control queue was horrendous for those with UK passports and no accessibility and on departure despite wearing the sunflower lanyard and having booked fast track I was declined at fast track and made to queue for security and with my disabilities I struggle with long queuing The departure hall was very busy and hot with not many places to sit I had a great holiday in the Algarve but it was tarnished by the atrocity that is Faro Airport on a positive note however the toilets were very clean

Its a pleasure to travel with Cyprus airways They are so kind and really try to help The staff in Dubai is super friendly and playful with my daughter Im a nervous flyer and I always feel at ease when travelling with Cyprus airways

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport
I think it is a great airport compared to most Chinese airports Today Hangzhou Airport is quite different from what it used to be Its very large and modern and has good service

The south domestic terminal in Anchorage is world class and beautiful This new terminal is very modern spotlessly clean provides amenities expected at an international airport and offers a view of the surrounding mountains that is breathless The displays of local wildlife native culture and art is unsurpassed by most airports in the world However the old north terminal which is now connected to the south terminal by a concourse is sad Anchorage is one of the five most busy airports in the world for international cargo airlines but not for international passenger service The few international airlines that do provide passenger service mostly during the summer months are forced to use the north terminal as US customs is located there All the comments seen on this site are about the north terminal made by international travelers and are undoubtedly true Wish they all could have been processed through the magnificent south building

Gatwick to Preveza return with Small Planet Airlines Our flights both ways could not have been any smoother and the experience was faultless I didnt try the food so unable to comment but all the staff were friendly and attentive Would use again
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet

I could not believe this was the first time I had arrived and departed from Tokyo Haneda Airport When I first arrived immigration was straightforward and I was very impressed When I was leaving checkin was also pretty straightforward and the whole Terminal was massive with great lounges shops and food Plus I got to do plenty of plane spotting from lounges

Seats in economy cabin very comfortable compared to a lot of airlines The hot meal was of good quality however on a hour flight it was the only hot meal and a small roll before landing You need hot meals on such a long flight we were so hungry when we got off the aircraft Half of the crew were tui Scandinavia crew they were lovely very glam and hard working the uk based crew could learn a lot from these guys The uk based crew on my flight out looked a mess and done the bare minimum and werent very pleasant Drinks were plentiful also which they only served at specific times throughout the flight as I heard them say no to a few people when they asked outside of the service I think this is great stops people getting drunk and annoying on a long flight which makes it more pleasant for everyone The hours went quickly and Id fly with TUI again

This airport has undergone a transition from ugly duckling to something of a beautiful swan Spacious beautifully furnished comfortable are just some of the words that come to mind There is plenty of signage and even passengers on discount airlines are treated as if they are appreciated Although it doesnt have a butterfly garden I would compare this in ambiance to Singapore Changi on a much smaller scale of course Burmese charm is everywhere The CIP lounges are spacious well stocked well staffed and offer a good selection of local and international snacks I wish every airport in Asia was more like this one

Harrisburg MDT is a great airport Small but connected to many international gateways Security lines are short Food options are limited but good I only wish they offered a NYC area connection My airport of choice

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else

BRUJNBBRU with a stopover in Tripoli There were some troubles with the inflight entertainment On our way to JNB there were not enough headsets so we couldnt use the inflight entertainment On our way back from JNB to Tripoli the inflight entertainment in our part of the plane didnt work at all The food was okay and the cabin crew friendly Its definitely value for money but there are some things to improve

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again
Family trip from Montral to Edmonton Boeing Canadian North is a nice airline Food great No inflight Entertainment Beverages and Cabin Service nice It was a calm nonturbulent flight

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport
From Prague to Saint Petersburg great service nice food professional group price of the ticket was higher than competitors but worth it highly recommended

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

Small airline but a good one Despite heavy turbulence on the flight from Kuala Lumpurs old airport to Tioman Island I felt safe and that the FAs knew what to do in the event of an emergency Cant be sure of course but it felt that way Good information from the crew about the turbulence Small planes but comfortable for the relatively short flight Good service during the flight

Seats in economy cabin very comfortable compared to a lot of airlines The hot meal was of good quality however on a hour flight it was the only hot meal and a small roll before landing You need hot meals on such a long flight we were so hungry when we got off the aircraft Half of the crew were tui Scandinavia crew they were lovely very glam and hard working the uk based crew could learn a lot from these guys The uk based crew on my flight out looked a mess and done the bare minimum and werent very pleasant Drinks were plentiful also which they only served at specific times throughout the flight as I heard them say no to a few people when they asked outside of the service I think this is great stops people getting drunk and annoying on a long flight which makes it more pleasant for everyone The hours went quickly and Id fly with TUI again

YYZAMSYYZ Legroom was okay got the exit row on the way back Food decent for a charter Seat width normal unlike Air Transat they dont squeeze an extra row of seats in I didnt feel the need to upgrade to Economy plus The personal entertainment device portable hard drive with monitor was great Worth the euro on the day flight back

Vancouver to Honolulu via Ottawa We had the pleasure of flying Omni after a very long delayed missed connection flight and they went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and comfortable The higher level of service is very evident in the crews demeanor and professionalism Penny and Ilya were particularly helpful and went out of their way to make our flight memorable Thank you to the entire team

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

Hassle free check in is something unheard of at this Airport Not even a professional customer friendly staff in the check in counter Staff treat passengers as some kind of nuisance to their work they prefer to gossip between themselves rather than clearing passengers in the queue

My experiences have always been pleasant Security lines are extremely short and there is a lot of open space Checking in is never a hasslewe have been able to pass by the checkin desk in minutes or less on the worst of days Bathrooms are clean and theres always a cafe or news store open Delta seems to have the largest concentration of flights at the airport most of them being on their regional affiliates running under Delta Connection Overall the airport is very good clean and friendly

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there
Modern infrastructure and worldclass service Known for its efficiency cleanliness and design it has become one of the most impressive airports in India

I arrived at T Terminal Hongqiao Used the Sky Priority Customer Service Lovely helpful staff who helped me with my oversized baggage I was stressed about it and the team helped me without a problem Then even showed me clearly were to go as well as showing me were Sky Priority Lounge was I couldnt be more grateful for their good service

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Having stepped off an A a day before it was quite a strange experience to be one of just four passengers on the seater propeller ATR aircraft from Bangkok to Laos But the one hour and fiftyminute flight experience was lovely Following the traditional Sabaidee greeting from the friendly twoperson cabin crew we took off on time The elegantly uniformed flight attendant had a frangipani placed in her hair echoing the countrys national flower as well as it being in the airlines logo The x seating was comfortable with ample leg room Although a small airline it had an inflight magazine It was a sunny day and flying at around feet we had a clear view of the mountainous green scenery below A small snack box was offered which contained a tuna and cheese sandwich and drink and hot coffee was also served On arrival at Luang Prabang stepping out umbrellas were available just in case you found it too hot or if it was raining to walk to the terminal building The return flight was also on time this time with around or so passengers nearly all enjoying posing for photos by the aircraft

Airport was much better than expected In the general area are a few food options incl coffee shop icecream bar and a few fast food choices They even have a small duty free We were in the TAAG lounge called the Pearl lounge Clean comfortable with basic drinks food Staff are very friendly Did not see showers Internet is available but weak Other than internet this lounge is better than many US lounges I have visited I was expecting something much worse

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

The new Terminal C is a significant improvement over the old Delta terminal This is a spacious terminal with plenty of light from the floor to ceiling windows giving views of the airport runwaysaprons and CitiField and Arthur Ashe Stadium The walk from gate to gate was rather long Restrooms are plentiful and clean however in some locations they could use more stalls given the number of passengers who traverse this terminal Dining options are placed conveniently I had a delicious lunch at one of the restaurants The airport WiFi is very fast and worked flawlessly

Aircraft clean with immaculately presented and polite cabin attendants Seat comfortable with great leg room Flights on time Inflight entertainment consisted of North Korean military type music Food was a cold burger with a choice of water coffee tea or soft drink

Offered sandwich and drinks at this very short flight I love flying on Embraer planes in a short regional flights as they are very comfortable Staffs were OK both on ground and on board All in all it was a good flight in terms of schedule service ticket price

A good airport Lots of places to eat including burger and many seats with places to charge you devices I sat there for hrs just streaming Netflix on the wifi May I say the wifi Is great Highly recommend

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

Tashkent Airport has become very efficient on the international side Immigration and customs both on the way in and on departure were quite user friendly Not a lot of shops and restaurants but that was not inconvenient Readers should be aware that the domestic terminal is on the other side of the runway and it could take up to minutes to connect from one side to the other side using a taxi

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

I have flown here only on private aircraft The commercial airlines have yet to discover this often overlooked resource The parking and terminal buildings are great Reminds me of how Chicago Midway used to be before the most recent spate of reconstruction like a hometown feel Very clean facilities and the commercial pax I have spoken to all seem to enjoy it Mostly the lack of a commute to Chicago I think

Worst Airport in the world arrived to check in then security on baggage Then Passport machine thought great all good Walked through Duty Free then a mile long queue to get through to B gate BA is B gate Poor shops nobody could shop or eat unless you had got their hours early This queue apparently is normal and is called the new fast track what a joke One person in a box checking passports again Run to B hundreds of people standing there no way could you board in Groups just a free for all Again with one woman at the gate before you got on the coach to the plane still coaching you out to the plane She was checking everyones passport again Why havent they upgraded this system by now and built satellite gates off the main airport Not going back there

Modern small airport bright and clean with good signage On arrival it is a short walk to the terminal Toilets better than expected but all modern and clean All the facilities you could want not busy and not overcrowded I think I was expecting a small outdated airport building but obviously its a tourist hub so they have made it pleasant

Naples to New York JFK I flew this airline with caution after the reviews but I was pleasantly surprised One way with Meridiana for was the cheapest flight offered by any airline We got a free checked bag which was nice especially after my experiences with other cheap airlines The flight itself was also nice We flew economy and I felt like I had sufficient room and comfortable seats that retracted It was a ten hour flight and they fed us twice both appetizing meals I would definitely recommend this flight especially for the price

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

I wanted to acknowledge the entire ground staff including the Security who helped us a great deal to arrange boarding the aircraft We reached airport just min before scheduled departure and the checkin was closed After requests since we as a family had to take onward flight from Delhi the ground staff went out of their way to help us

SAPBZEFRS I had two flights with this regional airline this past month Ssmall grand caravan planes but both clean and spotless flights on time crew friendly Due to the size of the aircraft theres no FA on board Price paid fair I do recommend if youre flying to Belize

My son and I flew them in June from Copenhagen to Podgorica It was an older F aircraft but quite comfortable In fact we commented on how far the seats reclined The flight attendants were nice and the cockpit crew did a nice job getting us there safely We departed on time and arrived on time No complaints

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

Comfortable and clean provincial airport Didnt use any facilities other than the toilets which were clean and tidy Only real criticism is lack of seats at the gates I was on a full A flight to Brisbane and there were only seats for about passengers There is also no segregation of incoming and outgoing passengers the former have to weave their way through those people waiting to board Passengers seated in the rear half of the cabin were requested to go down stairs across the tarmac then up stairs to the rear door of the aircraft However by the time I reached the front of the queue the outside doors had been locked so I had to fight my way through the whole length of the aircraft cabin

Brussels to Lanzarote Nice little airline Both outbound and return flights on time Food premium menu delicious Swift and attentive service of the staff Clean aircraft on both ways We booked emergency exit seats which offered extra legroom which is a bonus on h flights Would recommend this airline for sure such a shame that this brand will probably disappear

Quite impressed as I was not expecting much the ticket was very cheap brand new aircraft very cleaned and smelled nice Pretty good legroom seat next to me vacant so it was comfortable flight Two hot meal services main meals not very good but was happy with fresh fruit on the tray insider tip when offered SEAFOOD NOODLES dont expect wok stir fried asian style noodlesyou will get something that I would expect in Swedish kindergarten see photo below crew dont speak much English and the service is somehow chaotic but not too bad IFE quite limited but enough for me
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

Kaohsiung International Airport is great but small There are some shops and restaurants The biggest point is that the airport is clean quiet and efficient the directions are clear as well Besides this international airport are really near downtown Kaohsiung The subway system is partially done recently you can take the KMRT to any place in downtown

Getting into Kinshasa is quite OK getting out is something else The airlines dontcant have their own staff at the terminal all the flights Kenya South African Ethiopian are handled by the same slow and unfriendly personnel There is now an official exit tax of plus a couple of minor unofficial ones Airport is gloomy very little seating nothing to do except worry about what is going to happen next VIP exit lounge while hardly Heathrow is clean and bright and you get a free drink well worth the extra Even if you speak French dont even contemplate going to Kinshasa unless your hosthotel sends a protocol to meet you at the airport and escort you out Be sure to stock up with US bills for unofficial taxes they wont take less and they dont expect more On a more positive note it is irritating rather than frightening and once youre through the airport everybody is pleasant and everything is fine

I had to cancel my travel plans from Dar Es Salaam to Arusha due to a medical emergency Coastal Aviation was very supportive understanding and efficient in processing my situation Much appreciated Great company

Conakry is in no way a modern airport even quite old But its management is stunning I have been through this airport a great number of times over the years and am always impressed by its efficiency especially arrivals In minutes you get through immigration and then at the luggage carousel something Ive never seen in the possibly airports I know luggage trolleys are already positioned in front of the carousel so very convenient Unfortunately to leave the airport is somewhat difficult especially for elder people as you have to push you trolley on a pretty steep ramp before exiting the airport Also departure area needs to be modernized

We flew EasyFly from Medellin EOH to Pereira When we checked in online we discovered theyd moved the flight minutes later This wasnt a problem for us and we checked in online without problem Check in at the airport was quick and we had no issues with bags one was slightly over kg one was under and we didnt get charged The flight was on time and upon arrival in PEI the bags were on the belt immediately The plane was clean and seemed fairly new It was impossible to buy a ticket from the US with a US credit card on their website however we were finally able to buy a ticket online using a Colombian travel agency Aviatur We had no problems and were pleased we chose EasyFly

I flew Brisbane to Honiara on the th April Flight Left early was only full and arrived minutes early Add kg of luggage good plentiful food and beer what more could you want Entertainment was poor but its only a hour flight so I survived Staff friendly which is much more than I can say about the BA Qantas staff on the Flights coming out from Ireland

Brand new airport On the positive side for Chinese standards it certainly is welldesigned and wellconnected Bright and clean checkin area Good choice of restaurants and cafes both before and after security controls As to the negatives the security controls are quite inefficient and slow the airline lounges are all quite poor and certain gates from upward are very far up to min walking

Bogota to Pereira After reading many bad reviews were prepared for anything Fortunately everything went well Our slightly overweight baggage was not an issue kgkg the ground staff was friendly Not knowing if they charge extra for not printing the ticket we did the check in ourselves but seeing many with an airline printed ticket I assume this is not an issue The flight left minutes earlier the cabin crew was friendly as well and during the short flight they even offered us a small free drink The plan was clean the captain friendly So overall a great experience Not much to complain about really

Extremely friendly wheelchair assist personnel I am disabled and was being moved from gate to gate and since I had some layover time I decided that I would like to get a snack at one of the fast food shops The wheelchair assistant not only took me there but he helped me get my order as well The people everywhere were friendly Cleanliness wasnt top grade but adequate

Absolutely tiny airport but great at the same time has a lot of character Lacking service stalls but thats due to the scale of the airport and the expectations of people derived from visiting larger airports

I had not heard of Air KBZ before I made the booking for my Myanmar trip However all of the three domestic flights Mandalay to Thandwe Thandwe to Sittwe and Sittwe to Yangon went very well ontime arrivals food and beverages free of charge although the flights were short friendly staff modern and clean aircraft I would fly Air KBZ again in case I return to Myanmar

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Leipzig is a wonderful city but difficult to reach from the UK Flew from Manchester via Dusseldorf The airport is huge but seemingly deserted for much of the time though most facilities are there There is a long but under cover walk to the railway station to catch the hourly connection into the city euro Here lies the problem There was no indication as to which platform the train departed it was No nor were there any staff to ask Eventually with the help of several other bemused travellers we worked out the ticket machine and the train eventually arrived A great little airport with friendly staff but for international travellers the rail connection into the city needs a bit more working out

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National

Not Verified The new airport is much better than the old but the issue with taxis remains The military controls the airport and hence which taxis are used No meters and extortionate fares Better off walking minutes south on road outside arrivals right angle to airport terminal and pickup a bluebird or AA cab from there Clean and metered Pity the Government does not stop in and do something about this as it is a horrible welcome to what is otherwise a friendly and interesting city and region

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

Note that the airport departure tax is SP for over s All taxis from airport are run by private company and are fixed rate The cost is around All previous comments re chaos at departure excessive zeal by document checking officials overcrowding etc are still as relevant as ever A thoroughly depressing experience in what is a friendly generous and wonderful country

Incheon Airport generally has a nice and clean layout making navigation straightforward However my experience today at Security Lane was quite disappointing Out of the three passport scanner machines only one was operational causing severe delays I joined the queue at PM and only cleared security at PM taking over hour and minutes to get through For an airport of this reputation such inefficiency was unexpected Thankfully I had arrived early for my PM flight or I might have missed it While the rest of the airport experience is great the management should urgently address such issues

Shanghai to Tehran return July Direct flight to Tehran Economy class Aircraft A Fare was quite good Checkin fast Cabin crew showed Iranian hospitality No individual inflight entertainment but fairly speaking since the flight was at night One toilet closed for whole trip the other two were not clean and almost out of tissue Food was enough and fine for me Many drink options Flying time was less than hours on my way to Tehran and less than on the way back to Shanghai Considering all the above I will certainly choose this airline next time for my trip to Tehran

Used this airport multiple times for international and domestic arrivals and departures Nice and clean Airport staff are friendly Provides jet bridge at almost every flight In my opinion it needs more coffee shops eateries and lounges Parking spot is located conveniently close to the airport entrance
Small airport clean and friendly staff However they have horrible wifi Make sure you have a good data plan if you have to sit for a while for your flight

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia

Flew Monarch from Alicante to Gatwick on the ZB on the th May on board A GZBAK Seated in row seats were very comfortable and leg room generous Cabin crew really helpful and also very cheerful Flight left on time and also arrived promptly despite a missed approach initially into LGW Overall a great flight experience and far more superior product to some of the other UK based low cost and charter airlines My only criticism and something I was not happy with was that Monarch do not appear to apply a crew rule in the cockpit at all times

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

Modern small airport bright and clean with good signage On arrival it is a short walk to the terminal Toilets better than expected but all modern and clean All the facilities you could want not busy and not overcrowded I think I was expecting a small outdated airport building but obviously its a tourist hub so they have made it pleasant
Friendly and fast service Enough toilets seats and bins But shops close early and have a extremely poor selection in duty free If you want anything make sure you get it before coming to the airport
