Brussels to Lanzarote Nice little airline Both outbound and return flights on time Food premium menu delicious Swift and attentive service of the staff Clean aircraft on both ways We booked emergency exit seats which offered extra legroom which is a bonus on h flights Would recommend this airline for sure such a shame that this brand will probably disappear
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

Toulon to Paris Orly Aircraft on time and clean Good service in flight pleasant staff on departure inflight and on arrival We had to leave bags at plane entry gate and we fetched them at plane exit gate in Paris The aircraft is useful for small flights but is a little small for passengers Flight entertainment would have been appreciated domestic flights in another countries have in flight entertainment even for hr flights

Yangon to Mandalay Lounge photo and In flight meal photo are added We can access Lounge at Yangon International Airport for all Business Class traveler variety of Breakfast Lounge is located at the rd floor of Yangon International Airport Terminal for domestic In flight meal is great but simple because it is just a hour short flight

Bennett at the TSA first check point was so incredibly sweet to our son and his attitude was great Im sure everyone that works for the TSA feels this way on the inside but he was clearly showing it to us on the outside Keeper

I fly this airline regularly between Yellowknife and Edmonton Staff is generally friendly and the complimentary food service is a nice touch but generally inedible Unfortunately they have the tendency to change your seats without notice and you will not find out until checkin time Much of the reason for this change is that if they notice a flight is only half booked they use half of the plane for cargo which eliminates the first rows of seats Thus when booking on Canadian North make sure you book the back row of seats between and you likely wont have to worry about your seat being changed Prepare to be packed in like sardines on most Canadian North flights though Seat pitchwidth is standard

The south domestic terminal in Anchorage is world class and beautiful This new terminal is very modern spotlessly clean provides amenities expected at an international airport and offers a view of the surrounding mountains that is breathless The displays of local wildlife native culture and art is unsurpassed by most airports in the world However the old north terminal which is now connected to the south terminal by a concourse is sad Anchorage is one of the five most busy airports in the world for international cargo airlines but not for international passenger service The few international airlines that do provide passenger service mostly during the summer months are forced to use the north terminal as US customs is located there All the comments seen on this site are about the north terminal made by international travelers and are undoubtedly true Wish they all could have been processed through the magnificent south building

Berlin Tegel is a very unique airport both is positive and negative ways After arriving at Berlin Tegel and disembarking the aircraft we had to queue up on the jetbridge as the customs checkpoint was right after the jetbridge A very interesting concept Right after that was a small baggage carousel then out of the departures area This meant that there was basically no departures area We had to wait quite some time for our baggage When we returned to to the airport our checkin process was pretty smooth and the lounge was easily accessible There was a huge observation deck which spanned the roof of a terminal offering beautiful views of the runway and tarmac a good place to spend the time However you have to go through a small security check and buy a ticket before entering Every two gates had its own departure area with seats and its own security checkpoint This meant snaking queues into the public area each time a flight was boarding and it was hard to walk around with baggage because there was little space Inside the tiny departures area there was insufficient seating and insufficient space for the boarding queue Everyone was squeezed at the gate and there was absolutely no order or anything No queues set up

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

I went to Jamaica for a week on vacation and I have no complaints regarding Caribbean airlines Not the best airline on the planet but theyre definitely by far not the worst they are reasonable and if youre willing to spend a bit more than business class definitely is substantially more comfortable The only drawback that I can think of but that isnt their fault is the fact that on the return trip I had to make four stops in four different countries

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National

Cochin International Airport is a beautiful environment friendly and comfortable airport From the infrastructure to the furniture the process the staff everything about this airport exudes comfort and positive vibes The airport is powered by solar panels wooden interiors and well functioning toilet fittings and fixtures make this airport an environment friendly one

The ground staff in Puerto Princesa Airport and air crew of flight Z were so kind and understanding I have traveled via AirAsia Philippines times and I havent encountered any problems with them I always find their crew friendly The online booking is easier to navigate and payment process is smooth compared to the trouble I experienced with the other local airline

MontpellierMditerrane Airport is a tiny but nice airport Facilities are clean some computer charging desks are available reasonable amount of seats can be found at the gates Shopping and eating options are according to the size of the airport The airside area also features a lovely terrasse taking advantage of the sun drawbacks however The terrasse does not offer a direct view on the movement area and its the spot where all smokers endup Bagages delivery on arrival was a bit long especially for such a small airport Traffic right outside the terminal can be abot messy as the pickup dropoff zone seems to be on the street so cars are jammed Wifi connection procedure should be simplified and streamlined

The airport staff are friendly and the waiting time is short very convenient because there are many transport choices to choose The seats are comfortable and there are the sky bridge let me see the airplanes

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

The queue for the border was moving quite fast the border guards were working fast The toilets in the baggage reclaim area was clean although there was a queue to them one of the two urinals wasnt working The toilet would be better if they were bigger albeit they were quite clean

I had two flights with Atlantic Airways Flight Bergen Faroe Islands and Faroe Islands to Copenhagen one week later Both flights on time Comfortable seats clean aircraft good food friendly service I will flight with Atlantic Airways again with pleasure
The conveyer belt was not working ground staff are limited and quite unsupportive no canteen to eat food But the airport is very clean Newspaper stand and water filter is well in sight
It is a shame that the people at security do not speak English This is an international airport For the rest it is okay food is good and it is reasonably clean
From Prague to Saint Petersburg great service nice food professional group price of the ticket was higher than competitors but worth it highly recommended

The trip took us from Bangkok to Paro and back to BKK and other than having to use the apron bus at Suvarnabhumi and the lack of IFE the entire process was faultless The flights both departed and landed ahead of schedule checked bags didnt go missing meals were comprehensive and appetising cabin crew were courteous and professional With Business Class fares being a premium over Economy fares I wondered why more people didnt take up that option As several others have pointed out the views upon the journey in and out of Paro were breathtaking making it a great way to welcome any visitors into their enchanting and enthralling kingdom
Nothing to do Old airport looks like some maintenance is needed Not a lot of shops or seating Toilets not clean at all No ventilation in terminal humid Definitely not what I would expect in Nice

My AirAsia Zest flight was a short flight from Manila to Cebu but a good trip I arrived minutes earlier than scheduled my seats were upgraded for free and my check in luggage arrived on time in the baggage claim Everything was good but unfortunately during my flight they took off the headrest covers on the seats and the head rest looks unclean For money I paid for and the service I got I was satisfied

This June we booked on La Compangnie Newark to Paris return Our flight over was cancelled hours before departure We had firm bookings on a flight Paris to London La Compagnie offered us a later flight instead of Paris to Nice Of course we could not make our Paris to London connection We dropped that and waited until the next morning flying directly to London from Nice We incurred an extra nights stay in Nice taxi rides a lost ticket from Paris to London lost return flight when you dont show for the first flight you lose the return and a lost night in our London hotel adding up to over a thousand dollars in extra costs At the end of our stay in England and Paris we were told that our flight from Paris to Newark was also cancelled If we arrived at am at Orly we would be put on the morning flight instead of the more comfortable afternoon departure Flights for people both cancelled and we are repeat customers The check in people at La Compangie said the company would meet us they did not would reimburse us if we showed receipts they did not After multiple attempts to contact anyone by phone and waiting for weeks they more or less told us too bad we owe you nothing Unless you are willing to see your flight changed with very little notice and you have a great deal of flexibility or insurance at the other end do not fly this amateur operation

I flew Motor Sich this past July from Kyiv to Odesa and it was a great experience It was on one of their AN s and to my surprise the seats were the most comfortable economy seats I have flown not to mention the most room Also when checking in my bag was a few kilos overweight and they let me check it with no extra charge Would definitely fly Motor Sich again

Awful airport On arrival was very smooth to be fair but the passport control queue was horrendous for those with UK passports and no accessibility and on departure despite wearing the sunflower lanyard and having booked fast track I was declined at fast track and made to queue for security and with my disabilities I struggle with long queuing The departure hall was very busy and hot with not many places to sit I had a great holiday in the Algarve but it was tarnished by the atrocity that is Faro Airport on a positive note however the toilets were very clean

Second time we have flown Rex and it is now our go to airline Staff service and on time performance were exemplary It is in everyones interest to support Rex in the interests of competition But the efforts of their staff make for a truly great experience miles ahead of any other airline in the country

A great airport only one hour from New York City that is still a secret A major stop for SouthWest it is a welcome relief from the congestion at La Guardia or worse JFK Nice new buildings with convenient parking for locals or access to a train station with links to all of long island and NYC

Departure experience was relatively smooth an early morning flight on Ryanair so airport was very quiet Security was well managed clear markings on the floor to encourage social distancing However there was no coffee shop open so nowhere to buy a drink or a bite to eat Arriving back was very quick there were a number of staff members on hand to organise passengers no queue at passport control and bags were out within minutes however this was to be expected due to a very quiet flight and an empty airport Overall whilst the airport appeared clean we did not see any staff members cleaning while we were there with no hand sanitising stations available to passengers
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

Great little airport used mainly by Porter airlines Check in was efficient and you go down to an airport lounge open to everyone They serve free tea coffee and soft drinks along with cookies and nuts The wifi is free and fast Boarding is effortless and the scenery on take off is stunning The only downside was that when the lounge is busy it gets a little grubby with dishes lying everywhere Otherwise it comes highly recommended

For a small beachside city developed as a getaway destination for North Americans this little modern airport did not disappoint me Getting through security was a breeze very friendly TSA and compared to other airports Ive been to navigating is easy enough If you are someone who goes to the airport not just to fly but to shop mountains of stuff this airport might not be for you granted it has somewhere between and gates total and there is no gargantuan walkway of dutyfree shops to be found The terminal is very modern and clean For some reason despite being first in line for takeoff it did take us about min to get off of the ground Lots of general aviation so this might be a regular thing Bottom line would I fly here Absolutely This airport is all about convenience and efficiency

We had to return early from a holiday in Dubai and it was considerably cheaper to fly from Sharjah than from Dubai Sharjah is a relatively small airport but has a reasonable duty free area a food court with a number of very reasonably priced outlets and very friendly staff It was very clean and staff were constantly and vigilantly cleaning the public areas Unfortunately the check in desk for Pegasus was very slow and boarding was slow as well Nevertheless a stress free experience Would definitely use Sharjah again

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

A modest little airport in Sabah Arrived on a domestiic flight from KL so no formalities Leaving again domestically to Kota Kinabalu was a breeze with very fast efficient checkin bag scan etc The airport is clean light airy and efficient by modern standards a joy to use

Flew SkyWork Airlines from Berlin to Bern You can eckeck in hrs before flight Both flights were on time Cabin was clean and legroom standard Service was friendly and they offer coffee and pie for lunch Airport was small but there was a bustrain connection to the town I would recommend them

Arrived from Bangkok on Thai flight and still bussed to the terminal in June Queues for visa on arrival handled relatively quickly and luggage handling dealt with promptly and efficiently Friendly staff with a relaxed atmosphere

Guayaquil Airport is modern and clean but if you arrive on a domestic flight there is no transit You need to go out and do checkin and security Arrivals can be crowded and staff are not that friendly The one smile that I got was from the girl selling chocolates at the store inside

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Vistara is overall good The seats were comfortable the food was kind of okayish staff service on point inflight entertainment was okay This my first time flying with Vistara and i am sure that i will be flying again with this airline The ground service could have been more better than this the bus took a little bit of time
LuganoAgno is a little airport maybe the smallest in Switzerland but I think its the most efficient Its commercial says Youll be in the air in minutes and its the truth I think its a great airport

For a small beachside city developed as a getaway destination for North Americans this little modern airport did not disappoint me Getting through security was a breeze very friendly TSA and compared to other airports Ive been to navigating is easy enough If you are someone who goes to the airport not just to fly but to shop mountains of stuff this airport might not be for you granted it has somewhere between and gates total and there is no gargantuan walkway of dutyfree shops to be found The terminal is very modern and clean For some reason despite being first in line for takeoff it did take us about min to get off of the ground Lots of general aviation so this might be a regular thing Bottom line would I fly here Absolutely This airport is all about convenience and efficiency

The arrivals hall at the international terminal is clean and tidy but does not cope well with any more than large aircraft arriving at the same time It can take over an hour to clear customs and there is only one baggage conveyor The only ATM is after passport control and you will need PGK if you wish to purchase a visa so it pays to have your currency ready before you depart for POM The departure lounge is also very clean and tidy and customs and immigration are efficient However if you wish to do shopping there is only one very small duty free shop and an even smaller cafe after customs and security

Cleanliness of Terminal toilets and food section must be improved Toilets seems to be unattended for ages floor is full of tissues and stains Bins are full Food court tables and chairs are under the same condition which is quite surprising as per Japan standard Air Conditioning is not cool enough seats at he waiting area are also not enough However I still love to come back to visit Japan again

After a week away we returned to Atlanta and couldnt find our vehicle Somehow the parking space location was deleted in my phone Nokuthuba Bray found us wandering around trying to find it It took about an hour but she went above and beyond to find it We are grateful for her great effort
Clean easy to navigate reasonably priced for an international airport weak wifi signal Security staff not very polite The airport was easy to access

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good

KULCTUKUL The Shuanglin terminal is equipped with all the usual amenities The toilets are clean the terminal is clean The terminal also has signs in EnglishChinese Going through customs and immigration is a breeze You can reach the city centre easily by bus or taxi however signs to the bus outside was not to clearly shown

A relatively large regional airport for a small town However Darwin is the state capital of Northern Territory We checked in for the flight went through security and then waited for the flight to depart There were no hassles or problems Everything went smoothly

Small clean airport Close to the city centre If one arrives for a later flight in the evening arrive with a full stomach as nothing is open after It is an efficient small airport with quick security The TV is still on at full volume in the departure area

Is a small airport clean in the most northern part of the world where you can reach like normal tourist The walking tofrom the airport is always in a open space not airport finger be prepared for temperatures below months of the year The baggage claim is in normal time no so slow but no so fast There are taxi to the city center and the bus waiting for all passenger There are two bus with different routes you need to ask which one is for the your hotel The new security check point for taking the airplane is getting a little bit slowly but after the waiting area is nice the same like in many years the store is nice and the staff is great

Arriving at this airport is a little strange as it seems to be full of men wearing leather jackets However departure is quite nice its never very busy but everyone who works there is friendly and the cafe does a good selection of food

Book flight for Thanksgiving Left Nov one way to Fresno Flight was nice and comfortable no complications Book flight back from Reno Nevada December at am direct flight to Portland only to have canceled and reschedule for over booking Unable rescheduled on Sunday to fly so forced rebook by airline for Monday No base seat available so force to buy a higher price ticket or be reschedule for Tuesday Refunded dollar from Sunday then force to pay dollar Monday or be scheduled There more but I book flight through Alaska and flight was Via Skywest So their more even late leave airport on Monday and ground stewardess take minute to play with another passenger tablet before being able board plain Flight suppose be am left Reno after am

Our flight was on time checkin was smooth The staff on board were friendly I highly recommend this airline despite several negative reviews I think it is much better than many European low cost airlines Il nostro volo stato puntuale il checkin stato veloce Il personale a bordo stato cordiale Consiglio vivamente questa compagnia aereanonostante le diverse recensioni negative penso sia molto meglio di molte low cost europee

A modest little airport in Sabah Arrived on a domestiic flight from KL so no formalities Leaving again domestically to Kota Kinabalu was a breeze with very fast efficient checkin bag scan etc The airport is clean light airy and efficient by modern standards a joy to use

Traveled to Haikou from this airport as there were no flights from Macau to Haikou It is a fairly large airport with a small aviation museum in the departures hall However the airport was a bit old and wasnt very clean Overall it was quite a good airport with interesting activities to pass the time

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights

This is a quite modern airport and serves the country well after that being said I felt the airport is terribly connected to the other parts of the island and it makes you rely heavily on taxis or hotel transfers On arrival they will ask you for the Mauritius all in one form if you do not have it they will send you to the end of the line so that you can fill it online the airport provides free wifi for that then they will ask for hotel accommodation and return tickets make sure you have then handy or this will delay you and everyone else standing in line The staff seem to be friendly specially if you speak French Bathrooms were clean and after immigration and security on departure there are plenty of food options including global fast food giants I would say that I enjoyed my time while using this airport

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

Ryanair flight operated by Lauda Europe was on time Legroom wasnt great but was only just slightly worse than the same route with Austrian Airlines The crew were awesome a special shoutout to the female crew member who managed the iceinthecup situation for me I would happily fly this airline again its about the same as Austrian Airlines except you dont get a free small chocolate Recommended

Small regional airport With just two terminals it is pretty painless to navigate Lines at the security checkpoint move fast I was told that a contractor operates the checkpoints In my experience staff was friendly and two or more lanes were open Some restrooms in the secure area were closed off due to renovations in progress Concessions were limited but there is a McDonalds a Subway a news store and a coffee outfit Because its a regional airport many code share flights are operated by smaller airlines flying commuter aircraft If youre not a fan of turboprop aircraft avoid Piedmont Air operating as US Air Express on DHC planes

Birgi Airport has recently had a makeover so new there were no arrival or departure boards In many respects it reminded me of Pisa Aeroporto before it got too big On arrival I was nearly the victim of a potential scam Unlicensed taxi drivers gather around the door to the arrivals hall They spot your name on a card being held by a genuine tour company As you come into the arrivals hall they call out your name and when you acknowledge them they claim to be your pre booked taxi Fortunately I noticed my name on a card being held by representatives from the genuine company I had booked with For departing flights eat before you set out for the airport At checkin there is just one very small snack bar and shop Panini and water just over EUR and not a great deal of seating Everything was clean and new but facilities are extremely minimal with only vending machines for refreshments after security Waiting in the gate area the seating is insufficient to cope with the number of passengers I thought it was also very warm but probably not so for your average Sicilian Access to aircraft is by descending several flights of stairs and then crossing the tarmac on foot

Noumea to Tokyo in economy and it was a good experience for a hrs flight The crew was warm and welcoming The seat was comfortable with a lot of space for my legs and the entertainment system was complete However the A cabin looked quiet old but these aircraft have to be replaced by mid The food was correct but not exceptional Overall it was an appreciable flight

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

Arrived on the last evening flight from Barcelona tourist desk very helpful and received our luggage within minutes No taxis available so took the airport bus driver was very helpful and even dropped us a short distance from our hotel

The mid morning flight took off on time from CCU and as I had to go to Bangalore for work my company had booked this flight for me Web checkin and baggage drop were smoothly done Boarding also started on time Landing and disembarkation also happened swiftly along with baggage retrieval which was good IndiGo may not be a glamorous carrier but it gets the job done of taking you from point A to point B efficiently

Rigolet Labrador to Goose Bay Labrador on October on an Air Labrador twin Otter Aircraft has been well used over the years but provided a comfortable and quick way back to Goose Bay Bush flying copilot loaded and unloaded the bags seating well wherever there is an empty seat No complaints about the service and would not hesitate to fly with them again

Flight from Rome to Turin the plane was old but very clean the hostesses were all very friendly Its better than other low cost airlines because they let you bring both a trolley and a small handbag in the cabin while on other low cost such as Ryanair that isnt allowed

Because LH flights from FDHCGN are now to FRA only and at inconvenient times followed by connections to CGN by train I elected to fly InterSky instead Very clean aircraft and professional service throughout But for an Economy one way ticket price of they could surely provide at least a free cup of coffee Poor value everything else fine

A beautifully decorated small airport located near the city of Lyon France This airport is not too large but it has all international facilities available Very neat and clean Luggage collection was faster However there are very few chair to sit on for waiting Taxis are available

Durban to Cape Town with Comair This is a hour flight which was full The business class seats were the same as economy but with a little extra legroom and the middle seat was empty The FAs were mature and friendly There was a full bar service and light lunch was served The aircraft was clean left on time and arrived on time A relatively smooth flight unlike BA they serve refreshments and full bar service on this short haul domestic flight

I used Wakkanai Airport to fly out to Tokyo Haneda It is located about minutes away from Wakanai city There are only four flights per day by All Nippon Airlines two in and two out to Haneda and a city in Hokkaido The three storey building is clean modern and spacious Checkin is on the ground floor second floor is the arrival and departure gates and third floor is the viewing gallery Gift shop and a small restaurant are on the second floor just next to the securitydeparture The airport is on an open field with no other buildings nearby Wakkanai Park which the Japan Cup sled dog racing is held here annually in the winter is opposite the airport Like most Japanese regional airports Wakkanai airport is very much under utilized The ground staff are polite and efficient

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

My husband and myself were at Alicante airport returning from a short break I am disabled following a subarachnoid haemorrhage years ago I really needed to feedback on my support from Carmen who reported she has worked many years in the assistance area she was so kind and helpful and made my journey much more settled I cannot thank her enough Regards Kath Robinson
We took flight from Kathmandu to Delhi The aircraft was Airbus Flight was quite good and on time Food that was given during flight was good and well presented cabin crew was so friendly and humble

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

I had just gotten to Khartoum from Dubai and I really had to use the washroom I went to the mens washroom and man oh man It smelled like people went there and forgot to flush I didnt use the washroom I ran back to my father because there was faeces on the floor of the toilet as well Outside I saw a janitor sitting in his chair comfortably and as I do not know how to speak Arabic I just decided to hold it instead of telling someone to clean up Other than this the airport was alright but not even close to ideal A month later my mother came via the same flight and airport and she had to wait hours at the luggage belt for her luggage to arrive
Great service safety standard met Comfy seat and nice snacks The staffs in all aspects are very kind and very helpful Sad it will merge with Thai Airways

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

Not recommended if having a long time between connecting flights but otherwise it is good The airport is clean and tidy A good variety of shops to cater for the traveller Food is varied international flavours and of high quality Immigration is slow allowing only person at the counter at a time so therefore families and groups take longer to process Allow more time to be processed through immigration versus other countriesairports and allow longer transit times if connecting to another flight If needing to connect to a domestic flight look out for the transit cart I had a hrs layover between flights and Bali International is not the place to do this There is no air con and no power points I would never transit through Bali again if the layover time is longer Id try flying via Jakarta instead Checkin counters open hrs before departure checkin area is airconditioned but was told there are no seats inside which is roughly right I did have to checkin at area E which was down corridors and stairs and it was a big air conditioned space I saw lots of vacant seats but if was too late to know this after sweltering in the predeparture checkin area where there are cafes

I recently flew with Swiss Air on the Bucharest to Zurich route in an Airbus A Despite the overall comfort of the aircraft and the friendliness of the cabin crew the cabin temperature was much too low and could not be adjusted despite our requests The crew was kind and suggested we wear warmer clothes assuring us that the situation would improve over time Unfortunately the temperature remained consistently low throughout the flight making the journey less comfortable than we would have liked Nevertheless the aircraft was modern and clean and the staff provided prompt and friendly service If it werent for the temperature issue I would have had a very pleasant experience If the temperature cannot be adjusted immediately the company could provide passengers with additional blankets to offer them thermal comfort Overall my flight experience with Swiss Air was good but the temperature issue left a negative impression

I was visiting family in India so this was the airport we went to and it was actually really good there They had lounge chairs at the gates The only problem was the constant beep during a conveyor belt motion and it was really annoying and it spread throughout the airport I really do think this is a great airport overall

Brussels to Eskisehir with Tailwind Airlines Nice flight The crew was okay the plane was outdated The food was okay too not free or included though There wasnt any kind of inflight entertainment Great if you dont want WiFi connection or when you dont want to know where you are

Great little airport somewhat bizzare security arrangements which seem to depend on who you are or who you are with but really clean and with a nice cafe and seating while you wait the far side of passport control Duty Free expensive and poor selection

Flew to Dublin yesterday th October after catching train from Preston where I had been working for a few days to Squires Gate which is about a minute walk ADF was a bit of a disappointment but checkin and security a breeze Staff friendly and efficient Depatures lounge was a bit oldfashioned not necessarily a bad thing quite nostalgic really but was very clean and the cafe was good Aer Lingus as always a joy to travel with
Lots of seating Not enough electric plugs or charge points WiFi was hopeless it didnt work Tannoy too loud Staff seem nice enough Appeared clean

This airport is located in a train station next to it which is pretty cool but can cause major traffic getting in to it The inside is clean and well kept with plenty of restaurants Security is just ok not many lines open so it can take a long time to get through The issue I have like most Chinese airports is that they dont use the jetways much and make you walk out on tarmac and take buses sometimes to and from aircraft In our case it was in the rain which made for an uncomfortable trip Not sure why when jetways were open and they have enough but from what I can tell is that when the plane is not to depart after landing it gets stored over night and if you fly in later at night you will have to take bus so I try to avoid night flights into this airport
Not Verified Courteous and friendly staff Flight left early by about minutes when it was confirmed all planning to fly were on board Crew was great Seating was great

Ground service is terrible compared to in the air Manual checkin process with no computers This airline seems to be the only one to have a lounge in the domestic terminal in Yangon Airconditioned and friendly associates offering a cheese croissant No bathroom inside so that was a drag People in Lotus class got a private van to the plane which was nice compared to cramming onto a bus Onboard the flight was pretty good The front of the plane is much quieter compared to the back Their inflight magazine was pretty decent and the english grammatically correct Even on short flights they gave you food On my YGNMDY flight which was about minutes they served a full breakfast Seats were pretty comfortable on par with United A first class seats I dont really see the need for inflight entertainment on such short flights

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

Really good experience Security was busy but extremely efficient I was travelling with far too many laptops locked in security bags long story which obviously raised eyebrows Everything got searched lots of questions asked but so friendly and professional that it was really no hassle Couldve been awful but was actually as pleasant as it could have been Great burger surprise at Carls once airside Seating around the gates is a bit uncomfortable but its there and theres enough of it The gate itself was efficiently managed and theres room without a horrible crush All in all a good experience and one Id be happy to repeat
Small airport which makes everything easier But going through security was a hassle with lines nothing compared to Beijing though Dont expect much of it given the size Very clean

We booked the flight because it was rather cheap on ctrip hours before departure my wife got a message that my flight from Changsha to Chengdu was cancelled and we should call the airline company Due to Chinese New Year and the Coronavirus it was pretty hard to contact anybody so we decided to take the car to the airport At the airport the ticket desk was unable to change my ticket Sichuan Airlines was unable to change my ticket so we had to call ctrip After nearly hours we got the schedule change and I was able to get an earlier flight Would have wished the airlines had offered me the schedule change by themselves Service on the flight ChangshaChengdu was nonexistent I am not sure if that was due to turbulence or to the virus but it was just a twohours flight and I had brought some food of my own In Chengdu I had to get my luggage and wait for hours to check it in again fortunately there is a good lounge for transit passengers at Chengdu Airport At pm the Sichuan Airlines counters got really busy as there were many flights departing It was really crowded but service was quite quick I was pretty surprised when the flight to Rome got cancelled maybe due to personnel shortage because of the virus My gutfeeling says the flights to Prague and to Rome were pretty empty so they cancelled one flight Passangers to Italy got rebooked to our flight and even that one was not full Seats were a bit narrow and my earphones did not work but I was so tired takeoff at am that I did not need any inflight entertainment Luckily there was no foodservice at the start so passangers were able to sleep The flightattendants handed out bottled water and snacks when I awoke I found snacks and water on the vacant seat next to me Very thoughtful hours before landing they served breakfast It was not a lot we did not even get trays It was Chinese food and I liked it but for Europeans who cannot eat spicy food the choice was not good I am used to spicy food but even I considered the breakfast to be quite spicy No drinks were offered for breakfast Luckily I always try to get a seat near the galley so I could get hot water during the flight for my tea Allinall Sichuan Airlines was quite cheap the aircraft semiclean and inflightentertainment choices were okay If you are not too tall and do not need to many amenities I can recommend this airline Worst flight I ever had to China but still reasonably comfortable

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

I fly this airline regularly between Yellowknife and Edmonton Staff is generally friendly and the complimentary food service is a nice touch but generally inedible Unfortunately they have the tendency to change your seats without notice and you will not find out until checkin time Much of the reason for this change is that if they notice a flight is only half booked they use half of the plane for cargo which eliminates the first rows of seats Thus when booking on Canadian North make sure you book the back row of seats between and you likely wont have to worry about your seat being changed Prepare to be packed in like sardines on most Canadian North flights though Seat pitchwidth is standard
I agree with the previous reviewers comments This is a great little airport An added bonus is that there is now a direct train link to Jerez centre as well as Cadiz and the surrounding cities
Fast security checks great food court with wide selection of healthy and affordable meals and also fastfood Overall a great experience I can recommend this airport

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre
Mahon is clean light and airy with reasonable shopping facilities and bars the seating area is particularly good with a view of the airfield and runway and plenty of space
Everything was very good We used the lounge in the airport The services were great

Chisinau airport is the only international airport of Moldova and sometimes seems to be out of proportion with the growing traffic But anyway despite its small size after the latest restructuration it became a very efficient and easy to fly from The ground staff are very productive and manages the traffic with a great dexterity The number of shops and food choices remains low but its not really an airport of transit The main flaw of Chisinau airport is access to and from the airport without real shuttle service provided There is a minibus marshrutka route to the railway station but it doesnt service all night long and you often need to require a taxi very cheap Airport is very clean and staff is very professional

Isnt it fascinating that you can buy any spirit in a one liter bottle but water only in l bottles I asked and the not so friendly stuff assured that the whole airport just sells little bottles at the gates that is after security check Oh and when I asked why she cleverly replied just because I have never seen an airport that poor with food and beverages Dont come hungry or thirsty

Beijing to Pyongyang The Tupolev aircraft is as comfortable as many that are flying around the US The checkin experience was quick at Beijing and Pyongyang The crew were friendly and smiling during the flight The burger was quite tasty and I got a beer with it Baggage quickly delivered at both ends

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

I had to visit Abidjan this January There is no doubt the airport is more than a pleasant surprise One would expect the worst for any West African ariport in general and even more for this one keeping in mind that the country is fairly isolated and suffering from heavy civil unrest and at the edge of civil war keeping most western travellers and business away In fact the airport corresponds totally to European counterparts of the same size fairly small thus The terminal building is very new and has been totally rebuild in a quite recent past with all confort one can expect Aircondition normal sanitary facilities and yes all is clean and in good working condition On arrival jet aircrafts just dock at a direct tunnel connection to the building distances are quite short All controls are very smooth with absolutely no bribes to give to any official While standing in line for passport control a doctor passes trough the lines and checks vaccinations Yellow fever is compulsory every where there is security passport control is smooth and efficient although every one tries to be closest to the luggage belt this also goes quite smoothly including inspection of luggage No unauthorized people in the arrival area and nowhere unpleasant people insisting on helping you carrying your luggage and then trying to run away with it apparently some people do have a sort of authorization to enter customs area for helping passengers but not insisting Departure also is quite smooth Check in is done in an enclosed area with identity check at the entrance so here also one is safe after checking in there is just a short way up the stairs passing customs and then to the departure hall Here also with all normal facilities duty free shop large restaurant area some smaller shops and sanitary facilities still clean and in good working order Altogether thus a pleasant experience

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

Vancouver to Honolulu via Ottawa We had the pleasure of flying Omni after a very long delayed missed connection flight and they went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and comfortable The higher level of service is very evident in the crews demeanor and professionalism Penny and Ilya were particularly helpful and went out of their way to make our flight memorable Thank you to the entire team

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place
Great regional airport Min check in time for Lufthansa flights is mins Good connections via MUC to international destinations Reasonable amenities at the airport

I would like to express my gratitude to the airport staff for caring about my comfort and positive impressions of the company I would like to express special gratitude to the employee Annette for helping me resolve the issue with my luggage The flight was comfortable and in a safe atmosphere for me

Hong Kong to Bangkok and my first time with Orient Thai Airlines and I am very satisfied with both the price and service Orient Thai was cheaper than Air Asia and the Boeing was very spacious with comfortable seats Also they served breakfast airline meal with drinks that tasted ok

Considering the standard for Brazilian Airports the Capitals is very modern Good options for shopping and eating and even some cinema theaters As it is one of the hubs of the country the traffic in intense most of the time There is a lack of good transportation options for the city There is no subway station the buses are rare and uncomfortable and the taxis are quite expensive

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

Overall a great airport with great facilities and ample outlets to eatdrinkshop The only issue about this airport is the queues at immigration and security which is serious For instance immigration at arrival took minutes although there were only people in front of me and this was because only windows were open for processing

Free WiFi cleanliness and planning are good Queue for security and immigration took around minutes Should deploy more staff for this purposes Restaurants after check in are less and with no good choice

Older Dash but comfortable and good leg room but very noisy Departed on time friendly sole flight attendant juice and water on offer and great views of the Atolls they were organised friendly and have pride in their brand and country cant ask for more than that A bit pricey but no competition I guess

We were on a chartered flight taking a group of very special kids to Lourdes in France Team were so friendly and welcoming Lovely comfy accommodation clean and spacious Lovely touch was a special package snack for our VIPs Thank you Titan
This airport is small Traffic is quite convenient and the number of stores is small The airport is very clean and tidy and the waiter is polite

The airport is well laid out the gates are simply marked and the staff are extremely helpful There is an information desk to the left of the entrance which will direct you where you need to go Considering this was my first flight and after having a head injury they allowed my parents to go through security with me to guide me through the process Security was slower than I have come to realize is usual and very confusing however once on the other side there were many shopping options and also a great deal of eating options There was suitable seating and the boards with times of departures were readily available The bathrooms were a little messy however

SINNARSapporoNARSIN trips for last two years Sapporo NewChitose impressed me Comfortable massage chairs located around airport dining options fair but still better than others small and somewhat ageing but still cosy Checkin fast for domestic Glad to go there again
The plane was modern and the cabin very clean and appealing The crew was very friendly and professional Fast check in and at Belgrade Airport the suitcases arrived very fast
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

Small airport with helpful staff In the arrivals hall there is nothing special On departure you can enjoy your time on the st floor snacks bar with some good choices The view to the apron is good from the departure hall The only negative side is that the air conditioning system is not good at all

Cochin International Airport is a beautiful environment friendly and comfortable airport From the infrastructure to the furniture the process the staff everything about this airport exudes comfort and positive vibes The airport is powered by solar panels wooden interiors and well functioning toilet fittings and fixtures make this airport an environment friendly one
I have went with Novair four times OSLLPA x OSLTFS OSLFUE Great service good looking planes comfortable seats No delays new clean A The only less good thing the food

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

Dundee Airport provides a convenient link direct to London City Birmingham Belfast The airport is small and there are no shops There is a Costa coffee stall and the airport terminal is modern and comfortable I would recommend flying from Dundee Air France now provide the Dundee to London City route and Fly Woosh the Birmingham Belfast services My only gripe lies with the airlines themselves who do not seem to realise that if they lowered their weekend prices they could cash in on a lucrative leisure market which is put off by the high prices Dundee to London route is only worthwhile for leisure if booked way in advance and you can fly out with peak periods
Not Verified Courteous and friendly staff Flight left early by about minutes when it was confirmed all planning to fly were on board Crew was great Seating was great

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

Worst service I have ever seen in my entire life Had to wait for hrs at the carousel for my baggage to arrive Im told workers were slacking off and didnt see my bags until a senior officer had come to get the baggage moving Unfriendly staff who dont even wish to communicate with passengers unless you incorrectly use an aircrew term where they are most happy to correct you and then snigger about it and then once again act like youre nonexistent Well at least that informed me that they are not deaf but clearly ignoring me Porters in uniform are helpful and kindly directed me too Beware of Taxi drivers and ununiformed porters my baggage was forcibly snatched by one these to help me to the domestic flight departures

Great space Felt secure and secluded as a solo traveller Staff were great in a full cabin they were onto everything The wifi was dreadful though Food plentiful and tasty An hour and a half late leaving but with snow in UK thats hardly surprising

I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to the staff of Lost Found at the Venice airport At arrival at Venice Marco Polo airport my suitcase was lost The staff there was very helpful throughout the process in my application and delivery of my suitcase to my home address The luggage was delivered within hours So I was delighted with the service and want to give credit to staff and delivery Thank you

Munich to Kabul Privilege Style is flying this year old Boeing on behalf of other customers as a charter airline The flight was okay seats are comfortable enough and i felt safe throughout the journey

Being first time flyers with Rex we were delighted with the personal service at airports and in the air Assisted with booking in luggage and seating details Being tall enough leg room to be comfortable We would choose to fly rex whenever possible

I take Horizon often between Seattle and Portland after arriving from the UK and always find staff very helpful My last connection was late from LHR due to weather and holding separate tickets was a worry however Horizon staff did all they could to rush me through and I made the original connection Ground staff friendly and nice crew Flight down was operated by a CRJ its a quieter cabin and seems faster not sure it is though but the cabin feels smaller and return flight by Q was much more comfortable Cabin crew nice and you still get a free drinks service on a min shuttle great touch

Great little airport incredibly close in to the city centre minutes by metro from the Domestic Terminal to the central station and the international terminal is spacious with comfortable seating by the gates and good value shopping The only downside is the tedious minute bus transfer to get there from the Domestic Terminal

Although it is a regional airport it handles two international arrivals Seattle and San Francisco As I avoid YVR Immigration like a plague I spent over hours in one of my latest arrivals I prefer Victoria to get into Canada and then go to Vancouver You can take a taxi cab to the ferry terminal would not work on late flights though and be in Vancouver in less than hours enjoying one of the most scenic rides you will ever find in a ferry Immigration in YYJ is short and pleasant You get your bags in less than minutes usually and go through customs in less than Overall great airport to get to Canada Coming out is also simple and effective Short lines and great staff

Lots of good food and shops Amazing love piano playing and fun Wicked Weed food court However the reason Im writing is because this place is filthy I dont want to touch a surface I know theyre under construction but that doesnt account for counters and corners and floors that obviously havent been scrubbed in a long time Gross Embarrassing The survey asks if I would recommend this airport and my reply is mixed First off airport choice is pretty arbitrary as it just depends on where youre going and also some aspects are great The cleanliness however is terrible

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one

General Mitchell is a breath of a fresh air Its clean friendly and efficient Theres actually a classy little used book store and a museum full of model planes and blimps and whatnot If you get lost it is your fault my friend The whole place is like one of the models in the museum accurate well labeled and miniature Everything is right in front of you Theres an Amtrak station a block away minutes and to get to Union Station in Chicago is hard to beat This airport is tiny but its the easiest one Ive ever dealt with
I think it is a great airport compared to most Chinese airports Today Hangzhou Airport is quite different from what it used to be Its very large and modern and has good service

The seats in the Terminal waiting areas are very comfortable The security process looked ominous at first but I was constantly moving and when it came time for the scan I did not have to take off my belt or shoes and got through the security process comfortably I wish Portland Airport was like that

Very Crowded check in and long security lines However once past security it was a very clean and nice airport Not enough seats in the gate area however Just know where you are going and leave plenty of time before your flight

Its for T international arrivals Newly operated T pleasant experience no rush hardly min for immigration still under construction no eatingforex options within the terminal whatever available is outside the terminal Bag arrived on time hardly min to exit with baggage Clean toilets and facilities

I arrived at T Terminal Hongqiao Used the Sky Priority Customer Service Lovely helpful staff who helped me with my oversized baggage I was stressed about it and the team helped me without a problem Then even showed me clearly were to go as well as showing me were Sky Priority Lounge was I couldnt be more grateful for their good service

Uneventful flight with on time departure and arrival Usual Southwest nofrill service Clean aircraft and friendly flight crew In Flight Entertainment was easy to log on and watch live TV NFL football Unusual for this particular aircraft the overhead cabins were not as large as other aircraft

My son and I flew them in June from Copenhagen to Podgorica It was an older F aircraft but quite comfortable In fact we commented on how far the seats reclined The flight attendants were nice and the cockpit crew did a nice job getting us there safely We departed on time and arrived on time No complaints

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule

Impressed Booked a domestic hop at last minute Much cheaper than its competitors Had my flight cancelled from LGW to HAN earlier this month I expected the airline to be unreliablelate how very wrong I was Everything was faultless check in was smooth boarding and departure on time crew very courteous and polite Arrived safely and out of the airport in less than min Overall given a chance Bamboo would be my airline of choice while travelling around Asia

Toulon to Paris Orly Aircraft on time and clean Good service in flight pleasant staff on departure inflight and on arrival We had to leave bags at plane entry gate and we fetched them at plane exit gate in Paris The aircraft is useful for small flights but is a little small for passengers Flight entertainment would have been appreciated domestic flights in another countries have in flight entertainment even for hr flights

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

Flew to Dublin yesterday th October after catching train from Preston where I had been working for a few days to Squires Gate which is about a minute walk ADF was a bit of a disappointment but checkin and security a breeze Staff friendly and efficient Depatures lounge was a bit oldfashioned not necessarily a bad thing quite nostalgic really but was very clean and the cafe was good Aer Lingus as always a joy to travel with

Flew in and out of Rio Galeao airport in October Terminal was quite clean and quiet and quite a lot of shops but not too many which is neat The walking was a lot though and there were no conveyor belts to speed from the security to my gate all the way at the other end of the airport This is one of two points that could be improved The other one is is that some employes doing reaserch and statistics about client satisfaction were walking aroud the gates to get info No problem there But there are far too many I got interupted almost every minutes and I think that the airport cancould relax on that An otherwise great airport

I flew with my husband from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo to see the pyramids and Egyptian Museum with a return flight to Sharm three days later The flight took off on time the cabin crew were friendly and the seats were comfortable Unfortunately my husband was taken ill in Cairo and I decided we needed to return to the UK I cancelled our return flight on the morning we were due to fly back to Sharm The money was in my bank two days later I would fly Air Cairo again

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him

First time the flight left on time and even earlier for the first time in years I thought we were going to be landing way in advance Unfortunately we were then in a holding pattern in Bangkok for mins You win some you loose some It was a ten year old Boeing The first meal service was lovely the breakfast was poor I didnt eat that The recline on my seat was broke which isnt a deal breaker for me anyway Crew were great I still think they can improve but the convenience is the key with a direct flight

Small regional airport With just two terminals it is pretty painless to navigate Lines at the security checkpoint move fast I was told that a contractor operates the checkpoints In my experience staff was friendly and two or more lanes were open Some restrooms in the secure area were closed off due to renovations in progress Concessions were limited but there is a McDonalds a Subway a news store and a coffee outfit Because its a regional airport many code share flights are operated by smaller airlines flying commuter aircraft If youre not a fan of turboprop aircraft avoid Piedmont Air operating as US Air Express on DHC planes
TFNGMZ return on ATR Very good minute flights Served cup of water and chocolate bar Great views of a snow capped Mt Teide on left going and right returning

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

Not that much leg room If you are over cm tall you will be bashing your kneecaps but otherwise the seat is pretty comfortable The services from the cabin crew were friendly and efficient Due to Covid restrictions no snack was served on this flight There is no screen in the seats so you must supply your own inflight entertainment Would definitely use the airline again as their routes are handy and they were punctual

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

We flew EasyFly from Medellin EOH to Pereira When we checked in online we discovered theyd moved the flight minutes later This wasnt a problem for us and we checked in online without problem Check in at the airport was quick and we had no issues with bags one was slightly over kg one was under and we didnt get charged The flight was on time and upon arrival in PEI the bags were on the belt immediately The plane was clean and seemed fairly new It was impossible to buy a ticket from the US with a US credit card on their website however we were finally able to buy a ticket online using a Colombian travel agency Aviatur We had no problems and were pleased we chose EasyFly

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is

We flew to Cairo from our Sharm elSheikh resort as many others did in order to tour the capital city of Egypt The aircraft was very comfortable and seemed quite new They offer great catering for the one hour flight Couldnt fault it

This was my first flight with Starlux and was most impressed Checkin was quick and easy The plane is new quiet spacious and spotlessly clean featuring a large screen with many entertainment choices The flight left a few minutes late from Terminal One which was recently renovated and quite comfortable The onboard service was caring and professional My two oriental veg meals were somewhat bland but were generous and wellprepared

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date
