What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal
Lisbon to Salvador Bahia Flight plastic free The first one I have travelled with And they had Ipads to comfortable watch what we preferred The distance between the chairs was large

The more I travel the more I appreciate Port Moresbys Jacksons International Airport Whilst the speed at checkin is dependent on the systems sometimes it takes longer but usually its quite fast its always a breeze moving through this terminal from checkin to security to immigration and into the departure lounge The lounge itself has great seating with good food options and drink options as well as shopping POM isnt Changi but then again Changi is matchless
Comfortable enough flight which was fairly on time We were surprised that there was no catering on this flight of about hours Only took hand baggage

This is a fairly good airport Nice and clean easy to get around This airport is also very small and therefore has less wait time thus you can probably get away with arriving only hour prior to departure and still make your flight On the other hand there is not very many options to eat or shop

Worst service I have ever seen in my entire life Had to wait for hrs at the carousel for my baggage to arrive Im told workers were slacking off and didnt see my bags until a senior officer had come to get the baggage moving Unfriendly staff who dont even wish to communicate with passengers unless you incorrectly use an aircrew term where they are most happy to correct you and then snigger about it and then once again act like youre nonexistent Well at least that informed me that they are not deaf but clearly ignoring me Porters in uniform are helpful and kindly directed me too Beware of Taxi drivers and ununiformed porters my baggage was forcibly snatched by one these to help me to the domestic flight departures

Super small airport and wonderful if you are meeting someone from Hamilton Car rentals from site were out of cars and were no help Cost bucks to take cab from airport to in town car rental agency Tim Hortons only outlet in airport on arrival side or vending machines Flying with Flair and can only get tickets printed and drop off suitcases two hours before flight What we thought we were saving to get to a Blue Jays game in Toronto cost us more by flying to this back wood airport than what it would have been to fly WestJet to Toronto Never again will stick with West Jet friendly and helpful and reliable And the Blue Jays lost which made the trip even more horrible

I would just like to convey my sincere thanks to Shaye Qantas Broome I flew from Perth to Broome on the th June QF my luggage flew from Perth to Karratha due to an airport error in Perth The Qantas staff were very understaffed my luggage ended up on the wrong flight When I got to Broome I realised the mistake contacted Shaye whilst she herself was understaffed extremely busy she found time to organise to have my luggage located sent back to Perth then flown to Broome by am next morning If all airline staff were as conscientious genuinely caring as Shaye then the airline industry would have much greater respect from its customers

Munich to Kabul Privilege Style is flying this year old Boeing on behalf of other customers as a charter airline The flight was okay seats are comfortable enough and i felt safe throughout the journey

The new Terminal C is a significant improvement over the old Delta terminal This is a spacious terminal with plenty of light from the floor to ceiling windows giving views of the airport runwaysaprons and CitiField and Arthur Ashe Stadium The walk from gate to gate was rather long Restrooms are plentiful and clean however in some locations they could use more stalls given the number of passengers who traverse this terminal Dining options are placed conveniently I had a delicious lunch at one of the restaurants The airport WiFi is very fast and worked flawlessly

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

Absolutely love this airport Easy in and easy out Not jammed with people like the zoo at MCO Orlando Adequate places to get something quick to eat and comfortable seats to wait Only min from our place in Oviedo I just wish more domestic carriers other than just Allgiant flew into SFB Maybe international travelers dont care for it because its not a large airport but its great for us and I do recommend it

Pros Very good interiors and wellmaintained seats cleanliness lighting Ample space available between knee and seat in front of you Wellmannered and clear language English and Hindi speaking crew led by Ms Unnati Didnt have food nor used washroom so cannot comment on that Journey was comfortable and no bumpy rides encountered Communication from cockpit was also clear everytime Cons Boarding was not done in zoneseat number wise Quite some mosquitoes seen before take off which bit me and some passengers Crew applied some spray but wasnt enough Pricing was a big letdown as huge increase seen while booking on Feb for my journey date of Feb in a short span of time Slight delay in takeoff after closing of doors

Its a pleasure to travel with Cyprus airways They are so kind and really try to help The staff in Dubai is super friendly and playful with my daughter Im a nervous flyer and I always feel at ease when travelling with Cyprus airways
Everything was very good We used the lounge in the airport The services were great

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

Miami to Brussels On this Boeing plane Jetairfly has a separate cabin called comfort class and I was able to book seats there for an extra fee Only seats in this cabin with FAs doing a great job Seats configuration in xx while regular economy is xx Legroom was very good After take off we were offered Champagne followed by a hot meal together with wine coffee and digestif Before landing breakfast was served I would recommend this airline if you can get seats in this cabin

Atyrau to Uralsk I had a few meetings to attend in Uralsk and Aksai and was not looking forward to the hour or more arduous taxi journey from Atyrau to Uralsk in C heat I was recommend to use Qazaq Air as they now have a direct flight from Atyrau to Uralsk I booked a return flight online selected a seat paid via card and my eticket was immediately emailed On arrival to the airport checkin is simple and efficient The flight was serviced by a Bombardier Dash Next Gen aircraft which was very clean and the aircrew well dressed and welcoming The flight h m was very good with a surprisingly powerful takeoff and flight landing mins earlier than scheduled I certainly was impressed with the overall service and the value for money I will be using Qazaq air again for direct flights around west Kazakhstan

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Liked the airport of Edmonton Very efficient security and no big walking distances A nice bright design that make you feel comfortable Besides there are a lot of shopping and dining options here This Airport can be a role model how regional midsize airports should be

Small airport which was about minutes on bus to the city center Facilities was good and clean Baggage claim was fast and thoughtful as at many other Japanese airports Signs and directions were also clearly noted in English

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised
Nice small friendly airport Good transport links to the city by bus which meets flights and plenty of taxis A few shops and cafes and very clean facilities

Very good facilities as there are plenty of shops and restaurants Great transport connection particularly as the JR station is just at the basement However capacity at the international terminal seems to be pretty constrained There can be very very long queues at both checkin and security when a few flights depart at around the same time

Aircraft clean with immaculately presented and polite cabin attendants Seat comfortable with great leg room Flights on time Inflight entertainment consisted of North Korean military type music Food was a cold burger with a choice of water coffee tea or soft drink

The airport is new and clean however it is already overstretched For departures there are only a couple of snack bars and small shops in the departure area and for an international departure theres only one cafe Although your plane may be parked at a jetbridge you may not board from the jetbridge but rather have to go outside and use stairs Alternatively you may board at gate but then walk in the arrival corridor to the jetbridge at gate Check in and security were easy and fast At arrivals the tourist information office was closed There is no area for rental car return you will have to go in to the building to tell them you have returned Signage on the roads to the airport is not very good and it is tricky to reach the airport from any direction other than downtown There is construction at the airport entrance and perhaps that will address this issue The airport makes a good arrival spot for the Eje Cafetero Arriving with Easy Fly our bags arrived almost instantly

A great little regional airport located right on the edge of the coast whose baggage reclaim passport control and lounge are all currently being refurbished and expanded The airport is clean and tidy and has a delightful caferestaurant downstairs before security as well as a great little shop selling local artisan products Check in can be slow as there are no selfservice checkin facilities Note that once you go past security facilities are currently fairly scant small bar area and no shops

Hassle free check in is something unheard of at this Airport Not even a professional customer friendly staff in the check in counter Staff treat passengers as some kind of nuisance to their work they prefer to gossip between themselves rather than clearing passengers in the queue

Beijing to Weihai with Shandong Airlines Comfortable clean and modern plane with ample leg room far more generous than Etihad and the other premium airlines I have experienced Some delay due to air traffic congestion however bags promptly delivered on arrival Water provided by friendly and attentive crew for the short flight

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

Great medium sized airport Travel fairly frequent from Hannover mainly from Terminal B to the UK The three terminals are very similar Good city centre connection with SBahn Fast checkin to gate usually same for arrival to out of door

It is a mediumsize International airport located in the city easy to arrive Served with all the big airlines companies in Brazil and also Surinam Airways TAP Portugal and flights to Miami and Fort Lauderdale by LATAM and AZUL The terminal is clean and offers lots of options for shopping and food The departure lounge could be bigger Sometimes it is filled of people and the seats are not enough The staff are good and prepared

My first experience with Malm Aviation flying from StockholmBromma to Malm Cheap fares friendly cabin crew comfortable aircraft free meal and coffee on that domestic flight Do you recognize SAS Youre right it isnt SAS It is Malm Aviation

Flew Monarch from Alicante to Gatwick on the ZB on the th May on board A GZBAK Seated in row seats were very comfortable and leg room generous Cabin crew really helpful and also very cheerful Flight left on time and also arrived promptly despite a missed approach initially into LGW Overall a great flight experience and far more superior product to some of the other UK based low cost and charter airlines My only criticism and something I was not happy with was that Monarch do not appear to apply a crew rule in the cockpit at all times

Hong Kong to Bangkok and my first time with Orient Thai Airlines and I am very satisfied with both the price and service Orient Thai was cheaper than Air Asia and the Boeing was very spacious with comfortable seats Also they served breakfast airline meal with drinks that tasted ok

My boyfriend and I booked the basic fare from Hamburg to Rome Fiumicino I didnt expect much because Germanwings is a low cost airline but it was great The staff were friendly when boarding was completed the pilot welcomed us all on board and although we had just booked the basic fare the stewardess gave us drinks for free Departed and arrived on time The first time I was in Rome I waited nearly minutes for my bag but this time they were really fast Would recommend flying with Germanwings

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

I was very nervous as was flying on my own for the first time and with my young child All staff were very helpful from the minute we walked into the airport The lady who booked us in was so considerate When we got on to the plane we were met by Joanie she was so welcoming and involved Samuel straight away Joanie then went above and beyond during the flight to make sure we were ok and to help me keep Samuel occupied She was so kind and thoughtful and was very complementary about his behaviour To absolutely blow us away she let us meet Johnathan and Catherine I hope I have names right this made Samuels day He couldnt stop smiling Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to them all what a super team I will definitely be using Loganair again

I flew Skymark Airlines from Kobe to Tokyo Haneda on August th and I must say that I was pretty impressed by the quality of the airline They do not provide any food but service is good I had too much luggage and they only charged me for the extra kilos I had checked Seats are very comfortable and legroom is better than most international airlines I guess its at least inches maybe Nice flight and on time I will fly Skymark Airlines again in the future when I return to Japan

I flew Motor Sich this past July from Kyiv to Odesa and it was a great experience It was on one of their AN s and to my surprise the seats were the most comfortable economy seats I have flown not to mention the most room Also when checking in my bag was a few kilos overweight and they let me check it with no extra charge Would definitely fly Motor Sich again

First time the flight left on time and even earlier for the first time in years I thought we were going to be landing way in advance Unfortunately we were then in a holding pattern in Bangkok for mins You win some you loose some It was a ten year old Boeing The first meal service was lovely the breakfast was poor I didnt eat that The recline on my seat was broke which isnt a deal breaker for me anyway Crew were great I still think they can improve but the convenience is the key with a direct flight

Cleanliness of Terminal toilets and food section must be improved Toilets seems to be unattended for ages floor is full of tissues and stains Bins are full Food court tables and chairs are under the same condition which is quite surprising as per Japan standard Air Conditioning is not cool enough seats at he waiting area are also not enough However I still love to come back to visit Japan again

For a small town scale Manado airport is pretty good Has several places for check in Several lounges equipped with internet access and good food The lounge area is quite spacious and has good service from Avsec This airport is set as the transit airport for Raja Ampat another greatest diving spot in indonesia located in Papua and also has an international direct flight like Singapore etc

Used to be very busy in the Soviet times since then reduced the traffic by at least At the same time the new terminal was built with more adequate waiting spaces It is rather modern and clean Food service is kind of slow Public transportation to the city is not on top and I used parknfly only once

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

We flew to Cairo from our Sharm elSheikh resort as many others did in order to tour the capital city of Egypt The aircraft was very comfortable and seemed quite new They offer great catering for the one hour flight Couldnt fault it

Shanghai to Tehran return July Direct flight to Tehran Economy class Aircraft A Fare was quite good Checkin fast Cabin crew showed Iranian hospitality No individual inflight entertainment but fairly speaking since the flight was at night One toilet closed for whole trip the other two were not clean and almost out of tissue Food was enough and fine for me Many drink options Flying time was less than hours on my way to Tehran and less than on the way back to Shanghai Considering all the above I will certainly choose this airline next time for my trip to Tehran

This review is limited to Terminal This terminal is very convenient as all of Southwests gates are in one location which means connection times of minutes is more than enough to catch connecting flight As I had a very short layover I did not access WiFi The terminal was crowded midmorning but theres plenty of seating The bathrooms are very clean

Had a missing baggage when landing at Victoria Falls Airlinks staff was very helpful in tracing and rerouting this baggage to Nairobi where I was when they traced the baggage Awesome customer experience

The airport is huge with clear signage direction and information It is well connected to the public transportation such as bus taxi Grab and the airport rail link leading to Phaya Thai Immigration is fast and convenient All nationalities are now using the auto gate for immigration at Departure Shopping and dining experience is quite nice with great choices of duty free items More greens might be needed to make the airport more ecofriendly I would suggest

A small airport maybe or passengers a day I am guessing Fifteen flights a day AA to CLT and DFW DL to ATL And UA to DEN and IAH The plusses Fast From drop off to gate in maybe minutes max Friendly staff especially at TSA Small town helpfulness had a cell phone left on a plane returned to the check in desk before I got there to ask for lost and found Nice new departure hall and baggage claim Very airy with lots of light Low cost parking for friends picking me up The minuses The airfares They border on extortionate Many times cheaper to fly from MIA to Europe than to Shreveport And UA AA and DL always seem to have the exact same air fare The local chamber of commerce should work on that Concourses are dated Industrial carpeting remember that Looks like they have not been refreshed since the s Odd quirky amateur art and movie posters and house plants maybe a positive No discount carriers like Spirit Jet Blue Frontier or SWA No mainline jets just smallish regional planes

Uneventful flight with on time departure and arrival Usual Southwest nofrill service Clean aircraft and friendly flight crew In Flight Entertainment was easy to log on and watch live TV NFL football Unusual for this particular aircraft the overhead cabins were not as large as other aircraft

Pros The flight attendants were kind and helped us with the wifi for minutes Very helpful mindful and demure The food was great I was not expecting that Legroom was wonderful Me being m there was easily lots of legroom Theseat was hard IFE sucked and dirty floors

Pittsburgh International is a modern wellkept airport but it has been sad to its usage steadily decline over the last years or so The US Airways hub is no longer and the airport has had a difficult time with the transition Unfortunately this has meant plenty of vacant gates and ticket counters For the passenger PIT offers free wifi though the signal is really only active near the Skymall McDonalds right in the centre of the terminal Security lines are wellorganised While I was joining the line an employee suggested to a group of us that we use the special annex screening gate which had no waiting That was really good advice which had all of us through and into the secure area in no time Overall it is still a clean comfortable airport I just really miss the days when so many more people used it on a daily basis

Flight from Rome to Turin the plane was old but very clean the hostesses were all very friendly Its better than other low cost airlines because they let you bring both a trolley and a small handbag in the cabin while on other low cost such as Ryanair that isnt allowed

During the checkin we paid a lot for having a few kilos over the weight limit This was dissatisfying The takeoff and landing were on time Boarding the plane was easy because it was done based on groups Extremely skilled pilot who took off and landed very safely We barely felt anything when the plane touched the ground Seats were very comfortable and the AC was strong Meals were alright given the trips short time I liked the entertainment system but was disappointed to see the WIFI was only limited to it You cant use WhatsApp for example Overrall my experience with Iberia Express was very positive and I recommend this airlineaw for a budget flight

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

Arriving at this airport is a little strange as it seems to be full of men wearing leather jackets However departure is quite nice its never very busy but everyone who works there is friendly and the cafe does a good selection of food

I had two flights with Atlantic Airways Flight Bergen Faroe Islands and Faroe Islands to Copenhagen one week later Both flights on time Comfortable seats clean aircraft good food friendly service I will flight with Atlantic Airways again with pleasure

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

Bornholm to Copenhagen The flight on halfanhour was smooth and on time Very relaxed boarding and in the air you are offered coffeetea and a piece of chocolate by smiling crew Seats OK aircraft clean and announcements informal Danish as also often experienced on ofter Scandinavian carriers DAT now serve several routes inside Denmark and have always been ontime Tickets on this route however somewhat expensive compared to earlier days

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green

I had to cancel my travel plans from Dar Es Salaam to Arusha due to a medical emergency Coastal Aviation was very supportive understanding and efficient in processing my situation Much appreciated Great company

Our arrival was great No problems The airport was clean People were friendly Renting a car was a bit of a pain because it was in another building a long way to drag several bags When departing we arrived hours early but had to wait about minutes before checking our bags There were only people working one for frequent flyers and one for the rest of us The couple at the head of our line had a problem and it took minutes for the lady to get the problem worked out When we got in line there were people in line By the time we were being checked in there were people in line Again everything was clean and the people were very pleasant

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus

The flight was great However it could still improve Bring your own tablets as the IFE systems were kind of laggy and the choices were very limited The seats were quite hard and on my nd flight the seat recline was broken so I had to manually force it back to the original position The food was wonderful and so were the staff

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD
We flew from Toronto to Paris Flight attendants were very helpful and welcoming We especially appreciated Emersons help He was great Ground crew were great too
Flight attendants hospitality service careful consideration I hope the WiFi on airplanes will be better in the future Cabin clean and tidy It was an unforgettable journey

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you

This airport has terminals one for USA flights and one for non USA flights Not big airport Inside is very clean and staff are very helpful However there are long waiting times at immigration and customs Customs has no scanner machines so they have to open all bags for checks Needed almost hours to finish immigration and customs When departing it is very quick Inside the airport there are only a few shops

Nanjing to Hong Kong Nice airline good food Seat quality maybe not as nice as a Boeing Aircraft looked pretty clean flight crew was kind not a star airline but it must be a star The TV was not in such a good condition

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

This was a day Southwest Gourmet Tour of Tasmania The same aircraft stayed with us the entire time It was a great size and seemed very efficient All staff were very friendly and professional We were most impressed

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

We misplaced our passport which was very stressful However Ashley and Phil at the Canberra airport made sure that we still made it onto other flights back to New Zealand Their service was outstanding they were both so helpful nothing was a hassle which helped to alleviate a very stressful situation for us We cant thank them enough

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

Flying from Fayetteville to CLT on July The young man at AA was unfriendly like I never seen before Your ID put your bag take your bag were his only words No greeting no thank you no have a good flight I recently moved to Fayetteville for a job from New York Flying often Never flew from Fayetteville used Raleigh for that There was no soap in the restroom at am already Security was okay did not use thank you or please in their lexicon I will fly from Raleigh next time

I am grateful to the staff at DEL airport for the cooperation on th Jan Flt noVS I had a problem with my luggage as by mistake I had left a charger battery in my checked baggage One staff member helped me to a great extent to settle the issue The support given to me by her was exemplery

A small domestic airport in Taiwan Fast and friendly staff Surprisingly many shops Looked very clean Because this is a military airport too you can spot military aircraft taking off and land taking photos is forbidden though On time nonchaotic boarding and the plane took off in schedule Recommend

The onground experience was great very pleasant checkin experience the Adani lounge has a separate section for Vistara Frequent Fliers and Business Class which is quite nice The onboard experience is a bit soso the legroom in economy is fairly tight and feels less than Indigo They have cutdown on the quantity of food in meals visibly in economy class The IFE was good enough to keep oneself entertained and thankfully with the middle seat remaining empty the flight was quite comfortable

I was very excited to land here as this airport is famous around the globe for its risk landings The infrastrucure per se is very basic you deplane on the tarmac and then walk to the arrivals staff were ok I found people in the Madeira island to be very friendly Do not come without pre booked stuff as I noticed they inflate the prices for tourists who decided to book on the spot The airport is clean and security is fast long lines though Snacks on the land side much cheaper than air side
My budget airline fare turned out to be a complete surprise with full service and a fairly new A plane The service friendliness and cleanliness are no less than those of Singapore Airlines

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Berlin Tegel is a very unique airport both is positive and negative ways After arriving at Berlin Tegel and disembarking the aircraft we had to queue up on the jetbridge as the customs checkpoint was right after the jetbridge A very interesting concept Right after that was a small baggage carousel then out of the departures area This meant that there was basically no departures area We had to wait quite some time for our baggage When we returned to to the airport our checkin process was pretty smooth and the lounge was easily accessible There was a huge observation deck which spanned the roof of a terminal offering beautiful views of the runway and tarmac a good place to spend the time However you have to go through a small security check and buy a ticket before entering Every two gates had its own departure area with seats and its own security checkpoint This meant snaking queues into the public area each time a flight was boarding and it was hard to walk around with baggage because there was little space Inside the tiny departures area there was insufficient seating and insufficient space for the boarding queue Everyone was squeezed at the gate and there was absolutely no order or anything No queues set up

A great little regional airport located right on the edge of the coast whose baggage reclaim passport control and lounge are all currently being refurbished and expanded The airport is clean and tidy and has a delightful caferestaurant downstairs before security as well as a great little shop selling local artisan products Check in can be slow as there are no selfservice checkin facilities Note that once you go past security facilities are currently fairly scant small bar area and no shops

Bornholm to Copenhagen The flight on halfanhour was smooth and on time Very relaxed boarding and in the air you are offered coffeetea and a piece of chocolate by smiling crew Seats OK aircraft clean and announcements informal Danish as also often experienced on ofter Scandinavian carriers DAT now serve several routes inside Denmark and have always been ontime Tickets on this route however somewhat expensive compared to earlier days

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you
Mahon is clean light and airy with reasonable shopping facilities and bars the seating area is particularly good with a view of the airfield and runway and plenty of space

My first experience with Malm Aviation flying from StockholmBromma to Malm Cheap fares friendly cabin crew comfortable aircraft free meal and coffee on that domestic flight Do you recognize SAS Youre right it isnt SAS It is Malm Aviation

Pittsburgh International is a modern wellkept airport but it has been sad to its usage steadily decline over the last years or so The US Airways hub is no longer and the airport has had a difficult time with the transition Unfortunately this has meant plenty of vacant gates and ticket counters For the passenger PIT offers free wifi though the signal is really only active near the Skymall McDonalds right in the centre of the terminal Security lines are wellorganised While I was joining the line an employee suggested to a group of us that we use the special annex screening gate which had no waiting That was really good advice which had all of us through and into the secure area in no time Overall it is still a clean comfortable airport I just really miss the days when so many more people used it on a daily basis
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet
Both flights were on time friendly crew and there was an inflight service for this minutes flight Airplane was clean Due to short runway only passengers could board on departure from Kastellorizo

Great little airport Everything in one location baggage belts next to car hire desks and you walk out into the car park and collect your car Will be my preferred choice now rather than coming in via LAX or SAN and facing a hour drive
It is a shame that the people at security do not speak English This is an international airport For the rest it is okay food is good and it is reasonably clean

Kuala Namu International Airport is it is the second largest airport after SoekarnoHatta International Airport but the first airport which has a direct rail link to Medan city the capital of North Sumatra Kuala Namu is the most comfortable and the most modern airport in Indonesia

Berlin Tegel to Vienna On my short weekend trip to Vienna I ended up in a Niki aircraft although booked with Air Berlin You can see a small difference between Niki and its bigger sister for example the crew wear an pinkviolet uniform and probably the main difference being that Niki still gives the complementary drinks one hot and one cold and a little snack a vegetarian and a nonvegetarian option and it was like in the old days at Air Berlin The flight was of course on time The crew were very friendly the seat was very spacious I got one with extralegroom as a topbonus platinum A nice airline for a nice flight

The more I travel the more I appreciate Port Moresbys Jacksons International Airport Whilst the speed at checkin is dependent on the systems sometimes it takes longer but usually its quite fast its always a breeze moving through this terminal from checkin to security to immigration and into the departure lounge The lounge itself has great seating with good food options and drink options as well as shopping POM isnt Changi but then again Changi is matchless

I agree that it is a small tidy airport with close proximity to the city It is great that the tram is literally as you walk out the front doors with a frequent service to the city Bremen is such a great little city

Flew in from Baltimore on Southwest What a great little airport Easy to navigate spotless facilities fast wifi and good options for coffee and snacks A great alternative to Boston for access to Cape Cod

I could not believe this was the first time I had arrived and departed from Tokyo Haneda Airport When I first arrived immigration was straightforward and I was very impressed When I was leaving checkin was also pretty straightforward and the whole Terminal was massive with great lounges shops and food Plus I got to do plenty of plane spotting from lounges

A wonderful little airport So impressed While it was busy at the peak of the holiday season everything moved quickly and efficiently The shops airside while small have a great selection of Spanish specialties like olive oil I hope the new airport that opens next year keeps up the same high standards

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

Extremely friendly wheelchair assist personnel I am disabled and was being moved from gate to gate and since I had some layover time I decided that I would like to get a snack at one of the fast food shops The wheelchair assistant not only took me there but he helped me get my order as well The people everywhere were friendly Cleanliness wasnt top grade but adequate

Durban to Cape Town with Comair This is a hour flight which was full The business class seats were the same as economy but with a little extra legroom and the middle seat was empty The FAs were mature and friendly There was a full bar service and light lunch was served The aircraft was clean left on time and arrived on time A relatively smooth flight unlike BA they serve refreshments and full bar service on this short haul domestic flight

Love Ryanair efficiency Does what is says on the packet nothing pretentious Crew were great and even managed to go down with aisle with the trolley on a minute flight My th flight with them just wish they flew to Frankfurt theyd get all my euro business
Madrid to Toulouse Once again a punctual and comfortable flight Good legroom on time departure and arrival On flight entertainment was however not working you have to pay for anything on board

I arrived today from Heho with a sick child probably from food poisoning and was helped like I never thought I could We were taken charge of by a great team of officers nurse doctor that took us to the airport clinic and took care of my daughter Everyone has been great and we are really grateful to each of you They will recognize themselves
Great regional airport Min check in time for Lufthansa flights is mins Good connections via MUC to international destinations Reasonable amenities at the airport

This airport is so backward its unreal Today you get charged nearly three euros to get hot water for your own teabag You get charged ten euros development fee as you leave Same as Galway airport ten years ago six euros to get out again development fee now its shut Last time I flew from Knock the fee was the same Never went back because of the fee Now the place has hardly changed where did that money go Great idea to put an airport on top of a hill dont have to come down so far but hardly a great advert for Irish aviation or Mayo
A small but full service airport Doesnt have some of the amenities of larger airports but you would not expect them Clean Great service Short wait times Highly recommended

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

Sydney to Tianjin via Zhengzhou My wife and I could not have been happier with the flight service food and entertainment options provided Staff were great and went out of their way to help other guests We read a lot of reviews prior to our trip and can honestly say we did not experience negative factor Great choices on meals and entertainment pillows and blankets surprising amount of legroom in economy We are going back to China soon and dont see any reason to travel with another airline Great pricing and options for further exploration in China add to the airlines appeal

A great airport only one hour from New York City that is still a secret A major stop for SouthWest it is a welcome relief from the congestion at La Guardia or worse JFK Nice new buildings with convenient parking for locals or access to a train station with links to all of long island and NYC

Bennett at the TSA first check point was so incredibly sweet to our son and his attitude was great Im sure everyone that works for the TSA feels this way on the inside but he was clearly showing it to us on the outside Keeper

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Los Angeles to Cusco via Lima We were pleasantly surprised when Lan Airlines delivered our luggage hour from the airport the day after we landed American Airlines in the US didnt tell us sbout collecting our luggage in Lima before flying to Cusco must go through Customs so it never arrived in Cusco Lan Airlines Personnel were very helpful to fill the forms out and to deliver was unexpected Thanks for helping make our trip great

Shinchitose airport is really effective A lot of souvenir shops and wonderful musiam in the airport A brand new international terminal will be open in Great hotels and various amusement things are worth of expecting

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

Vnukovo Airport Waiting for baggage almost hour now and havent get it yet No extra infornation from airport officials In combination with absence of smoking rooms everything becomes socalled great Ill consider another airport the next time Though ceiling is ok

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

Needs a proper restaurant Toilets are not up to the hygiene standard and are very congested I am muslim and offer regular prayers but call is very loud need to maintain at comfortable listening Needs further variety of fast food international chains to have a quick meal

Great little airport somewhat bizzare security arrangements which seem to depend on who you are or who you are with but really clean and with a nice cafe and seating while you wait the far side of passport control Duty Free expensive and poor selection

After so many negative comments I believe a positive is in order Honolulu to Lanai check in a breeze courteous and friendly we paid per bag but now only Flight basically on time aircraft ATR quite comfortable after all flight is only minutes Flight attendants very friendly juice and water offered Bags delivered promptly Will fly them back to HNL and will only post if flight is any less enjoyable

La Paz Sucre in an exMexicana Ticketing process is manual and very slow beware and get your tickets before the airport We were handed a little snack bag as we boarded then served drinks on board a great way to provide good service on a short flight
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight
The set of counters of Cathay Dragon was a bit out of order since every counter was excessively full due to the great number of passengers Business Class and Marco Polo Club and Oneworld Members

I was very impressed by the level of care and support I received at the airport Having a severe reaction to an insect bite and no Antihistamine tablets with me The local team and Airport police went out of their way to help I wish I had noted their names they looked everywhere and obtained tablets for me while making sure I was comfortable and relaxed Thank you very much as the level of care and support at a busy airport was very welcome and impressive

We used Luxor airport both for internal flight to Cairo and international flight to UK On both occasions it was clean and airy with plenty of space to sit We were allowed to take our water with us so no problem in buying drinks Yes there was someone selling us toilet paper despite the notices saying this was not allowed but by then we knew their standard of living and if you cant spare the odd pound when we have spent so much on a holiday what does that say about us We were protected from harassment by helpers by our rep Altogether I thought using Luxor airport a pleasant experience

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

Yangon to Mandalay Lounge photo and In flight meal photo are added We can access Lounge at Yangon International Airport for all Business Class traveler variety of Breakfast Lounge is located at the rd floor of Yangon International Airport Terminal for domestic In flight meal is great but simple because it is just a hour short flight

It is not the most beautiful airport in the world but not the worst I always found it OK speed to checkin pass passport control is OK Shopping cheap and wide range of products VIP Lounge comfortable but old fashioned The information system is getting better and friendliness of officials is good

I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to the staff of Lost Found at the Venice airport At arrival at Venice Marco Polo airport my suitcase was lost The staff there was very helpful throughout the process in my application and delivery of my suitcase to my home address The luggage was delivered within hours So I was delighted with the service and want to give credit to staff and delivery Thank you
It was very great flying in Vistara today then any other Company I liked this because of several reasons like hospitality Seat comfort cabin staff service food Etc Keep it up

I had not heard of Air KBZ before I made the booking for my Myanmar trip However all of the three domestic flights Mandalay to Thandwe Thandwe to Sittwe and Sittwe to Yangon went very well ontime arrivals food and beverages free of charge although the flights were short friendly staff modern and clean aircraft I would fly Air KBZ again in case I return to Myanmar

Arriving into Landvetter was fine had to get a bus to the other side of the airport to go through immigration As I was on a nonschengen flight we had to go through immigration This part is quite small with European check desk and two noneu that are hidden in the corner and there are no signs to show that the noneu passport holder check is on the side Waited in the wrong queue for a few minutes till I had to ask and the immigration office put me right Immigration was quick with very friendly staff on arrival and departure Im the baggage reclaim you can see the bags come out from the conveyed overhead which is cool On departure airport queue times were quick with security very quick as well Gates has a small eating area with minimal seating and lack of plug sockets and as you have gone through immigration you cant leave this part Plenty of food and shopping options very modern clean airport that is nice to travel through

Cusco Airport is another wonderfully crowded and poorly designed airfield in Peru ie Lima Chiclayo Byzantine brutalist concrete architecture aside this airport is by far the worst designed for providing any kind of logical flow for a singlerunway airport serving a large metropolitan area It would seem that nobody in government has looked at what can be done with the cramped space and volume of passengers to try and make a more hospitable clean and userfriendly facility Unfortunately this airport will remain the sole thoroughfare for all international Machu Picchu travelers for the foreseeable future Maybe Peru can step up to the plate and make some major changes to this facility and take a field trip to Quito and check out their new airport which is very nice

Having stepped off an A a day before it was quite a strange experience to be one of just four passengers on the seater propeller ATR aircraft from Bangkok to Laos But the one hour and fiftyminute flight experience was lovely Following the traditional Sabaidee greeting from the friendly twoperson cabin crew we took off on time The elegantly uniformed flight attendant had a frangipani placed in her hair echoing the countrys national flower as well as it being in the airlines logo The x seating was comfortable with ample leg room Although a small airline it had an inflight magazine It was a sunny day and flying at around feet we had a clear view of the mountainous green scenery below A small snack box was offered which contained a tuna and cheese sandwich and drink and hot coffee was also served On arrival at Luang Prabang stepping out umbrellas were available just in case you found it too hot or if it was raining to walk to the terminal building The return flight was also on time this time with around or so passengers nearly all enjoying posing for photos by the aircraft

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

I flew Skymark Airlines from Kobe to Tokyo Haneda on August th and I must say that I was pretty impressed by the quality of the airline They do not provide any food but service is good I had too much luggage and they only charged me for the extra kilos I had checked Seats are very comfortable and legroom is better than most international airlines I guess its at least inches maybe Nice flight and on time I will fly Skymark Airlines again in the future when I return to Japan
UIA is always a great experience in businessclass Great service onboard Very lovely crew The lounges in KBP and MUC are also very relaxing Looking forward to flying UIA again
A small but friendly airport which is quite central The facilities are adequate for the size of the country It is clean and tidy and the staff are helpful

Its been years since I traveled through Terminal The refurbished Terminal is a world class modern airport terminal It is spacious brightly lit with plenty of seating and dining options aplenty There are oodles of power ports and USB ports at the gates however some of the power ports were not working Bathrooms are very clean The concourses are wide and directions easy to follow to baggage claim Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished terminal is a significant upgrade to the old terminal

Used this airline for an internal flight in China last October from Kunming to Lijiang and just had to take some photos etc but not a joke crisp new airline with latest Boeings smart logos etc Short flight but adequate English used and friendly crew

ARNHEL on the standard B Clean and airy cabin legroom fine for such a short hop Coffeetea served for free Courteous FAs gave out a stuffed toy for the baby in our party and took extra care explaining how the infants seatbelt worked Bags were on the belt in minutes at HEL

Arriving here is a potential nightmare especially at the weekends They are just not geared up to handle more than one jet the size of at a time Queues at passport control can stretch almost out to the tarmac and although very friendly and courteous they are so slow Baggage reclaim takes forever and it is just a scrum to try and get through customs On the last trip we were in a queue for customs clearance and the officer in charge of our line just disappeared We had to start all over again

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

This is a great airport us my wife and self We fly from it twice a year We have just returned from Lanzarote We had no problems at all until we arrived back at hrs mins late There was a full plane load of passengers and only Border Control Officers on duty We were stood in a snakelike queue for nearly half an hour in a room that was like a shed I think that Border Control can do a lot better and should be doing so After saying this we are flying from Doncaster again in Sept

Berlin to Paris Flight on time clean and modern plane It was impossible to buy any drinks due to an issue with their visa machine The crew was ok but they could smile a bit more At Orly airport we had to disembark by bus which took minutes to finally be at the south terminal
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Not bad

This was a day Southwest Gourmet Tour of Tasmania The same aircraft stayed with us the entire time It was a great size and seemed very efficient All staff were very friendly and professional We were most impressed

Dont understand all negative reviews yes you can not compare this airport to a modern European or US one but short lines friendly people despite unfriendly behaving tourists enough seating to wait Smooth entry into the country expect to enter a country that is years back in time and you will enjoy your trip

It is a mediumsize International airport located in the city easy to arrive Served with all the big airlines companies in Brazil and also Surinam Airways TAP Portugal and flights to Miami and Fort Lauderdale by LATAM and AZUL The terminal is clean and offers lots of options for shopping and food The departure lounge could be bigger Sometimes it is filled of people and the seats are not enough The staff are good and prepared

HELLPA return with A Booked flights months earlier and reservation for exit seats for extra charge from their call center was kept at check in Generous legroom Friendly attentive crew flight deck announcements and clean aircraft made hrs flight more enjoyable for a leisure flight Also our pre booked Holiday Meal on outbound flight was surprisingly tasty and hot and portions were more filling than we have had for this route with other carriers Only minus was inbound flight meal which was bit tasteless perhaps due to LPA catering Drinks for purchase but all in all flight with them DK offered more holiday feeling than our national carriers charter flight offers Baggage came fast at LPA but in HEL it took more than min due to ground handling problems
Mediumsized modern airport clean and easy to navigate around Easy public transport to and from city centre

I flew from Blackpool airport to Belfast for the first time I always fly from Liverpool to Belfast with Easyjet but the flight times were better and it was slightly cheaper to fly with Jet from Blackpool I was expecting a small airport with limited facilities but nothing prepared me for the facilities here Parking is free which was a bonus for me when booking on arrival however both car parks P and P were full and ended up abandoning my car on a grass area known as an overfill car park This was a minute walk to the airport On arrival there was nothing before the departure lounge The cash machine was out of service and WHSmiths closed Paying the airport charge was no problem and I was assisted with my baggage tag by a very helpful Jet worker The worst experience was going through security where the staff were extremely rude not just with me but with an elderly couple in front of me I agree that security needs to be strict but not intrusive and this was made a much more uncomfortable experience by the rudeness and lack of customer service with the staff I will never be using this airport again and even after a drink from the limited choice in the cafebar I was still reeling I can safely say this is the st and last time I will use this airport

Aalborg Lufthavn AAL is a smallish airport near the city of Aalborg There is not usually a lot of people leaving or arriving at any one time so there is hardly ever any time wasted standing in line for checkin or security checks brilliant A very friendly and inviting atmosphere overall

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

Kaohsiung International Airport is great but small There are some shops and restaurants The biggest point is that the airport is clean quiet and efficient the directions are clear as well Besides this international airport are really near downtown Kaohsiung The subway system is partially done recently you can take the KMRT to any place in downtown

Domestic terminal is easy to use not much going on and no crowds or wait times It has sufficient seating capabilities but restaurant and shopping options are fairly limited But it serves its purpose is reasonably clean and convenient

Nice small low cost but very aged airport needs full reconstruction asap Everything looks like the s but not nice way The floor was dirty so they need to improve cleaning as well Restaurant was closed so there was nowhere to even get a coffee Staff were kind and helpful Will fly there again as FR and W operate nice cheap flights otherwise no chance will be back
The folks at Delta and Sky West were great They took great care of daughter and her room mate on their way home for spring break They made a special trip to get our bags at the Elko Airport

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE

Had a great flight from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines A brief winter maintenance delay ensured a safe departure and while we experienced mild turbulence leaving Philadelphia and again upon arrival in Washington the pilots handled it smoothly Due to the conditions inflight service was not possible but safety remained the priority The Main Cabin Extra seats made for a much more comfortable experience and with a flight time of under minutes we arrived quickly and safely Republic continues to deliver a reliable and professional service for the American Airlines group

Yangon to Thandwe and pleasantly surprised by Air KBZ Snacks served onboard seats generally comfortable Organisational issues with boarding and a slight delay in departure from Yangon Check in at RGN was not very organised however once inside the departure terminal ground staff were more helpful They give you a coloured sticker to put on your shirt to ensure you get on the correct flight Would use again

AZDMHD Aseman is one of the only airlines that provides domestic flights between Yazd and Mashad Tickets are cheap and service is ok There was a delay of hr which feels endless waiting at a small domestic airport Despite the delay the flight was comfortable on a Fokker aircraft Not much legroom but fine for a flight of about mins Some snacks were included and that was ok Friendly staff

Its for T international arrivals Newly operated T pleasant experience no rush hardly min for immigration still under construction no eatingforex options within the terminal whatever available is outside the terminal Bag arrived on time hardly min to exit with baggage Clean toilets and facilities
