At last a quiet clean and efficient airport Terminal F without the tiresome duty free The hourly Borispil Express train will drop you off near Terminal D and you need to catch a halfhourly shuttle bus to Terminal F mainly for LCC flights as its something like a m walk otherwise The number of flights is fairly small and seemingly mainly Ryanair Plenty of room to wait just a couple of refreshment options Straightforward passport control and security no queues Plenty of seats in the departure lounge easy access to gates good view of airport operations No duty free Hooray A couple of refreshment stands No air bridges but then LCCs dont use them anyway A very relaxing experience particularly in contrast to departing from a UK airport

Seat C A swift flight mainly with Sleep as it was an overnight flight Airplane was clean although the business class seating looked very old well worn arm buttons and seat capsule panelling The Bahrain Gulf Air lounge was a super treat with Dinner options such as Pizza and Lasagne all were very good I certainly look forward to booking my next Gulf Air flight

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options
The plane was modern and the cabin very clean and appealing The crew was very friendly and professional Fast check in and at Belgrade Airport the suitcases arrived very fast

Great little airport Everything in one location baggage belts next to car hire desks and you walk out into the car park and collect your car Will be my preferred choice now rather than coming in via LAX or SAN and facing a hour drive

PSP is a great little airport The s style terminal is fairly well designed but with the advent of security screening areas its a bit harder to negotiate Rental cars are right outside the door from the baggage carousels The weather is seldom a problem so flights stay pretty close to their schedules Parking is reasonably priced and convenient to the terminal

Gatwick to Monastir return We took off on time both ways the aircraft are dated but seat was comfortable Food going was fine but only a stale sandwich coming back Crew pleasant The toilets are a lot to be desired and we made sure that we used the airport facilities before boarding on the return flight
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll

I was stopped by the airport because i had a problem with my passport the bluebird staff did everything to help me get on the plane on time The staff ran with me to the place where they make you a new passport and the Security head took me in his car to the airplane they all did a great effort to let me fly to my destination and not cancel it Thank you guys

My boyfriend and I booked the basic fare from Hamburg to Rome Fiumicino I didnt expect much because Germanwings is a low cost airline but it was great The staff were friendly when boarding was completed the pilot welcomed us all on board and although we had just booked the basic fare the stewardess gave us drinks for free Departed and arrived on time The first time I was in Rome I waited nearly minutes for my bag but this time they were really fast Would recommend flying with Germanwings

Not Verified The new airport is much better than the old but the issue with taxis remains The military controls the airport and hence which taxis are used No meters and extortionate fares Better off walking minutes south on road outside arrivals right angle to airport terminal and pickup a bluebird or AA cab from there Clean and metered Pity the Government does not stop in and do something about this as it is a horrible welcome to what is otherwise a friendly and interesting city and region

Taoyuan International Airport provides a comfortable travel experience with modern and clean facilities and very friendly and professional staff However its worth mentioning that security and checkin queues do tend to be slightly longer during peak hours which may impact some travellers schedules It is hoped that there will be further improvements in the future to provide a smoother traffic experience

I was very nervous as was flying on my own for the first time and with my young child All staff were very helpful from the minute we walked into the airport The lady who booked us in was so considerate When we got on to the plane we were met by Joanie she was so welcoming and involved Samuel straight away Joanie then went above and beyond during the flight to make sure we were ok and to help me keep Samuel occupied She was so kind and thoughtful and was very complementary about his behaviour To absolutely blow us away she let us meet Johnathan and Catherine I hope I have names right this made Samuels day He couldnt stop smiling Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to them all what a super team I will definitely be using Loganair again

This airport has terminals one for USA flights and one for non USA flights Not big airport Inside is very clean and staff are very helpful However there are long waiting times at immigration and customs Customs has no scanner machines so they have to open all bags for checks Needed almost hours to finish immigration and customs When departing it is very quick Inside the airport there are only a few shops

Really small airport but everything went fine Fast check in and fast security check Theres only one coffee shop kuna for a cappuccino and kuna for water is a decent price People speak English and are friendly The WiFi works fine but you have to get the password from the personnel I asked a girl from the duty free shop Taking points away only because the WiFi password is not available somewhere and you have to ask and there are no nice seating areas

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

A small domestic airport in Taiwan Fast and friendly staff Surprisingly many shops Looked very clean Because this is a military airport too you can spot military aircraft taking off and land taking photos is forbidden though On time nonchaotic boarding and the plane took off in schedule Recommend

Shinchitose airport is really effective A lot of souvenir shops and wonderful musiam in the airport A brand new international terminal will be open in Great hotels and various amusement things are worth of expecting

I read a huge amount of negativity about this airport prior to my trip there it was a five hour transit stop going from London to Bangkok I was certainly concerned reading all the previous reviews However I didnt experience any real issues The airport is very large so easy to find a quiet spot there are plenty of power outlets and getting online is extremely simple you just log on and take a pic of your passport Granted you wont be able to do very much online unless youve got one of the VPNs that work behind the great China firewall but if you have an iPad with a couple of movies downloaded the time will soon pass There was a reasonable amount of shops open both for coffee and souvenir shopping The train that youll need to take to get to your gate is frequent clean and fast Overall Ive been to more interesting airports but my message would be dont stress out reading the negative reviews I had no issues whatsoever

This June we booked on La Compangnie Newark to Paris return Our flight over was cancelled hours before departure We had firm bookings on a flight Paris to London La Compagnie offered us a later flight instead of Paris to Nice Of course we could not make our Paris to London connection We dropped that and waited until the next morning flying directly to London from Nice We incurred an extra nights stay in Nice taxi rides a lost ticket from Paris to London lost return flight when you dont show for the first flight you lose the return and a lost night in our London hotel adding up to over a thousand dollars in extra costs At the end of our stay in England and Paris we were told that our flight from Paris to Newark was also cancelled If we arrived at am at Orly we would be put on the morning flight instead of the more comfortable afternoon departure Flights for people both cancelled and we are repeat customers The check in people at La Compangie said the company would meet us they did not would reimburse us if we showed receipts they did not After multiple attempts to contact anyone by phone and waiting for weeks they more or less told us too bad we owe you nothing Unless you are willing to see your flight changed with very little notice and you have a great deal of flexibility or insurance at the other end do not fly this amateur operation

The food wasnt that great and theres no inflight entertainment but we were comfortable and had our iPods With regards to the cleanliness of the aircraft weve been on worse We found the cabin crew to be friendly their English is not great and they all had smiles I think if you expect high standards from a star airline youre bound to come home and write negative reviews Overall we were happy with what we got

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

Boarded by airbridge on an AN with very good condition crew was very friendly Legroom was plenty and seat was very comfortable We departed on time Soon after departure they offer free coffee and water and buy food from a menu Captain made announcements of the flight path We had a great experience with them

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place

Hong Kong to Hanoi Regional flight Hong Kong toHanoi January on an A aircraft Ticket included free services and luggage Hot meal given was OK Flight full on time Nice clean aircraft Seats were good but space to front seat was horrible and extremely tiny small de facto painful to knees CheckIn in Hong Kong was quick and easy though my handluggage was double the limit Checked in luggage arrived smoothly checked by customs in Hong Kong who had left a note inside the bag Airbridge provided at both ends

Pretty much the only option between the islands around St Maarten and Winair knows that so their proces are high We paid each for two times twelve minutes of flying Having said that it is real fun to fly their Twin Otter out of Saba with the shortest runway on earth and than landing at the rollercoaster runway at Saint Barthlemy The move our departure time one hour forward Sabas tiny airport is more like a bus stop and the plan cans land with too much wind so its always unsure Taking off is spectacular since the engines are pushed to their limits before being catapulted on the runway The plane doesnt give you any personal space there is no service of any kind but the view is great Since the same plane took us form SXM tot SBH we could stay inside and repeated the whole thing Flying Winair between the Caribbean islands is part of the experience so dont skip it

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

Nanjing to Hong Kong Nice airline good food Seat quality maybe not as nice as a Boeing Aircraft looked pretty clean flight crew was kind not a star airline but it must be a star The TV was not in such a good condition

VnukovoIrkutsk An eventful and enjoyable flight Everything went smoothly Vnukovo is the closest airport to the city centre and it has also a convenient train connection the train departs from the Kievsky train station This helps to avoid the usual heavy traffic of Moscow UTair uses a new terminal A which is quite handy It is likely that UTair is the only airline which uses a widebody B on this route and the plane seems to be a relatively new and wellmaintained one Friendly flight attendants the flight was ontime onboard catering is not superb but it was OK Would fly them again

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food
Mediumsized modern airport clean and easy to navigate around Easy public transport to and from city centre

The seats in the Terminal waiting areas are very comfortable The security process looked ominous at first but I was constantly moving and when it came time for the scan I did not have to take off my belt or shoes and got through the security process comfortably I wish Portland Airport was like that
Havana Cayo Coco return A one hour flight with an old ATR turboprop Seats surprisingly comfortable and we were offered a free drink plus candy onboard Nothing special but we arrived on time

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

Tiny but well kept airport different design not too many flights but departure lounge seemed chaotic Immigration is friendly but takes a long time a few shops you need to pay attention to the counters to find out where youre going to checkin Overall experience fair

This is a small airport but the new passenger terminal is great Fast service helpful people and clean This is a good alternative of Brussels airport We like it and for sure if possible we will try again

Considering the standard for Brazilian Airports the Capitals is very modern Good options for shopping and eating and even some cinema theaters As it is one of the hubs of the country the traffic in intense most of the time There is a lack of good transportation options for the city There is no subway station the buses are rare and uncomfortable and the taxis are quite expensive

Naples to New York JFK I flew this airline with caution after the reviews but I was pleasantly surprised One way with Meridiana for was the cheapest flight offered by any airline We got a free checked bag which was nice especially after my experiences with other cheap airlines The flight itself was also nice We flew economy and I felt like I had sufficient room and comfortable seats that retracted It was a ten hour flight and they fed us twice both appetizing meals I would definitely recommend this flight especially for the price

Small airport yet very efficient Dont come too early as there is not much to do Queuing is almost nonexistent staff checkin and security are very friendly There is a restaurant with view on the tarmac and a small airport shop before the security Arrival is very fast to minutes including bagage reclaim There is a bus stop right before the terminal taking you to AntwerpenBerchem train station a major train station with fast connection to Brussels or anywhere in Belgium Very close to the city center Highly recomended for users who like fast airports

The flight was about one hour and yet the flight attendants managed to hand out refresher towels then they gave each passenger a snack box and on the the third service round each passenger was given a drink All this was done unhurried with poise and a smile Such an unexpected level of star service In addition boarding was ontime flight departed and arrived on time What a great airline

Because LH flights from FDHCGN are now to FRA only and at inconvenient times followed by connections to CGN by train I elected to fly InterSky instead Very clean aircraft and professional service throughout But for an Economy one way ticket price of they could surely provide at least a free cup of coffee Poor value everything else fine

A short flight with this airline on behalf of Swiss Plane was all clean and modern and had USB outlets Staff was friendly and professional Food and beverages were buy on board unfortunately but a bottle of water and a chocolate were complementary All in all a rather uneventful flight but good and professional as it should be

Small minimal facilities not much to do while you wait Staff are friendly and efficient The day we arrived there was live music playing in the customs area nice touch We walked out of the terminal to be greeted immediately by our tour arranger

Toronto City Center while dwarfed in size by nearby Toronto Pearson Airport provides an exceptional experience for travelers Most notable is the terminal cafeteria stocked with free coffee soft drinks and light snacks In an era where nothing seems to be given out for free in air travel it is refreshing to see this at City Center The terminal is designed differently than those at most other airports As opposed to separate waiting areas for each gate there is one central waiting area which serves every gate the airport has gates At first glance the sight is a bit jarring but travelers will feel at ease as they settle in to the comfortable seats with their free snacks City Center is also recommended because of its location Views from within the airport and during approaches are beautiful as the airport is situated over water Lake Ontario Meanwhile the airport is very close to downtown Toronto making transport to and from the airport quick and cheap

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice

Guayaquil Airport is modern and clean but if you arrive on a domestic flight there is no transit You need to go out and do checkin and security Arrivals can be crowded and staff are not that friendly The one smile that I got was from the girl selling chocolates at the store inside
UIA is always a great experience in businessclass Great service onboard Very lovely crew The lounges in KBP and MUC are also very relaxing Looking forward to flying UIA again

Hamad International Airport is nice brand new airport Very spacious and clean Good wifi line and plenty of free desktop for internet Seats are everywhere and they are comfortable Charging points are available throughout this airport Many choices for food and shopping However I find that the price is rather high
Taipei Hualein TaiChung Both flights by ATR cabin was clean and comfortable Very friendly crew Drinks service on both flights

Note that the airport departure tax is SP for over s All taxis from airport are run by private company and are fixed rate The cost is around All previous comments re chaos at departure excessive zeal by document checking officials overcrowding etc are still as relevant as ever A thoroughly depressing experience in what is a friendly generous and wonderful country

MSP Airport does a great job with stores and restaurant options and recently completed some moderate improvements in aesthetics to terminal They currently offer a total of electric parking spots which are spread out across sites It appears the planning team completely overlooked this aspect of the customer experience

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Love Ryanair efficiency Does what is says on the packet nothing pretentious Crew were great and even managed to go down with aisle with the trolley on a minute flight My th flight with them just wish they flew to Frankfurt theyd get all my euro business

Arrived on the last evening flight from Barcelona tourist desk very helpful and received our luggage within minutes No taxis available so took the airport bus driver was very helpful and even dropped us a short distance from our hotel

I was very excited to land here as this airport is famous around the globe for its risk landings The infrastrucure per se is very basic you deplane on the tarmac and then walk to the arrivals staff were ok I found people in the Madeira island to be very friendly Do not come without pre booked stuff as I noticed they inflate the prices for tourists who decided to book on the spot The airport is clean and security is fast long lines though Snacks on the land side much cheaper than air side

Traveled to Haikou from this airport as there were no flights from Macau to Haikou It is a fairly large airport with a small aviation museum in the departures hall However the airport was a bit old and wasnt very clean Overall it was quite a good airport with interesting activities to pass the time
Friendly and fast service Enough toilets seats and bins But shops close early and have a extremely poor selection in duty free If you want anything make sure you get it before coming to the airport

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport

Checkin would not accept passengers until hours before the flight despite the monitors advising us to do so Check in person was blunt and almost rude not acceptable we are the customers It isnt my fault she was talking quietly and I had to ask her to repeat every time Then security they take possession of my backpack and without comment put it on a unit away from me and left it there A couple of minutes later another security man came along and started swabbing the bag because I had lots of camera equipment inside The toilets in departures need a good refurbishment Otherwise a great little airport modern clean with duty free and so on

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use
Needed a wheel chair because of an injury people were so helpful and caring A special thank you to Damian who pushed my wheel chair So grateful Thank you
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll
Friendly of the staff a new huge mall had been opening Mall del Soll This is the modern and fully functional airport with the biggest mall of the country and four hotels between stars

Ive flown Firefly a number of times on intraSabah routes Kota Kinabalu Sandakan and Kota Kinabalu Tawau and Ive never had any issues with them This flight was no different One day before the flight it was delayed by minutes I was informed of this delay via email and SMS The queue at the checkin counter in Kota Kinabalu was quite long but aside from that everything else went smoothly The flight departed and landed on time and the cabin was clean and comfortable passengers were given salted peanuts cookies and a bottle of water At Tawau the aeroplane was parked at a jet bridge Baggage claim went faster than it usually does in Kota Kinabalu I was very satisfied with my experience and will for my future trips

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience

Flying from Fayetteville to CLT on July The young man at AA was unfriendly like I never seen before Your ID put your bag take your bag were his only words No greeting no thank you no have a good flight I recently moved to Fayetteville for a job from New York Flying often Never flew from Fayetteville used Raleigh for that There was no soap in the restroom at am already Security was okay did not use thank you or please in their lexicon I will fly from Raleigh next time

The flight was about one hour and yet the flight attendants managed to hand out refresher towels then they gave each passenger a snack box and on the the third service round each passenger was given a drink All this was done unhurried with poise and a smile Such an unexpected level of star service In addition boarding was ontime flight departed and arrived on time What a great airline

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

First impression of Minsk airport was given by its exterior grand Brutalist Sovietera architecture Very impressive Inside the terminal doesnt feel grand and impressive I was in transit only so I only saw the arrival gates transfer area and the airside departure areas The arrivals area is a bit of a maze and signage not that clear So be sharp when looking for the transit area after arrivals The transfer area was old fashioned with worn fakeleather couches that seem to taken from a landfill Queuing time at the transfer area was OK around minutes After boarding card check passengers process through security which was a bit of a joke as passengers are not checked at all after passing the walkthrough metal detector The departures area with its shops is a bit of a maze and the gate waiting areas are very small There is not a lot of choice in shops what I saw was mostly liquor or food and beverage outlets Seating in the gate waiting areas is limited but on the upper level of the departures area there is sufficient space to take a rest on one of the seats At the upper level there are also seats on which you can recline but these seats are quite hard and not very comfortable to take a good nap There are also sleeping cabins here Wifi works great login via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean especially at the upper level where not a lot of people go The terminal it not really fit for PRM passengers as there are a lot of stairs but not escalators and just a few lifts They did install stairlifts at the gates a rather silly solution in my opinion but is works This airport is fine when you have a short transfer In case of a long transfer it can be boring and FB options are very limited

Airport is away from city and not good public transport available better to use cab Not too busy most of times so not long queue at entry check in and security mostly min to complete all formality Limited food options needs more there is one lounge but one of the smallest and least food options i found in India only suggested if having complementary lounge access Shopping options is also very limited only recommend tea shop if didnt got time to buy tea in city which is famous for Toilets needs to be more clean Shortage of sitting space on both floors Free Wifi only for min This airport need proper maintenance now

Small minimal facilities not much to do while you wait Staff are friendly and efficient The day we arrived there was live music playing in the customs area nice touch We walked out of the terminal to be greeted immediately by our tour arranger

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

Airport is away from city and not good public transport available better to use cab Not too busy most of times so not long queue at entry check in and security mostly min to complete all formality Limited food options needs more there is one lounge but one of the smallest and least food options i found in India only suggested if having complementary lounge access Shopping options is also very limited only recommend tea shop if didnt got time to buy tea in city which is famous for Toilets needs to be more clean Shortage of sitting space on both floors Free Wifi only for min This airport need proper maintenance now

Still a well organized airport We use the new international section Clean and simple to use Good staff security and customs Just expect that more international flights will be available soon from Qubec

I guess Mr E Bernal hasnt been to CCS Intl recently This airport has been totally renewed since June a brand new arrival area was opened with about desks and very friendly staff Deplane go through immigration and picking up your luggage takes about minutes So I recommend you to save those US and continuing to fly through Caracas By the way I did not know that there were flights from Maracaibo to Aruba

What great TSA staff have at St PeteClearwater Airport The lines moved smoothly and additional lines were opened when it became crowded The food court consists of one small shop where the food is OK Looking forward to going through this airport again on Sunday

The airport has a quick checkin counter right outside where you arrive with the taxi This led to a checkin time for our Delta flight including one checked in luggage of just minutes after I got out of the taxi Security was fast too never experienced such a comfortable on boarding on any flight

Great airport Good duty free Good fb outlets Just one question why do you clean all washrooms at the same time leaving just handicapped ones opened And to find a vacant one you need to pass several kms to find it

Small airport which was about minutes on bus to the city center Facilities was good and clean Baggage claim was fast and thoughtful as at many other Japanese airports Signs and directions were also clearly noted in English

Small airline but a good one Despite heavy turbulence on the flight from Kuala Lumpurs old airport to Tioman Island I felt safe and that the FAs knew what to do in the event of an emergency Cant be sure of course but it felt that way Good information from the crew about the turbulence Small planes but comfortable for the relatively short flight Good service during the flight

Beijing to Weihai with Shandong Airlines Comfortable clean and modern plane with ample leg room far more generous than Etihad and the other premium airlines I have experienced Some delay due to air traffic congestion however bags promptly delivered on arrival Water provided by friendly and attentive crew for the short flight

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

I expected the worst but to my surprise its one of the smoothest flight I have ever hard Everything was good other than the seats that needs a mattress to make them comfortable for sleeping The staff were good I will fly it anytime I prioritise feeling safe
It was very great flying in Vistara today then any other Company I liked this because of several reasons like hospitality Seat comfort cabin staff service food Etc Keep it up

I flew from Blackpool airport to Belfast for the first time I always fly from Liverpool to Belfast with Easyjet but the flight times were better and it was slightly cheaper to fly with Jet from Blackpool I was expecting a small airport with limited facilities but nothing prepared me for the facilities here Parking is free which was a bonus for me when booking on arrival however both car parks P and P were full and ended up abandoning my car on a grass area known as an overfill car park This was a minute walk to the airport On arrival there was nothing before the departure lounge The cash machine was out of service and WHSmiths closed Paying the airport charge was no problem and I was assisted with my baggage tag by a very helpful Jet worker The worst experience was going through security where the staff were extremely rude not just with me but with an elderly couple in front of me I agree that security needs to be strict but not intrusive and this was made a much more uncomfortable experience by the rudeness and lack of customer service with the staff I will never be using this airport again and even after a drink from the limited choice in the cafebar I was still reeling I can safely say this is the st and last time I will use this airport

Not that much leg room If you are over cm tall you will be bashing your kneecaps but otherwise the seat is pretty comfortable The services from the cabin crew were friendly and efficient Due to Covid restrictions no snack was served on this flight There is no screen in the seats so you must supply your own inflight entertainment Would definitely use the airline again as their routes are handy and they were punctual

MSP Airport does a great job with stores and restaurant options and recently completed some moderate improvements in aesthetics to terminal They currently offer a total of electric parking spots which are spread out across sites It appears the planning team completely overlooked this aspect of the customer experience

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

Entire flight was smooth however boarding time was a little confusing and the assigned gate they suddenly changed it so it caused more confusion I ordered prebook meal it tasted good but the food itself was somehow cold For me airlines baggage policy was highly favorable as I was able to check in kilos regardless of number of luggage

Flew TACA Airlines from Lima to Bogota Only the outside of the aircraft and the food carriage were TACA The rest magazine and crew were Avianca Food service for the and a half hour flight was great full meal Full service of drinks juices beers alcoholic I would fly with them again

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

Stunning new terminal friendly staff pleasurable experience only thing missing was the airlines One scheduled flight to Moscow once a week and winter charter flights is not justified hope to see the scheduled operators move in soon

We misplaced our passport which was very stressful However Ashley and Phil at the Canberra airport made sure that we still made it onto other flights back to New Zealand Their service was outstanding they were both so helpful nothing was a hassle which helped to alleviate a very stressful situation for us We cant thank them enough

I agree that it is a small tidy airport with close proximity to the city It is great that the tram is literally as you walk out the front doors with a frequent service to the city Bremen is such a great little city

Arrived mid night from Mumbai in a domestic flight aircraft attached to aero bridge in min we were at baggage area baggage arrived in next min Washroom were clean paid porters available plenty of baggage trolly No public transport during night only option is either prepaid or booking directly with taxi drivers We took prepaid going to Utorda around km paid approx inr during night a percent surcharge is applicable during day time should be around inr Just after you exit the terminal would be surrounded by taxi drivers prepaid cab counter is inside the building at arrival hall

My AirAsia Zest flight was a short flight from Manila to Cebu but a good trip I arrived minutes earlier than scheduled my seats were upgraded for free and my check in luggage arrived on time in the baggage claim Everything was good but unfortunately during my flight they took off the headrest covers on the seats and the head rest looks unclean For money I paid for and the service I got I was satisfied
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

Used to be very busy in the Soviet times since then reduced the traffic by at least At the same time the new terminal was built with more adequate waiting spaces It is rather modern and clean Food service is kind of slow Public transportation to the city is not on top and I used parknfly only once

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

I was returning from visiting a friend in Uruguay and it involves a full day of travel flying TAM Airlines from Montevideo to London via Sao Paolo They had inflight entertainment on loop for h m flight from Montevideo to Sao Paulo the flight from Sao Paulo to London was without concern On the way out my inflight entertainment broke and I had to do without for the flight from London to Sao Paolo The crew were professional seats were comfortable As it was an overnight flight they offered a twocourse eveining meal and breakfast in the moring All in all I would recommend it as an airline to fly to and from South America with

I was stopped by the airport because i had a problem with my passport the bluebird staff did everything to help me get on the plane on time The staff ran with me to the place where they make you a new passport and the Security head took me in his car to the airplane they all did a great effort to let me fly to my destination and not cancel it Thank you guys
Great airport not many flights so no hassle From check in to take off minutes Car parking also free

My wife daughter and I used Eastern Airways to fly from Humberside Airport in the UK to Esbjerg in Denmark We had a number of reasons for choosing Eastern The proximity as Humberside is only a minute drive away and our daughter has a disability that requires her to have lots of medical equipment with her in the cabin she requires mechanical ventilation via a trachea when flying and it was our daughters first flight We believed Eastern as a small local airline could provide the service we would need to make the trip a success They did not disappoint From my initial communication with customer services to our flights all the staff were helpful considerate and went above and beyond Nothing was too much trouble and they pulled out all the stops to ensure the medical equipment could be accommodated At one point the captain of the plane enquired with the air steward about our daughters welfare Very impressed and would not hesitate to use the airline again We have told friends and family about the route offered by Eastern and recommended them for a break to Denmark Cannot praise the airline enough and special mention to customer services the staff and the captain who was on both journeys

Used this airline for an internal flight in China last October from Kunming to Lijiang and just had to take some photos etc but not a joke crisp new airline with latest Boeings smart logos etc Short flight but adequate English used and friendly crew

Auckland to Chengdu Their cabin was fresh and clean and being a newer aircraft was kept very well The service is warm and professional The seats fold flat and my kids slept for most of the hour flight We arrived relaxed and stress free considering that we had young kids to look after and worry about Night flights with kids are the way to go The food was very tasty The flight attendants were very polite and accommodating They never made you feel you were a burden to them I will happily fly Sichuan in the future
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

On arrival Very long queue for passport control over an hour They have plenty of staff but processing time per person is simply very long On departure queues were fine We were told to arrive hours in advance which meant waiting doing nothing for a long time There are no restaurants after security just a few fast food options Also WiFi only works if you can receive an OTP by text ie you already have data Clean and pleasant but some of the details could be thought through a bit more
Clean efficient airport small but with nice stores A variety of airlines and it is never busy
The set of counters of Cathay Dragon was a bit out of order since every counter was excessively full due to the great number of passengers Business Class and Marco Polo Club and Oneworld Members

Every time on arrival from either holiday work meetings interstate or visiting relatives in Melbourne I feel all the renovations look great but please put the car park ticket machines near the carousel arrival hall out of the weather When some people pay at the gate they hold up the traffic I travel with Virgin regularly and cant wait for the renovations to be finished

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal

I went to Jamaica for a week on vacation and I have no complaints regarding Caribbean airlines Not the best airline on the planet but theyre definitely by far not the worst they are reasonable and if youre willing to spend a bit more than business class definitely is substantially more comfortable The only drawback that I can think of but that isnt their fault is the fact that on the return trip I had to make four stops in four different countries

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice
Plane clean and on time Ran out of water after row economy Its a short flight so bring back water in seat pockets of you cant cope No coffee tea or drinks for anyone

Cheap prices comfortable seats decent legroom inches on the former IndiGo airplane Check in at Bogota was done online but tourist pass for San Andres and bags had to be dropped off at the check in counter which was pretty easy Boarding was a breeze After take off many people switched seats since most didnt pay for an assigned one Flight was minutes late but otherwise good The only problem were kids running up and down the aisle like wild animals and nobody from the crew stopping them Unfortunately due to Colombias COVID rules there was no inflight service but you are able to bring your own drinks and snacks

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience
It is not big The efficiency of checkin and security checks is high Signposts are clear The WiFi connection is stable The ambience is clean and not crowded

Luangpraban to Vientiane This airline was above expectations The checkin opened on time The staff where very helpful and gave me a seat with extra leg room The flight left on time and arrived early Will use again for sure

Ground service is terrible compared to in the air Manual checkin process with no computers This airline seems to be the only one to have a lounge in the domestic terminal in Yangon Airconditioned and friendly associates offering a cheese croissant No bathroom inside so that was a drag People in Lotus class got a private van to the plane which was nice compared to cramming onto a bus Onboard the flight was pretty good The front of the plane is much quieter compared to the back Their inflight magazine was pretty decent and the english grammatically correct Even on short flights they gave you food On my YGNMDY flight which was about minutes they served a full breakfast Seats were pretty comfortable on par with United A first class seats I dont really see the need for inflight entertainment on such short flights

Very Crowded check in and long security lines However once past security it was a very clean and nice airport Not enough seats in the gate area however Just know where you are going and leave plenty of time before your flight

General Mitchell is a breath of a fresh air Its clean friendly and efficient Theres actually a classy little used book store and a museum full of model planes and blimps and whatnot If you get lost it is your fault my friend The whole place is like one of the models in the museum accurate well labeled and miniature Everything is right in front of you Theres an Amtrak station a block away minutes and to get to Union Station in Chicago is hard to beat This airport is tiny but its the easiest one Ive ever dealt with

Lovely airport and great shops for an airport of this size Paying a the counter for taxis removes the touts that descend on you in other places Food options are limited but then who would want to spend too long checking in too early and getting hungry when on such a lovely island

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

Gatwick to Venice We were hesitant about this airline having read reviews but booked it for the low price I have to say the flight exceeded our expectations Checkin and boarding were both an extremely smooth process I think we were at the bag drop desk for a total of minutes and boarding was much quicker than with other lowfrills airlines We paid in advance for extra legroom seats my partner is so this is an essential for us and were surprised by the amount of space and comfort We sat at the front of the plane with plenty of room to stretch out unlike Ryanair and EasyJet whose exit row seats only have an extra inch or so Flight took off and landed on time and was far more comfortable than wed anticipated There are definitely some areas to be improved upon in terms of the preflight process I have not come across any other airline in the past few years that makes you print out your own boarding pass rather than making it available electronically Its also pretty irritating to be told you cant check in online unless you pay for it this could potentially lead to long queues at the airport on the day These points lower my overall score for the airline but the flight experience itself was very pleasant

Ive flown Firefly a number of times on intraSabah routes Kota Kinabalu Sandakan and Kota Kinabalu Tawau and Ive never had any issues with them This flight was no different One day before the flight it was delayed by minutes I was informed of this delay via email and SMS The queue at the checkin counter in Kota Kinabalu was quite long but aside from that everything else went smoothly The flight departed and landed on time and the cabin was clean and comfortable passengers were given salted peanuts cookies and a bottle of water At Tawau the aeroplane was parked at a jet bridge Baggage claim went faster than it usually does in Kota Kinabalu I was very satisfied with my experience and will for my future trips

VIP Boarding is a scam VIP Seats are a scam Too many flight cancellations without warning Every question I ask the response is I dont know Uncomfortable seats Always super late and they lie about being on time I will stick to USbased airlines from now on This is the last time I fly VivaAir

MSL continues to be a good alternative to larger nearby airports Flew to see family in Late Nov and Early Dec of NWA continues to have flights a day to its Memphis Hub As with my previous experiences traveling through MSL the NWA and Airport Staff did a great job in taking care of their passengers Again a job well done by the MSL Airport and Airline Staff Also the New Marriot Hotel and Spa has opened the Robert Trent Jones Golf Course is also open for the avid golfer both of which are just minutes from the airport My round trip flights were flawless and running at or ahead of schedule outbound and inbound from the North West Alabama Airport

The mid morning flight took off on time from CCU and as I had to go to Bangalore for work my company had booked this flight for me Web checkin and baggage drop were smoothly done Boarding also started on time Landing and disembarkation also happened swiftly along with baggage retrieval which was good IndiGo may not be a glamorous carrier but it gets the job done of taking you from point A to point B efficiently

Worst Airport in the world arrived to check in then security on baggage Then Passport machine thought great all good Walked through Duty Free then a mile long queue to get through to B gate BA is B gate Poor shops nobody could shop or eat unless you had got their hours early This queue apparently is normal and is called the new fast track what a joke One person in a box checking passports again Run to B hundreds of people standing there no way could you board in Groups just a free for all Again with one woman at the gate before you got on the coach to the plane still coaching you out to the plane She was checking everyones passport again Why havent they upgraded this system by now and built satellite gates off the main airport Not going back there

Windhoek to Frankfurt After having read reviews I was prepared for bad service and problems during the flight but luckily everything was fine and I am quite happy with the overall experience The aircraft is spacious and clean seats are comfortable and have a pillow and a blanket for each passenger The crew was very friendly and not so good cop bad cop The food was quite good however it might have been better maybe a dessert could be added Big selection of drinks but only one type of juice orange On the long overnight flight dinner and breakfast have been offered During the flight the crew also offered water The entertainment system is still not working it seems to be a persistent problem that the airline is not willing to solve

Small but efficient and clean airport There was not much rush and check in to gate was minutes in the evening I fly from this airport once a year and never have any issueso far Customs and immigration takes less time than any other airports in India experienced

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point
Havana Cayo Coco return A one hour flight with an old ATR turboprop Seats surprisingly comfortable and we were offered a free drink plus candy onboard Nothing special but we arrived on time

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus

My experiences have always been pleasant Security lines are extremely short and there is a lot of open space Checking in is never a hasslewe have been able to pass by the checkin desk in minutes or less on the worst of days Bathrooms are clean and theres always a cafe or news store open Delta seems to have the largest concentration of flights at the airport most of them being on their regional affiliates running under Delta Connection Overall the airport is very good clean and friendly

Being first time flyers with Rex we were delighted with the personal service at airports and in the air Assisted with booking in luggage and seating details Being tall enough leg room to be comfortable We would choose to fly rex whenever possible

Small airport with helpful staff In the arrivals hall there is nothing special On departure you can enjoy your time on the st floor snacks bar with some good choices The view to the apron is good from the departure hall The only negative side is that the air conditioning system is not good at all

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

Great employees service schedules but I have stopped flying with Horizon because they are now using Turbo Prop planes Q Its slower has more noise and vibration and most of all they cannot fly at altitudes where the ride is smooth This is compared to the full size jets that Southwest flies on the same routes as Horizon I used to have the credit card had Frequent flyer status and earned oodles of miles Those days are gone
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them
My budget airline fare turned out to be a complete surprise with full service and a fairly new A plane The service friendliness and cleanliness are no less than those of Singapore Airlines

Auckland to Chengdu Their cabin was fresh and clean and being a newer aircraft was kept very well The service is warm and professional The seats fold flat and my kids slept for most of the hour flight We arrived relaxed and stress free considering that we had young kids to look after and worry about Night flights with kids are the way to go The food was very tasty The flight attendants were very polite and accommodating They never made you feel you were a burden to them I will happily fly Sichuan in the future

PSP is a great little airport The s style terminal is fairly well designed but with the advent of security screening areas its a bit harder to negotiate Rental cars are right outside the door from the baggage carousels The weather is seldom a problem so flights stay pretty close to their schedules Parking is reasonably priced and convenient to the terminal

Return journey Clean modern aircraft comfortable seat tasty food and drying and great cabin crew On the way back ground staff checked our bags through to EDI on BA even though we did not have the journey on a single ticket Impressive and enjoyable journey and I would happily use them again

A short flight with this airline on behalf of Swiss Plane was all clean and modern and had USB outlets Staff was friendly and professional Food and beverages were buy on board unfortunately but a bottle of water and a chocolate were complementary All in all a rather uneventful flight but good and professional as it should be

Small airport yet very efficient Dont come too early as there is not much to do Queuing is almost nonexistent staff checkin and security are very friendly There is a restaurant with view on the tarmac and a small airport shop before the security Arrival is very fast to minutes including bagage reclaim There is a bus stop right before the terminal taking you to AntwerpenBerchem train station a major train station with fast connection to Brussels or anywhere in Belgium Very close to the city center Highly recomended for users who like fast airports

We booked the flight because it was rather cheap on ctrip hours before departure my wife got a message that my flight from Changsha to Chengdu was cancelled and we should call the airline company Due to Chinese New Year and the Coronavirus it was pretty hard to contact anybody so we decided to take the car to the airport At the airport the ticket desk was unable to change my ticket Sichuan Airlines was unable to change my ticket so we had to call ctrip After nearly hours we got the schedule change and I was able to get an earlier flight Would have wished the airlines had offered me the schedule change by themselves Service on the flight ChangshaChengdu was nonexistent I am not sure if that was due to turbulence or to the virus but it was just a twohours flight and I had brought some food of my own In Chengdu I had to get my luggage and wait for hours to check it in again fortunately there is a good lounge for transit passengers at Chengdu Airport At pm the Sichuan Airlines counters got really busy as there were many flights departing It was really crowded but service was quite quick I was pretty surprised when the flight to Rome got cancelled maybe due to personnel shortage because of the virus My gutfeeling says the flights to Prague and to Rome were pretty empty so they cancelled one flight Passangers to Italy got rebooked to our flight and even that one was not full Seats were a bit narrow and my earphones did not work but I was so tired takeoff at am that I did not need any inflight entertainment Luckily there was no foodservice at the start so passangers were able to sleep The flightattendants handed out bottled water and snacks when I awoke I found snacks and water on the vacant seat next to me Very thoughtful hours before landing they served breakfast It was not a lot we did not even get trays It was Chinese food and I liked it but for Europeans who cannot eat spicy food the choice was not good I am used to spicy food but even I considered the breakfast to be quite spicy No drinks were offered for breakfast Luckily I always try to get a seat near the galley so I could get hot water during the flight for my tea Allinall Sichuan Airlines was quite cheap the aircraft semiclean and inflightentertainment choices were okay If you are not too tall and do not need to many amenities I can recommend this airline Worst flight I ever had to China but still reasonably comfortable

Cusco Airport is another wonderfully crowded and poorly designed airfield in Peru ie Lima Chiclayo Byzantine brutalist concrete architecture aside this airport is by far the worst designed for providing any kind of logical flow for a singlerunway airport serving a large metropolitan area It would seem that nobody in government has looked at what can be done with the cramped space and volume of passengers to try and make a more hospitable clean and userfriendly facility Unfortunately this airport will remain the sole thoroughfare for all international Machu Picchu travelers for the foreseeable future Maybe Peru can step up to the plate and make some major changes to this facility and take a field trip to Quito and check out their new airport which is very nice

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines
A small but full service airport Doesnt have some of the amenities of larger airports but you would not expect them Clean Great service Short wait times Highly recommended
Great service safety standard met Comfy seat and nice snacks The staffs in all aspects are very kind and very helpful Sad it will merge with Thai Airways
Needed a wheel chair because of an injury people were so helpful and caring A special thank you to Damian who pushed my wheel chair So grateful Thank you

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

HELCPHHEL HELCPH on Avro RJ ontime both ways Clean aircraft crew and service are nothing special but seats comfortable and spacious in the x configuration CPHHEL on B food for purchase in both directions drinks free In general this is competitive to SAS on the same sector but definitely a lowcost feel without a particularly lowcost price

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

The queue for the border was moving quite fast the border guards were working fast The toilets in the baggage reclaim area was clean although there was a queue to them one of the two urinals wasnt working The toilet would be better if they were bigger albeit they were quite clean
The check in was smooth Signs in English are sufficient to direct the passengers The ambiance is great and its facilities are enough to give comfort to its passengers

SINNARSapporoNARSIN trips for last two years Sapporo NewChitose impressed me Comfortable massage chairs located around airport dining options fair but still better than others small and somewhat ageing but still cosy Checkin fast for domestic Glad to go there again

Ohrid St Paul international airport was in terms of size like a trip with the time machine The aircraft is parking literally in front of the Arrivals door where passengers are directed to the Passports control There were only desks working out of which for an airport with flights daily can be considered a good performance Nevertheless despite the size the airport is well organized and clean showing the travelers how flying was at the past times when holding an airline ticket was considered a luxury As an improvement for the administration I think that a shuttle bus from airport to the city roughly km Distance would be to consider synchronized with the flying schedule

International arrival hall is small immigration is crowded does not provide much facility except toilet and carousel With its size luggage come very quickly and most passengers only need to spend minutes from gate to pick up area Once you get out of terminal there are plenty of food shops coffee shop including Starbucks on ground floor and food center on the nd floor For Departure facility is much better Check in area is large clean and modern Departure hall have a lot of shops cafe and restaurant but International departure need to make sure to reserve enough time to pass immigration which is at the farthest end of the airport and no more shop beyond that point

Aalborg Lufthavn AAL is a smallish airport near the city of Aalborg There is not usually a lot of people leaving or arriving at any one time so there is hardly ever any time wasted standing in line for checkin or security checks brilliant A very friendly and inviting atmosphere overall

Harrisburg MDT is a great airport Small but connected to many international gateways Security lines are short Food options are limited but good I only wish they offered a NYC area connection My airport of choice

Great medium sized airport Travel fairly frequent from Hannover mainly from Terminal B to the UK The three terminals are very similar Good city centre connection with SBahn Fast checkin to gate usually same for arrival to out of door

Boarded by airbridge on an AN with very good condition crew was very friendly Legroom was plenty and seat was very comfortable We departed on time Soon after departure they offer free coffee and water and buy food from a menu Captain made announcements of the flight path We had a great experience with them
Family trip from Montral to Edmonton Boeing Canadian North is a nice airline Food great No inflight Entertainment Beverages and Cabin Service nice It was a calm nonturbulent flight

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional
Taipei Hualein TaiChung Both flights by ATR cabin was clean and comfortable Very friendly crew Drinks service on both flights

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

Big enough to serve all of your needs yet small enough and easy enough to get in and out of What a contrast when compared to Kansas City and Atlanta where my journey originated They have a childrens play area great local restaurants beers coffee etc It is about the same airfare to fly into Milwaukee often times as it is to fly into Chicago with a lot less hassle

MadridRome return over the weekend Both flights departed and arrived on time Boarding priority worked well seat comfort ok but nothing special just middle seat empty and a bit more legroom than economy Service was great the food service is tasty Pre lunchdinner drinks served then a full meal Open bar during the flight Lounge in Madrid is great not the one in Fuimucino but it does the job Overall it was a great experience

Berlin to Paris Flight on time clean and modern plane It was impossible to buy any drinks due to an issue with their visa machine The crew was ok but they could smile a bit more At Orly airport we had to disembark by bus which took minutes to finally be at the south terminal

I have flown times on La Companie so far and could not be happier It makes me laugh to see complaints about ground accommodations and old planes etc this is an airline that flies to a manageable airport Orly with lower taxes than for example CDG it is a boutique operation with limited flights and proposes business class flights RT for as low as vs on poorer major airlines It is great value for the price and grumpy people can still spend their on a coach ticket booked on United coping with the CDG mess and see if they are offered hot towels full meal champagne and most importantly business class seats with better air quality

I arrived today from Heho with a sick child probably from food poisoning and was helped like I never thought I could We were taken charge of by a great team of officers nurse doctor that took us to the airport clinic and took care of my daughter Everyone has been great and we are really grateful to each of you They will recognize themselves

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

The airport was not busy when we arrived but this did not stop it taking minutes to pass through immigration and collect bags Facilities are what you expect from an airport about years out of date and did not expect anything different I guess Found the staff to be unfriendly and there were no painted on smiles available here

Beijing to Pyongyang Comparing an intraEuropean flight of hours and this flight practically no differences clean aircraft nice stewardesses punctual simple food good and attentive service a normal standard

I have flown here only on private aircraft The commercial airlines have yet to discover this often overlooked resource The parking and terminal buildings are great Reminds me of how Chicago Midway used to be before the most recent spate of reconstruction like a hometown feel Very clean facilities and the commercial pax I have spoken to all seem to enjoy it Mostly the lack of a commute to Chicago I think
