The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

MSL continues to be a good alternative to larger nearby airports Flew to see family in Late Nov and Early Dec of NWA continues to have flights a day to its Memphis Hub As with my previous experiences traveling through MSL the NWA and Airport Staff did a great job in taking care of their passengers Again a job well done by the MSL Airport and Airline Staff Also the New Marriot Hotel and Spa has opened the Robert Trent Jones Golf Course is also open for the avid golfer both of which are just minutes from the airport My round trip flights were flawless and running at or ahead of schedule outbound and inbound from the North West Alabama Airport

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

Long Beach is a great little airport It has the most efficient TSA checkpoint I have ever seen with the longest line ever being about three minutes and I fly through here quite often While the south concourse is the only gate area I have used I am sure the airport is the same throughout the terminal The staff is great and friendly and you can chat with everyone The gate numbering can be a bit confusing but so long as you dont immediately exit the terminal to the left you should be fine They even give you an umbrella when it rains to walk onto the plane

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him

Tashkent Airport has become very efficient on the international side Immigration and customs both on the way in and on departure were quite user friendly Not a lot of shops and restaurants but that was not inconvenient Readers should be aware that the domestic terminal is on the other side of the runway and it could take up to minutes to connect from one side to the other side using a taxi

MontpellierMditerrane Airport is a tiny but nice airport Facilities are clean some computer charging desks are available reasonable amount of seats can be found at the gates Shopping and eating options are according to the size of the airport The airside area also features a lovely terrasse taking advantage of the sun drawbacks however The terrasse does not offer a direct view on the movement area and its the spot where all smokers endup Bagages delivery on arrival was a bit long especially for such a small airport Traffic right outside the terminal can be abot messy as the pickup dropoff zone seems to be on the street so cars are jammed Wifi connection procedure should be simplified and streamlined

I have been travelling to the Gambia for six years now and have seen alot of changes at the airport over the years Security are very friendly people You can even sit out in the open and have a drink and a bite to eat and watch your plane land

Brand new airport On the positive side for Chinese standards it certainly is welldesigned and wellconnected Bright and clean checkin area Good choice of restaurants and cafes both before and after security controls As to the negatives the security controls are quite inefficient and slow the airline lounges are all quite poor and certain gates from upward are very far up to min walking

Bangkok to Hong Kong and return After several good experiences I only use Orient Thai for my flights to Hong Kong Their price is Set regardless whether youre buying ahead or last moment Other low costs can have their cheapest offers around US less however that distinction quickly fades with slapping you various charges before you click buy Orient Thais fare is all inclusive inclusive of taxes a hot meal and KG of baggage too They used to fly an older B however now they use the version Flights were on time the plane was comfortable Staff active and helpful Seats and leg room superior to other low cost and many full fare airlines out there Only drawback is that there is no online check in and you get seats at the airport so you might not get your favourite seat All in all cannot fault them and love to see them fly to more Asian destinations

I flew Brisbane to Honiara on the th April Flight Left early was only full and arrived minutes early Add kg of luggage good plentiful food and beer what more could you want Entertainment was poor but its only a hour flight so I survived Staff friendly which is much more than I can say about the BA Qantas staff on the Flights coming out from Ireland
Clean efficient airport small but with nice stores A variety of airlines and it is never busy

Its big enough for the number of people it serves on a weekday although Id imagine it would get pretty crowded when the larger Virgin planes come in from Melbourne on weekends The staff are friendly the facilities adequate for a regional airport of this size the queues managable and its clean It just feels like its missing something Despite it being refurbished within the last decade or so it feels like it needs a bit of a touch upand the constant use of that sickly blue colour everywhere doesnt necessarily help the situation So yes it is a nice airport in regional NSW that serves its purpose and the needs of the people but I just get the feeling that with a bit of money put in new floorings lick of paint open up the departure lounge a bit more provide wifi it could be have a certain wow factor reserved for NSW regional airports like Newcastle Albury and Dubbo which have been thrust forward into the st Century

I had just gotten to Khartoum from Dubai and I really had to use the washroom I went to the mens washroom and man oh man It smelled like people went there and forgot to flush I didnt use the washroom I ran back to my father because there was faeces on the floor of the toilet as well Outside I saw a janitor sitting in his chair comfortably and as I do not know how to speak Arabic I just decided to hold it instead of telling someone to clean up Other than this the airport was alright but not even close to ideal A month later my mother came via the same flight and airport and she had to wait hours at the luggage belt for her luggage to arrive

The security staff were incredibly slow and seemed to be more interested in personal chats than getting customers through the security process as quickly as possible Why not be more proactive you will get less tension with customers shorter queues and a better job satisfaction You dont need to be unfriendly and impersonal

At last a quiet clean and efficient airport Terminal F without the tiresome duty free The hourly Borispil Express train will drop you off near Terminal D and you need to catch a halfhourly shuttle bus to Terminal F mainly for LCC flights as its something like a m walk otherwise The number of flights is fairly small and seemingly mainly Ryanair Plenty of room to wait just a couple of refreshment options Straightforward passport control and security no queues Plenty of seats in the departure lounge easy access to gates good view of airport operations No duty free Hooray A couple of refreshment stands No air bridges but then LCCs dont use them anyway A very relaxing experience particularly in contrast to departing from a UK airport

A wonderful little airport So impressed While it was busy at the peak of the holiday season everything moved quickly and efficiently The shops airside while small have a great selection of Spanish specialties like olive oil I hope the new airport that opens next year keeps up the same high standards

Used Hamilton Airport as an alternative airport to Toronto A much smaller airport than Pearson a good thing resulting in much less walking and waiting and much easier to get in and out of A great option if youre visiting Southern Ontario or Niagara Falls if you want to avoid the Toronto traffic and is km from downtown Toronto Not the greatest airport for public transit links to Hamilton and Toronto and beyond likely due to the airports small size Airport was slightly built on the cheap has exterior siding and drop celling interiors reminding me of a bus terminal and has very limited foodshopping options Despite these minor complaints overall a good alternative to Pearson for direct flights and would use it again

Atyrau to Uralsk I had a few meetings to attend in Uralsk and Aksai and was not looking forward to the hour or more arduous taxi journey from Atyrau to Uralsk in C heat I was recommend to use Qazaq Air as they now have a direct flight from Atyrau to Uralsk I booked a return flight online selected a seat paid via card and my eticket was immediately emailed On arrival to the airport checkin is simple and efficient The flight was serviced by a Bombardier Dash Next Gen aircraft which was very clean and the aircrew well dressed and welcoming The flight h m was very good with a surprisingly powerful takeoff and flight landing mins earlier than scheduled I certainly was impressed with the overall service and the value for money I will be using Qazaq air again for direct flights around west Kazakhstan

I would like to express my gratitude to the airport staff for caring about my comfort and positive impressions of the company I would like to express special gratitude to the employee Annette for helping me resolve the issue with my luggage The flight was comfortable and in a safe atmosphere for me

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell

The airport is huge with clear signage direction and information It is well connected to the public transportation such as bus taxi Grab and the airport rail link leading to Phaya Thai Immigration is fast and convenient All nationalities are now using the auto gate for immigration at Departure Shopping and dining experience is quite nice with great choices of duty free items More greens might be needed to make the airport more ecofriendly I would suggest

Travelled twice fromto Joburg Very small airport used mainly and maybe only to reach Okawango Delta A couple of flight per day to South Africa and Gaborone twice a week to Namibia However it is usually quite busy because all small airplanes leaves from here to all airstrips in Okawango Security control also for internal flights with these small planes One gate you walk to the airplane There are no facilities inside only one toilet and no food and shops one checkin desk that open hours before flight but the queue is reasonable It is a safe airport quite clean but not the place where youd like to spend more time than necessary Nice shop and honest food just in front of the airport

Tiny but well kept airport different design not too many flights but departure lounge seemed chaotic Immigration is friendly but takes a long time a few shops you need to pay attention to the counters to find out where youre going to checkin Overall experience fair

I recently flew with Swiss Air on the Bucharest to Zurich route in an Airbus A Despite the overall comfort of the aircraft and the friendliness of the cabin crew the cabin temperature was much too low and could not be adjusted despite our requests The crew was kind and suggested we wear warmer clothes assuring us that the situation would improve over time Unfortunately the temperature remained consistently low throughout the flight making the journey less comfortable than we would have liked Nevertheless the aircraft was modern and clean and the staff provided prompt and friendly service If it werent for the temperature issue I would have had a very pleasant experience If the temperature cannot be adjusted immediately the company could provide passengers with additional blankets to offer them thermal comfort Overall my flight experience with Swiss Air was good but the temperature issue left a negative impression

Great little airport used mainly by Porter airlines Check in was efficient and you go down to an airport lounge open to everyone They serve free tea coffee and soft drinks along with cookies and nuts The wifi is free and fast Boarding is effortless and the scenery on take off is stunning The only downside was that when the lounge is busy it gets a little grubby with dishes lying everywhere Otherwise it comes highly recommended

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Travelled twice fromto Joburg Very small airport used mainly and maybe only to reach Okawango Delta A couple of flight per day to South Africa and Gaborone twice a week to Namibia However it is usually quite busy because all small airplanes leaves from here to all airstrips in Okawango Security control also for internal flights with these small planes One gate you walk to the airplane There are no facilities inside only one toilet and no food and shops one checkin desk that open hours before flight but the queue is reasonable It is a safe airport quite clean but not the place where youd like to spend more time than necessary Nice shop and honest food just in front of the airport

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

Isnt it fascinating that you can buy any spirit in a one liter bottle but water only in l bottles I asked and the not so friendly stuff assured that the whole airport just sells little bottles at the gates that is after security check Oh and when I asked why she cleverly replied just because I have never seen an airport that poor with food and beverages Dont come hungry or thirsty

Offered sandwich and drinks at this very short flight I love flying on Embraer planes in a short regional flights as they are very comfortable Staffs were OK both on ground and on board All in all it was a good flight in terms of schedule service ticket price

I was very impressed by the level of care and support I received at the airport Having a severe reaction to an insect bite and no Antihistamine tablets with me The local team and Airport police went out of their way to help I wish I had noted their names they looked everywhere and obtained tablets for me while making sure I was comfortable and relaxed Thank you very much as the level of care and support at a busy airport was very welcome and impressive

I never thought I would find myself reviewing a TSA department but I felt compelled to after my recent positive experience My family and I were unexpectedly transiting through Newark on June We had several mishaps happen beyond our control after an extended travel day hours The TSA department at Newark airport in particular a man named Fontaine helped greatly alleviate our stress and help expedite us through the security line and airport correcting the mistakes of our airline workers I cannot begin to tell you how appreciative I am for their help empathy and services

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

We used Luxor airport both for internal flight to Cairo and international flight to UK On both occasions it was clean and airy with plenty of space to sit We were allowed to take our water with us so no problem in buying drinks Yes there was someone selling us toilet paper despite the notices saying this was not allowed but by then we knew their standard of living and if you cant spare the odd pound when we have spent so much on a holiday what does that say about us We were protected from harassment by helpers by our rep Altogether I thought using Luxor airport a pleasant experience

Dont understand all negative reviews yes you can not compare this airport to a modern European or US one but short lines friendly people despite unfriendly behaving tourists enough seating to wait Smooth entry into the country expect to enter a country that is years back in time and you will enjoy your trip

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

La Paz Sucre in an exMexicana Ticketing process is manual and very slow beware and get your tickets before the airport We were handed a little snack bag as we boarded then served drinks on board a great way to provide good service on a short flight

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

They canceled my flight and no refund My boyfriend and I booked tickets from Cusco to La Paz for just on I received an email saying that the flight was canceled Reason From that moment on they were no longer flying to La Paz We were already in Cusco when I received the email so we looked for a customer service point Arriving we were super poorly attended the lady who answered us checked the system that was really canceled was when we knew the reason and could not do anything We had to swallow it dry for to make a scandal was not going to do any good We returned for our stay and started looking for air tickets again Great illusion at that time of the championship prices were very high and schedules that did not favor us because from La Paz we went to Uyuni where we had reservations that we did not want to have to change them Anyway we had to buy same bus tickets and face h of travel We put it in our head that if it was happening this way it was because it was supposed to be like that and in the end we were saving I contacted them as requested in the email I received advising about the cancellation to this day nothing I only receive automatic responses I already sent to the emails available on the site and also nothing these nor automatic response I receive The phones look like nonexistent I do not know what to do to get my refund

Ohrid St Paul international airport was in terms of size like a trip with the time machine The aircraft is parking literally in front of the Arrivals door where passengers are directed to the Passports control There were only desks working out of which for an airport with flights daily can be considered a good performance Nevertheless despite the size the airport is well organized and clean showing the travelers how flying was at the past times when holding an airline ticket was considered a luxury As an improvement for the administration I think that a shuttle bus from airport to the city roughly km Distance would be to consider synchronized with the flying schedule
The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green
Another great flight Very consistent service consistent quality of food and comfortable aircraft The service on the flight was just spot on I would recommend them based on how consistent they are

Arrival Clean and spacious airport However the luggagebaggage arrival area appears small and congested Taxi counters are available near the exit Departure Checked in online and print ticket using the kiosks available in the airport Thumbs up However upon entering the departure gate the officer who are on duty did not recognise the ticket ticket from kiosk is thinner more plasticky compared to thicker ticket from the counter and questioned me of having a fake ticket She maintained her politeness though but still how come your own staff didnt recognise ticket which you own airport albeit kiosk produce Otherwise the rest of the experience was good Spacious and clean airport with abundant seats A bit too cold
Mannheim to Berlin Great experience flying like in the past good service no queues customers first I can recommend

Warsaw to Tallinn Our flight was in codeshare with LOT Polish Airlines Between our arrival and departure there were minutes gate opens mins before departure the ground crew worked very well so we could catch our Nordica flight to Tallinn with ease The seats are comfortable the legroom is more than okay Bigger meals and drinks are available on purchase but they serve complementary drinks coffee tea water and snacks chocolate bar The cabin crew was kind and the cabin was clean

The staff are friendly and its clean and offers a good service most of the time I do have two constructive comments however I wish you would put your flights on sale way in advance Eg I want to book for next summer now but have been told to wait until the end of the year This is not good for their own business as most people want to book summer vacations for next year now and if they are not on sale people will go to other countries like the Canary Islands etc and this is a shame I had booked for trip returning to Dublin via LGW on th November and bought flight from Dublin on Ryanair now told change to Heathrow New flight to Dublin from LHR required Additional expense for people using you to route home

Paris to Newark Service on board adequate and friendly staff But the issue was that my checked luggage did not arrive in Newark From that moment no feedback customer care nonexistent The staff was not concerned and blamed the situation on Orly airport No support

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

MalagaSan Sebastian Approach looked a bit dodgy as the airport is sandwiched between the Pyrenees and the sea but in reality it was a gentle descent From aircraft to baggage yards Baggage arrived very rapidly my host had parked in the free carpark only another yards away Clean modern airport not actually in San Sebastian but Irun about minutes from the French border very convenient for Biarritz

The flight Taipei to Shenzen was uninspiring with staff being disinterested and an older aircraft with uncomfortable seats but the service after clearing the Shenzen transit lounge hours of life lost there was very good and cheerful However this is a headsup for snowsports travelers Unless you are in business class you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true They do but the total length width depth has to be cm or less There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size We somehow missed this fact In business class it is cm which is more than enough but for me it meant a US penalty No pay no boarding pass Be aware when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage it is not entirely true Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry
Mannheim to Berlin Great experience flying like in the past good service no queues customers first I can recommend

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use

Beijing to Pyongyang Comparing an intraEuropean flight of hours and this flight practically no differences clean aircraft nice stewardesses punctual simple food good and attentive service a normal standard

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

Have used this airport twice in the last year and found it very smooth From plane arriving at terminal only ten minutes to clear border control collect bags and exit airport Bus to Gothenburg outside terminal to meet each flight and in to city in about minutes quicker than from the main Gothenburg airport Adequate facilities in airport and an outside area airside for smokers to sit in the sun with a drink

Sukhothai Airport owned by Bangkok Boutique Airlines is a great little secret gem not to be missed Due to its size you feel like a celebrity A flower festooned approach greeted by security officers in their shorts and old colonial hats checking in outdoors the open feel the gardens water dripping from the roof to keep customers cool The check in staff all line up and wai you to send you off and the ground staff at the aircraft do the same Priority boarding for monks of course Exotic and fabulous with the usual Bangkok Airlines free drinks and snacks

This review applies to Terminal only American Airlines Transited through a rather busy Reagan National There are great views for the airfield from the D concourse terminal building and E concourse The walk from the end of D concourse to the end of E concourse is rather long and with only a minutes connection I made it to the connecting gate in E concourse with minutes to spare Overall a good airport and terminal to transit through

Great airport Good duty free Good fb outlets Just one question why do you clean all washrooms at the same time leaving just handicapped ones opened And to find a vacant one you need to pass several kms to find it

HKGBKK I booked with them because it was the only airline available Check in took hr in HKG and plane was a year old B Entertainment was pretty much nothing and seats were the most uncomfortable Ive ever experienced Plane and bathroom were unclean I booked a seat in the upper deck and it was quiet Food was horrible Only good thing was the value because I you pretty much get everything for that cheap price
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Not bad
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

Upon arrival we were herded into two huge queues in passport control Plenty of people to herd you but only two actually processing passports After minutes one of the herders pointed the remaining twenty or so people in our queue to the automated passport machine She then promptly walked away Unfortunately no one bothered to walk through them as you could simply walk around so we all did Spain has no record of me entering its island Arrivals is like revisiting the s it all needs replacing Departures by comparison was like a different airport well managed very short queues and modern Toilets are very clean

Departure experience was relatively smooth an early morning flight on Ryanair so airport was very quiet Security was well managed clear markings on the floor to encourage social distancing However there was no coffee shop open so nowhere to buy a drink or a bite to eat Arriving back was very quick there were a number of staff members on hand to organise passengers no queue at passport control and bags were out within minutes however this was to be expected due to a very quiet flight and an empty airport Overall whilst the airport appeared clean we did not see any staff members cleaning while we were there with no hand sanitising stations available to passengers

Almaty to Karaganda Purchasing a ticket days before the flight from Almaty to Karaganda was super fast and cheap Airplane looks new and clean Service exceeded my expectations Cabin seat was quite comfortable Menu of snacks teacoffee and other bevarages is affordable One unusual thing is while checking in they sort flyers based on their seat numbers to make it easier to board a plane

Our arrival was great No problems The airport was clean People were friendly Renting a car was a bit of a pain because it was in another building a long way to drag several bags When departing we arrived hours early but had to wait about minutes before checking our bags There were only people working one for frequent flyers and one for the rest of us The couple at the head of our line had a problem and it took minutes for the lady to get the problem worked out When we got in line there were people in line By the time we were being checked in there were people in line Again everything was clean and the people were very pleasant
LuganoAgno is a little airport maybe the smallest in Switzerland but I think its the most efficient Its commercial says Youll be in the air in minutes and its the truth I think its a great airport

This is a small airport but the new passenger terminal is great Fast service helpful people and clean This is a good alternative of Brussels airport We like it and for sure if possible we will try again

Ryanair flight operated by Lauda Europe was on time Legroom wasnt great but was only just slightly worse than the same route with Austrian Airlines The crew were awesome a special shoutout to the female crew member who managed the iceinthecup situation for me I would happily fly this airline again its about the same as Austrian Airlines except you dont get a free small chocolate Recommended

Very basic domestic airport Probably the most basic Ive ever experienced Probably built late s early s and left Old Lino on the floor broken last Id strips where your luggage goes straight to the tarmac one coffee shop Surprisingly the toilets were very clean even with fresh flowers Nothing airside just uncomfortable plastic chairs I felt offended in that only non Caucasian people were scanned with the wand Did not seem right or fair Boarding of course was by steps Despite its limitations it was ok Just annoyed when those with too much baggage holds up the rest as they argue about it

Arrived mid night from Mumbai in a domestic flight aircraft attached to aero bridge in min we were at baggage area baggage arrived in next min Washroom were clean paid porters available plenty of baggage trolly No public transport during night only option is either prepaid or booking directly with taxi drivers We took prepaid going to Utorda around km paid approx inr during night a percent surcharge is applicable during day time should be around inr Just after you exit the terminal would be surrounded by taxi drivers prepaid cab counter is inside the building at arrival hall

This is a quite modern airport and serves the country well after that being said I felt the airport is terribly connected to the other parts of the island and it makes you rely heavily on taxis or hotel transfers On arrival they will ask you for the Mauritius all in one form if you do not have it they will send you to the end of the line so that you can fill it online the airport provides free wifi for that then they will ask for hotel accommodation and return tickets make sure you have then handy or this will delay you and everyone else standing in line The staff seem to be friendly specially if you speak French Bathrooms were clean and after immigration and security on departure there are plenty of food options including global fast food giants I would say that I enjoyed my time while using this airport

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

It was the smoothest landing ever and an enjoyable flight overall The crew was very polite and the departure and the arrival were on time in a minute

Gatwick to Venice We were hesitant about this airline having read reviews but booked it for the low price I have to say the flight exceeded our expectations Checkin and boarding were both an extremely smooth process I think we were at the bag drop desk for a total of minutes and boarding was much quicker than with other lowfrills airlines We paid in advance for extra legroom seats my partner is so this is an essential for us and were surprised by the amount of space and comfort We sat at the front of the plane with plenty of room to stretch out unlike Ryanair and EasyJet whose exit row seats only have an extra inch or so Flight took off and landed on time and was far more comfortable than wed anticipated There are definitely some areas to be improved upon in terms of the preflight process I have not come across any other airline in the past few years that makes you print out your own boarding pass rather than making it available electronically Its also pretty irritating to be told you cant check in online unless you pay for it this could potentially lead to long queues at the airport on the day These points lower my overall score for the airline but the flight experience itself was very pleasant

This tiny little airport couldnt be any more crowded or inadequate for its traffic Underseated understaffed And the most frustrating thing is the amount of space wasted on trying to sell perfume and other duty free when no one cares to buy it while people are all crowded around sitting on the floor in the terminal Food costs were highway robbery even in comparison to other airports and lines were so long it was frightening The only good part was the security agents who were friendly and less stressful than in most airports

The airport looks worn and uninviting Signage is abysmal and staff are just not interested in the flying customers Departures are better than Arrivals You end up walking literal miles This trip return from Fiji was like the airport didnt want to see us The auto kiosk scanning did not work meaning having to go to end of line of human checking There is no joy in Sydney airport It was far superior in the recent past When you exit and look for taxi it is difficult to find Uber gets precedence and is very slow

My biggest criticism for this airport is the pathetic approach road From the highway you have to suddenly dive into a potholed by lane which contains a hospital and will very shortly be hosting a big shopping mall Once the mall opens there is good chance of getting stuck in traffic just outside the airport The airport needs to urgently build a proper direct approach road from the highway to the airport

It was our honeymoon and this airline couldnt care less We didnt ask for much but the rudeness of their online staff really took away from the experience Very disappointing approach from what I thought was a reputable organisation

Do not transit through this airport No direct transfer path have to pass through immigration no airline lounges even BA A godforsaken hour wait in a miserable little airport Truly a third world experience in the heart of London

Koh Samui Airport was in general very cool This was because it was completely outside Although this is cool it was really hot throughout the airport which made it uncomfortable The airport was also dirty and the toilets were also dirty and very smelly The WiFi was also very poor Overall cool airport just the cleanliness isnt the best

Mixed expectations given various research but I have nothing but good points to say notwithstanding a delay of an hour On board the planes seats were far more comfortable than typical for European airlines with space and padding we were all served a tasty three course meal the courtesy of the staff and airline were to high standards It was all very fussfree and lacked an annoying push on sales etc An airline magazine would have been appreciated although the plane had USB sockets at every seat On board duty free range was significantly better value than expected too Id certainly book again and frankly wish more airlines ran services to this general standard

Be prepared that youll be rejected to checkin on the counter without any reasons They said that agent had an issue with booking but it cant be true because couple of months before flight I had a chat with support about buying luggage and they didnt mention any problems with registration As pointed in other reviews the problems in this airport hard to solve as it doesnt have WiFi and airline staff didnt offer any help So I was forced to buy new tickets times more expensive than initially

Arrived in the domestic section in the evening Bags out quickly no matching of the bagtag to the baggage receipt as can be the case in other airports Left on the international side the following morning Checkin reasonably quick No waiting for passport control Security check also quick though followed up by a patdown Once airside the food options are limited The small smoky cafe served very expensive filter coffee at RMB espresso machine broken but the Udon noodles at RMB were excellent Shopping limited The Terminal is bright nice and airy though fairly small only five gates in the international section When taxiing you get a nice view of the military airport the closest foreigners will get to seeing chinese airforce planes

rather cold and impersonal although food shop and checkin staff pleasant and I was able to checkin over an hour before departure Extraordinary use of loudspeaker systems inside and outside the terminal playing a local radio station at full blast It seems this airport is owned by the local radio station so loudspeakers are used to blast their advertisements at you as you alight from the Regional Express aircraft Beware that the terminal is shut until about an hour or so before an aircraft arrives or departs and one is forced to look for shelter where one can if dropped off a little early Strange place
Very Bad Airport Queue for almost hours for departure security check need to improve the security clearance wasting time just for queueing

Flew Nadi Fiji to Wallis Island Aircalin is the flag carrier of New Caledonia and although a small airline provided a good service There were no boarding problems and the flight was on time This was a very short flight and the cabin service was appropriate

The woman at the information desk Terminal near arrivals is a rude person and lacks politeness and empathy I really dont understand how they choose this specific person for a task that needs some communication skills and some level of politeness

After booking with them I went to check their reviews to know what to expect gotta say I was worried from what I read and was trying to see if I can change the airline Rate was too good and all was non refundable so I had no option but to go for it Got an email a few days before that the flight will be delayed for mins On the day of the flight I went in checked in bags total for people no issues boarded on time and pushed back once all boarded and arrived mins early Hard to review service as it was non existent for a mins flight Im not undermining other peoples bad experience i just thought Id comfort others and let them know there are days where its a really good experience

The service on the flights is great Free movies and texting Pay for full wifi The flight crew were very friendly However our luggage was lostdelayed during our hour overnight layover in Seattle The SeattleTacoma Airport had issues with their sorting systems but with so much time between flights and it being an overnight layover the lostdelayed luggage seems rather unacceptable Compensation was not offered upon arrival at our final destination until I asked about it The airline sent an email telling us about the issues at the Seattle airport hours after we had already checked our bags and were enroute to Seattle Extremely disappointed in the handling of our belongings which included gifts purchased while on vacation and medications

I have been using this airport for close to years and can honestly say it has become a complete nightmare The day we departed the had International Flights set for Departure at the same time and the airport was a complete disaster They are in no way equipped or handling flights simultaneously They seem to have missed the fact they are the size of a municipal airport and trying to have the appearance of an international airport We arrived at the airport hrs early as directed and they entire time was spent in the security line There were passport control employees as the line was wrapped around the building and down the sidewalk to the rental car lot The workers while friendly didnt have a care in the world that they were holding up a thousand people from boarding their flight in a timely manner Their TSA was also the slowest on the planet taking their sweet time to look at everything and ask the same questions over and over again We walked on our flight at final boarding and our plane was delayed mins due to more people stuck in the line They also had a side door at passport control that they allow people to continuously cut in line because their flight was in final boarding or they seem to know the people working at the airport We must have had people jump the line in front of us during our hr min wait time This airport needs to reevaluate their procedures and limit the flights departing at the same time as they are in no way up to the standard of being able to work in this manner

The biggest problem with this airport is unprofessional and inconsistent service Rules are being arbitrarily enforced business check in desks are used by economy passengers mobile boarding pass would not work so even if you have no bag to check you need to queue for min to get a paper boarding pass The biggest problem is the lack of professionalism

Short domestic flight from Heho to NyaungU Bagan for about USD per person with luggage included Checkin was done in a very small departure hall which was more like a bus terminal rather than an airport terminal with wooden kiosks Received boarding cards without seat and name attached to it as it was choose your seat in this flight After security and getting our boarding card stamped by passport control we were now waiting for our flight which turned out to be delayed by about an hour without any announcement The moment we were ready for boarding a wooden stick with our flight was shown and upon exiting the terminal we crossed passengers from another arriving flight to board our aircraft Greeted by a very friendly flight attendant who handed us some refreshing towels Not later than twenty minutes from boarding call we were already rolling for take off Service started quickly with a small snack box which included some water and a snack Landing was good in night and luggage was collected via open door in which luggage was dropped as no luggage belt was present

Astana Airport feels more like a bus station than an international airport Its tiny That said staff are friendly and will go out of their way to help you buy and install a Sim card There are a few of the usual taxi touts but not too many and they accept no There are a few shops but none of those annoying overpriced boutiques which is a good thing Wifi appeared to work

Good Airline to fly with Good staff and services there were no delays in departure and arrival The luggage at the belt came very fast Only the problem was Seat was not comfortable

The flight staff is very nice and helpful airplane is pretty clean Barely any delays Very cheap They need to improve their online Customer service I called them and messaged them on WhatsApp many times in a week but they only attended my call once at the very end International calling wasted a lot of my money Their part of the Kuwait airport is very claustrophobic Its very boring because it was very limited on stores And snacks and fast food was very expensive they dont serve snacks I shouldnt complain about this because the flight being cheap makes up for it You have to order food for the flight hours before the flight with money They have something called Jazeerascreens which is a flight entertainment website that you can access with their on plane wifi Awesome replacement to save money but it only works on phones and didnt work on my laptop

Arrival was super speedy world class speed by the immigration guy Airport facilities money changer is up until the time we arrive in there early pm ish local time Kudos to the landside staff However departure is a different story travelers are mire with last minute opening of AAX counters where usually it opens three hours ahead of time however at IKA it opens hours before departure time For non Iranians immigration queue is super long with one female officer working only we had to queue for more than minutes just to clear our passport Before immigration the seats are not enough to contains all the travellers and after the immigration there isnt any trolleys to move the luggage of us Good part about IKA you will feel safe in the airport with thorough checks and the presence of officers in military fatigue the security here is top notch After immigration there are sleeping benches at the most behind of gates Improvements to be done add more chairs before the immigration speed up the passport clearance and introduce trolleys after immigration

Flew with this airline a few times and each time was OK Then in May i booked a ticket from Kazakhstan back to the UK via Minsk They then cancelled the flight a couple of days before due to COVID I followed instructions and applied for a refundcredit for the price I paid which was just less than Dollars I filled in the appropriate document and sent it along with the eticket a copy of my passport etc I have since emailed them multiple times It is now September and I have not heard a single thing from them they have just taken my money and ignored me Disgraceful

This case seems warranted as a warning to anyone with a disability and related service dog After calling Porter to report traveling with a service animal a month in advance submitting appropriate documentation and being approved to travel with said dog I arrived at the Toronto airport to check in and was told no service dog was on record I provided my printed documentation which was scoured for the next minutes Finally the check in assistant approved my paperwork and added a service dog to my reservation They checked my bags printed my boarding passes and we proceeded to the gate to wait for boarding to begin When the gate attendant scanned my ticket I was moved to the side so Porter could finish boarding Porter employees then proceeded to close the gate and inform me I was barred from boarding the flight because my service dog was not documented Considering we fly together on flights a year I thought there must be some mistake Much to my dismay Porter both gate attendant and disability help line told me they couldnt point me in the direction of assistance refund me or help me in any way shape or form beyond their toll free customer service number hr estimated hold time They said they didnt have my documentation in their call center so I was not allowed to fly I was instructed to go back out of TSA security pick up my checked bags on a carrousel and wait hours after resubmitting my service dogs paperwork to try and rebook Sweat tears and hours later AirCanada got me a flight on the spot accepted the same paperwork and did not discriminate against me for having a disability which requires me to travel with an animal trained to attend to my medical needs

It seems several flights have arrived at once and immigration is not geared up to deal with so many passengers even though Malaga is now the th largest airport in Spain So far weve waited mins and its still a long way to go No information provided over the speakers and no staff to explain why the delay

Flight delay on December from HKG to BKK for hours It was supposed to be an early morning flight ended up arriving BKK at pm My family needs to transfer to Pattaya which ended up losing one day vacation No customer service staff at Hong Kong airport to explain the situation and all passengers were stuck at the airport
Airport was working smoothly for arrival and departure with no appreciable delays No queues at immigration or security indeed not that many passengers around A marked improvement from earlier trips

Travelled with Air New Zealand on Boeing Auckland to Honolulu in business class The ground handling was some of the best I have experienced Regrettably the experience quickly became more than a little disappointing The layout in herringbone pattern resulted in providing no privacy and very limited space Given that the herringbone style was already discredited by the time ANZ introduced this pattern it is hard to understand why they went with that option The appalling layout was only exceeded by the extremely poor onboard service with poor menu choice and failure to provide the supper and breakfast requested It gave the impression that the attendants didnt know what they were doing or were not interested As a long term user of ANZ and having found their serviceproduct very competitive this latest experience has left me looking to other airlines for long haul flights what a shame

The airport advertises Verified Traveller program and has signage but this option didnt exist I was shunted into regular lineup When I asked the security guard about it he shrugged told me to empty out everything and looked away until I started doing it As I was packed for the express line and they are very old school wanting belts etc off laptops in their own tray I ended up using trays Grateful I didnt have kids with me

New York to Copenhagen The seats were absolutely tiny No screens This was in place of Norwegian The flight attendants were nowhere to be found most of the flight The lights were on all night When I left the plane I felt like I could breathe again

Dinard Airport arrival experience was excellent I was second off the plane so got out within minutes Departure was a nightmare hrs queuing to get through passport control and security Theres only one Douane and security lane which isnt enough for full Ryanair flights Our flight had to be delayed by mins so everyone could get on Once in the departure lounge there is limited seating and a vending machine thats all and just toilets for everyone The terrace bar before security is very nice though

This was the First time i choose WestJet and it will be the last time The delay was about hours without any reasons First they said it has a delay for two hours because they want to repair the airplane Then they added one hour after one hour After five hours delay they said we cant repair this airplane and we will give you another one After hours the new airplane arrive from Winnipeg to Toronto When the passenger came out of the plane they said we have to find captain and crew for this airplane plane Finally after hours we departed I have never had a like this delay

Very small airport although recently refurbished The departure area has just one tiny bar before the security check Once you go through the security check there is no chance to get a bottle of water Few metal detectors When I left I didnt wait on line more than minutes but the area wasnt crowded at all I guess the waiting time would increase dramatically when more flights depart simultaneously

Skymark is fine when all goes well On the outbound trip from Tokyo to Shin Chitose my partner and I had no problems Checking was done by machine and boarding was prompt Inflight seats are okay and legroom is okay for an LCC The return trip never happened We checked in and went to get lunch at the airport before the flight As we made our way to security we saw the flight was canceled As all other SkyMark flights to Tokyo were full we were told we had find our own way back after which point we could apply for reimbursement of our new tickets cost All other airlines serving HND were full today so we ended up on Vanilla Air to NRT and getting home nearly nine hours later than planned Skymark followed their rules so we cannot fault their front line staff for the lack of service The bottom line with Skymark is that unless you are prepared to fend for yourself if something goes wrong its better to pay a bit more for an airline like JAL or ANA that is focused on customer service

The airport of the provincial capital of Haikou on Hainan Island China Dominated by Hainan Airlines and China Southern Airlines The exterior looked a little dated and the interior looked a little yellow with age though the checkin counters and washrooms certainly were uptodate Custom and security clearance were done smoothly and efficiently The main airport lobby was a little dark but it was certainly buzzing with activities The International Terminal serving Dragonair and Air Macau was tucked into an inconspicuous corner and not properly marked I did not see any signs either in English or Chinese Touts littered the airport exits If you do not mind the haggling RMB should be about right to get you into the city if not go for the Airport Shuttle bus Cost you only RMB and you can grab a taxi from its terminal for only RMB to anywhere within the city itself

Tehran to Shiraz with Iran Aseman Airlines The F is old The windows are scratched and poor The seats are not comfortable and ugly Nice takeoff and landing but even at the front of the plane the engines are noisy The plane was old and not so clean Really not a good time on the flight Cabin staff are nice and catering is not bad Overall its not good

Shocking Massive queue on arrival staff on passport control going very slow other planes arriving and bypassing passport check and straight baggage claim our rep used the word Brexit waiting ages and ages for cases no carousel number so pot luck if you were at the right one Departures unbelievable queuing outside get in then more queues then back outside to queue again to go back in passport check hundreds of people going nowhere once in departures words cannot describe it hundreds of people in one small room well thats all we could see as you literally could not move boiling hot no seats will we return no

Medellin to Pereira I flew to countries around the world My work involves some serious traveling and here I am after hour delayed local flight with no apologies of EasyFly This is the worse flight I have ever taken First they dont notify you of time changes then they gave me a meal that was so poor that I couldnt even eat it Then they put all passengers on a bus to take us to a different airport and dropped us there without any kind of information Unbelievable Different airlines are taking off in our eyes while they said the flight is closed due to bad weather Wouldnt be flying with them any more for sure

Never again This is a classic sentence said by customers and I really hope we will never need to buy tickets with Azul again We tried to book a flight from Manaus to Rio de Janeiro but the process was extremely complicated because we are not Brazilian and dont have a CPF It took forever and we had to try multiple times Eventually we managed to book the tickets and received a confirmation email so we assumed everything was fine However a few days later we realized they had sent another email saying the payment was pendingfor reasons unknown No problem we thought Lets try again Thats when the real trouble began We wanted to pay again using a card but it wasnt possible They offered PIX as a payment option but as foreigners we dont have access to PIX What were we supposed to do We tried to contact customer service We called different numbers sent an email and even messaged them on Facebook and Instagram No responseuntil finally after minutes on hold someone picked up The Azul representative told us the only way to fix the payment issue was to go to the Manaus airport in person up to four hours before the flight This was not a solution for us We were on an organized tour in the Amazon and couldnt just leaveand its so why couldnt they send us a payment link to finalize the process Still the answer was no Finally a kind Brazilian offered to help us pay via PIX We sent her the payment link but it expired in just seven minutes We sent another link but after that we werent given another chance to try The result We had to cancel a night and a day of our tour lose money and deal with immense frustration Azuls customer service is nonexistent They dont help and they seem to actively make things difficult for foreigners by requiring CPF for booking and PIX for payment To make matters worse their tickets arent even cheap
The price of the fare was very reasonable and affordable but there was no food on board served for free unless you ordered and paid for it also there was no entertainment screen to watch movies

Didnt actually fly Georgian Airways I attempted for a day and a half to book a flight on their website Incredibly cumbersome and user unfriendly site I got to the end and tried to pay the site site churned for a long time then switched back to the pay screen requiring me to reenter everything This happened I believe more than a dozen times A couple of entries just resulted in a failed screen If I waited too long I was required to additionally reenter all my demographics I sent an email to the airline requesting assistance I received no response The next day I tried again Finally switched from my Visa to an American Express card This resulted in being emailed an AMEX SafeKey code to verify I wanted to use this vendor Being emailed the code meant that my card info had been entered correctly I gain emailed the airline for assistance hours alter Ive not received any response

Our flight from Coron to Manila originally scheduled for AM was delayed to PM with no explanation The airport was in total disarray no information on the screens no staff in sight no WiFi When we finally boarded we saw that luggage from the previous flight was still being offloaded and the cabin was visibly dirty After an unusually short flight of just over an hour we were informed that suitcases had been left behind due to technical issues But the luggage was offloaded to lighten the aircraft and shorten the flight tim keeping it under hours the legal threshold that would have required the airline to compensate passengers As compensation we were offered Philippine pesos per bag about an amount that doesnt even cover the bare essentials for two days without luggage An insult more than a remedy

Boarding was by bus departure on time Plane was in a good condition There was a limited IFE through your mobile adequate for such a hour flight Inflight service was a bottle of water There was buy MENU available

AdenDubai on A Checkin swift and airside in less than mins Flight overbooked caused delay as ground staff sorted out rebookings for disgruntled pax Boarding was mildly confusing as some pax did not respect seat assignments Crew did their best to sort it out and finally got my seat Seat pitch tight for someone over cm limited seat recline good enough for h min flight would have been worse for longhaul Video on safety procedures was running during takeoff Light meal served after takeoff Good selection of juices though only one drink offered Cabin fairly clean but hygiene of restrooms questionable Rule on mobile phone use not enforced by crew and several pax out of their seats emptying overhead bins while taxiing to stand at Dubai quite chaotic

Customer service is so rude I approached a rep asking if where a flight was due to arrive as it was delayed and I was given a stock answer I tried to clarify the issue i was having and was met with hostility The agent was dismissive Instead I was able to get my answer online using the free wifi staff very unhelpful

Gatwick to Heraklion MT th September left a little late but it made up some timethe meal which I had prepaid for arrived almost three hours into the flight no water was offered or wine just a weak flavoured tea which didnt really quench my thirst This was very disappointing I expected more The aircraft seemed very cramped inside The take off message during the safety demonstration was very mumbled The flight was ok it would have been nice if the flight destination screens had been switched on Once through passport control and having collected my case there was a row of coaches outside the terminal and even at pm the place was very busy On return arrived at Heraklion Airport Packed with people no where to sit as we waited for a delayed flight back to Gatwick This time the flight destination screens were switched on and off in between an old episode of an American sitcom I had to ask when the food was coming as it had been several hours since my last meal Again no water or wine was offered only another cup of flavourless tea It seemed that duty free sales came first The flight was okay

Im supposed to fly to Zurich via LX today from London city airport The flight was cancelled suddenly without explanation I was given a redirected flight for h later I was told by the ground staff at the London city airport that I can get a complimentary meal pack from the airport either London City or Heathrow by showing my prior boarding pass I verified that I do not need anything else The airline provided a complimentary cab service to London Heathrow airport The fb facility at healthrow said that I need to show a meal voucher to qualify for the meal When I approach the Heathrow Swiss air ticketing counter which was a very long wait the staff said that theres no such a record for a meal voucher entitlement for me and tried to direct me to another staff then the Swiss air hotline This is a reflection of very poor service

Getting through the departure area at Banjul airport The Gambia to get to the UK is beyond ridiculous Firstly when you arrive to the airport you have to queue and weigh your luggage outside of the airport on scales You then proceed to pay GMD PP departure tax about at another area You are then shown to the first check in point where you need to show the following Covid test vaccination proof for the UK Evidence that a day test has been booked in the UK We had to challenge the staff here as they were stating that a day was needed as well Not if you are doubled jabbed Covid test result in The Gambia Passenger locator form for the UK PP Luggage drop the conveyor belt does not work So you weigh your luggage and take them off to place them back onto the luggage trolley Air Brussels are strict with weight and do not give you an inch Your hand luggage is also weighed at this point Passengers proceed to bag security where the luggage is scanned checked and can be opened so have your keys ready The bags are then weighed again Once this is done the bags are taken by a man to be placed in holding Next stop The passenger locator form for Brussels then needs to be shown at another desk Travellers then need to proceed to immigration where eye scans a further PP check is done and finger prints are taken Another security check again for hand luggage which is scanned and your PP is checked again The final check is done before you board the plane and access the bus Covid test result despite being shown already Standard PP check boarding pass Hand luggage is weighed again Boarding pass for connecting flights need to be shown as well I would suggest leaving early to get to the airport I would also suggest that you eat inside the airport at the restaurant to the top right The restaurant past the final check point is limited and more expensive too You are also attacked by flies whilst eating There is no duty free shopping either

Southwest hour layover on a return trip from Cancun Airport is quite nice and modern With enough space to accommodate surges Ill take this airport any day over an Atlanta Delta layover Clearly a new addition to the Kansas field did not experience old terminal Customsbag claim recheck and rescreen for TSA for the domestic leg was super quick Really like the glass jetways Friendly TSA and gate agents Bag claim and TSA were all quite clean Gate areas were dirty and not in the postrush kind of way Heavy duty cleaning seemed neglecteddeferred One example that stuck out Dusty and fingerprints on window areasills etc Bathroom sink areas could have received more attention Some soap dispensers not functioning A small gripe Impossible to get a bottled unsweet tea anywhere in the facility Every retail business had the exact same drinks in their grab and go coolers My guess is it is contracted out to Pepsico or something Whats the point of having multiple retail businesses if they all serve the same stuff Overall I really like the size and style of the facility Will look forward to my next layover here should the time come

I arrived here from Tokyo Haneda Two other flights arrived at the same time so there was a queue at immigration which took minutes My baggage was waiting for me at baggage claim Although older and smaller than TPE this airport is super convenient for visitors to Taipei Fewer passengers decent shopping very close to downtown and served by a metro line I flew out of Songshan to HND once before and was surprised at how easy it was to deal with

Both food and souvenir prices are outrageous and they are indicated in USD maybe a better to rip travellers off to dollars for a bowl of pho over for Burger King not even mentioning the drinks Restaurant offer very limited not even a proper coffee shop to seat down A very bitter way to say goodbye to Vietnam
Beirut to Stansted via Larnaca on Cobalt Cobalt is a budget airline so all services are unbundled No meals or refreshments were purchased I will fly Cobalt Airlines whenever I can

Yet another airport that does not provide fresh drinking water free of charge airside Having had a discussion with the security people at passport control they assured me there was no provision for potable water The only option was to buy a plastic bottle of water or use a tap in the toilet but that was not recommended It makes a mockery of the dustbins for recycling different items and that are scattered around the airport see picture It should become mandated that airports provide water free of charge Any claims to be green are otherwise total garbage

About hours before landing a passenger seated D fell off her seat We as passengers got very alarmed while the stewardesses being as robotic as they are took about a good mins before responding to our requests for assistance I am a retired US military with basic CPR knowledge and knew the crew showed how untrained they are to render basic medical assistance another mins past before they finally announced for any doctornurse assistance from the passengers After about an hour the patient was given medical assistance the head steward was more worried about the signing of disclaim papers than worrying about the persons condition On top of that we passengers experienced the most rough and bumpiest landing at MNL I have been riding airplanes since i was a child and a C can land smoother on a dirt runway than what we had to experience landing that night at MNL

I flew from Detroit to Paris with hour mins layover Little that I know that the IST is so vast that theres no way that I can transfer from gate D to gate A within that time limit My luggage never arrived to CDG when I arrived I was asked to complete a form online indicating my address in France telephone number and off course my information and the ticket number At that point I was told that I should expect the luggage in hours That was Thursday My flight to Istanbul was booked on Sunday by Saturday I was concerned that the luggage may not arrive before my flight I decided to change my flight to Tuesday afternoon pm I was forced to pay for charging my flight even though it was not my fault that the airline didnt deliver the luggage It has been a week now since I left Detroit and I still dont have my belongings

I just flew into this airport and not out so I can only say that the bags arrived very quickly and efficiently I will also say that walking from the plane to the terminal and night it seemed as though we were the only people on earth in the middle of nowhere Ive never been to an airport that was so quiet It certainly seemed bereft of planes

My incoming flight by West Air was arriving to Terminal at night and my onward international flight was from Terminal several hours later in the morning It was easy to find the transit bus stop there were a few taxi drivers offering their services at the arrival hall but they werent annoying as long as they saw Im uninterested and despite my worries the bus was operating at night and my wait time was no longer than minutes On the way the bus stopped a few times to pick up and drop off mostly airport staff in a few places including the nowdisused old Terminal but it took no more than minutes to get to Terminal Terminal is very modern but looks a bit empty except the departure floor where there are quite many shops many of which started to open after am and restaurants I didnt have time to get out to the city at Chongqing so I picked up some food souvenirs at Mannings supermarket as well as another smaller shop the prices while possibly higher than in the city didnt seem to be overly so The eleven has some inexpensive foods as well WiFi is free doesnt take much hassle to log in and is fast enough Check in desks look unusual with those futuristic large machines where all the baggage goes in place of traditional rubber belts Otherwise the check in and security procedures were as usual Didnt have too much time to explore the airside but it looks a bit empty too

Very nice designed airport clean and big but they have the worst type of airport staff from salesmen at the duty free to airport staff walking around to assist you You feel that they were forced to work and you can see that in the way they behave

Rude treatment of elderly passengers This is not our first time visiting Tbilisi It was always great This year I decided to meet my elderly parents in this city We were flying from America they were from Belarus We had a great time and were inspired by the beauty of Georgia its hospitable people unique culture and great food But all of this was crossed out at the airport Both of my parents are over years old and it shows At the security screening they were never offered help or possibility to skip the line Moreover they were rudely searched and groped and my father was taken to a separate office where he was forced to take off the hernia belt which he never takes off and cannot put back on on his own We got to the airport more than two hours before the flight time However because my parents cannot walk quickly all of this screening took a lot of time They were at the security line past the boarding time Even after their names were announced on the PA system several times they were not allowed to go through passport control without standing in line As the result they were forced to run as fast as they could to get on the plane My parents are very kind people they never complain about anyone and try to stay positive But I see that for a couple of days now they have not been able to recover from this stress I am shocked by this attitude of the airport security and border control staff I am very sorry that airport services demonstrate such treatment towards guests of their country

A very modern elegant and efficient airport From taxi to lounge it took us less than minutes But beware of extreme and violent security just before boarding We were forced to leave our bags in the middle of the passage way leading to the airbridge and moved against the wall while a sniffer dog went over them No one told us what to do or what to expect Then we were forded to face the wall while a police office hand searched us No instructions was given not even in Spanish we just follow what others did Very scary I have never seen anything like this before My hand was violent moved upwards by the police officers during the search Iberia should have informed us this was going to happen and what to do A lot of passengers complained and the pilot called the dispatcher on board the purser told us Not a nice experience being treated like criminals as though one was in a prison and they were carrying out security checks A nasty experience which damages the reputation of a rather very pleasant airport
